+# ADR-0086 — Canonical DAB Windows course and separate legacy API checks
+
+## Status
+
+Accepted architecture choice, 2026-10-11, attributed to the explicit PO chat approval recorded in the companion approval preview. Publication and compilation remain Root-owned; implementation and qualification status are separate.
+
+## Date
+
+2026-10-11
+
+## Context
+
+The normal design flow uses canonical DAB review receipts and one aggregated design proof. ADR-0085 retires the separate DWP approval artifact and readiness content review. Original RC12C001 still records a native Windows failure in the legacy readiness fixture; presentation retirement alone does not resolve that failure or establish native coverage.
+
+## Decision
+
+Test the canonical DAB design flow on native Windows as the current design-course successor. Check retained legacy Readiness APIs separately against their surviving compatibility contracts; do not reactivate the retired DWP approval ceremony. Preserve the original RC12C001 failure and explicitly map its successor coverage. Neither the new course nor the separate API check is deemed successful by this decision.
+
+Native course evidence must exercise actual Windows process ownership, custody and finalization, real review receipt consumption, canonical DAB binding, the one design proof and terminal readback. Existing controlled or POSIX evidence cannot substitute for native Windows evidence. Retained standalone APIs require a finite compatibility inventory and explicit per-API disposition; no total API decommissioning is implied.
+
+## Consequences
+
+The canonical course and legacy API compatibility are separate engineering obligations. Existing stored evidence remains readable and original failures remain historical evidence. One common Design package carries this decision; no separate ADR terminal or signature is added. This scope decision confers no HGO grant, planSignature, protected-write executor, native PASS or item closure.
+
+## Affected Contracts
+
+ADR-0085; canonical DAB design approval; native Windows course and legacy RC12C001; retained runCodexDesignReadinessHost/runCodexToolFreeDesignReadiness compatibility. The accepted carrier amendment remains authoritative against DWP reactivation.

+# ADR-0087 — Owning verification through an authenticated controller test channel
+
+## Status
+
+Accepted architecture choice, 2026-10-11, attributed to the explicit PO chat approval recorded in the companion approval preview. Publication and compilation remain Root-owned; implementation and qualification status are separate.
+
+## Date
+
+2026-10-11
+
+## Context
+
+Actual owner/member/requester handles and the default Verify journal are constructive existing mechanisms. Current FD4 requester identity does not prove a suite-to-owning-course authorization to a fresh guard. ADR-0050 grants recovery evidence continuity, not lifecycle execution authority.
+
+## Decision
+
+Implement a specific Source-issued verification-only controller test channel, following the frozen OSV001–008 requirements and the carrier design refinement. The genuine I03 producer derives the owning course, registered suite, candidate/tree, source bytes and fixed executable/argv/cwd from authenticated owner/execution/member/current-requester bindings. A fresh guard independently authenticates the live original issuer and one-use attempt before dispatch. Serialized JSON, PID, cleanup records, filenames, caller flags or FD4 identity alone are insufficient.
+
+Use real default Verify child execution, journal and official FD3 completion. Close synchronous Registry boundaries before awaiting the child, retain the original requester Promise lifetime, and freshly recheck at terminal. Verification admits only existing journal effects and sanctioned disposable fixtures; it grants no State/approval/public-authority write, member release, another-suite permission or general interpreter exemption.
+
+Select and freeze the exact production protocol, genuine course-to-suite data fields, child/guard ownership ports, bounded attempt/claim durability and result schema before Source posts. The refinement rejects shared-capability HMAC alone as live-parent freshness proof. Activate the narrowly scoped guard admission only after independent issuer/transport/consumer qualification.
+
+## Consequences
+
+Unknown, foreign, stale, malformed, drifted, expired or replayed attempts refuse before dispatch and conserve active authority. Child failures and incomplete FD3 evidence remain failures. OSV001–008 remain unchanged in the companion requirements copy. Implementation approval does not itself prove qualification or activate execution authority. This decision joins the common Design package with no extra ADR signature or terminal, HGO grant, planSignature, protected executor or item closure.
+
+## Affected Contracts
+
+I03 verification issuer; Registry synchronous genuine member inspections; Source-owned requester lifetime and authenticated fixed child/guard channel; default Verify journal and official FD3 terminal. ADR-0050, ADR-0076 and ADR-0085 remain in force.

+# Draft: Item-owned EGM and retained independent quality gates
+
+## Status and date
+
+Proposed, 2026-10-11. The PO selected complete item ownership and the coherent
+batch correction course in the original EGM optimization conversation. This
+draft records that selected direction and its scope, as relayed in the Source
+dispatch; it is a selection paraphrase, not a quoted chat transcript or an
+approval receipt. Include the exact record and Markdown digest in the existing
+aggregate design package. No separate adoption question or ADR terminal
+signature is required. The configured aggregate approval and sanctioned
+materialization remain necessary where applicable. Numbering follows ADR-0069
+at acceptance. This record confers no accepted or live compiler authority.
+
+## Context
+
+ADR-0005 protects against reported completion without tests, retains a
+two-part Definition of Done, and explicitly states that the implementation
+Goldfish never modifies its own tests. Separate test preparation and code
+ownership can split one outcome across contexts and add rediscovery and waits.
+The PO selected one complete independently verifiable outcome per Goldfish.
+That deliberately relaxes separate test authorship while preserving independent
+judgment and honest evidence. Significance axes 1 and 4 apply: role boundaries
+and reliability policy change. Benefits remain hypotheses, not measurements.
+
+## Decision proposed for the common design package
+
+1. One Goldfish owns one complete independently verifiable acceptance criterion
+   or backlog outcome: analysis, test cases, code, targeted checks and fixes
+   remain in one context. It may author new regression tests. Existing acceptance
+   examiners remain intact; necessary changes are visible, justified and
+   independently reviewed. Assertions map to original criteria. Meaningful RED
+   demonstrates the real defect, not fixture/setup failure. Actual receipts bind
+   commands, results and candidate inputs; author claims never award acceptance.
+2. The Elephant schedules nonoverlapping file owners. Colliding/dependent items
+   wait; Main integrates tested deliveries preserving other owners' changes.
+   Do not routinely repeat targeted tests. After a manual merge conflict, run
+   affected checks; drift/missing evidence requires Goldfish requalification.
+   Original owners end after tested delivery and integration.
+3. Predeclare one coherent batch before its items start; freeze membership after
+   integration and before Critic. Every risk tier uses one independent full
+   Critic over code and tests against the original criteria, never one Critic per
+   mini-item. A singleton requires a documented substantial risk rationale.
+4. After findings, one fresh Correction Goldfish owns the whole batch and keeps
+   context across all findings, fixes and delta reviews. The batch budget is one
+   full Critic plus at most three delta Critics, stops immediately on PASS and
+   cannot restart under a new identifier. Exhaustion retains the existing
+   stop/course path; Elephant self-review cannot substitute for independent PASS.
+5. Full Verify qualifies the integrated reviewed candidate once. Failure still
+   requires repair and applicable requalification; no pending result becomes
+   PASS. Tests alone are not acceptance. Semantic completeness remains an
+   independent judgment duty that mechanical enforcement cannot prove alone.
+6. The methodology scope includes Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity, Windows,
+   Linux and macOS, and user repositories. Actual installed native enforcement
+   qualification remains pending per runner/host; source checks or declarations
+   cannot establish universal native PASS. Prior M2/M3 whole-closure report-only
+   decisions remain report-only. No added human gate arises from routine work.
+
+## Supersession and retained obligations
+
+The machine record proposes replacement of ADR-0005, because its absolute
+test-role separation clause contradicts item-owned regression-test authorship.
+The replacement preserves all still-valid ADR-0005 obligations: one calibrated
+Verify entry, Format/Lint/Typecheck/Tests/Build where applicable, machine-written
+candidate-bound evidence, blocking deterministic requirements before final
+acceptance, CI duties, and the two-part deterministic plus independent judgment
+Definition of Done. Existing boundary-aware Verify under ADR-0081 and the
+content-bound review-before-final-Verify course retain their own authority;
+this replacement does not restore an obsolete mandatory full run before review.
+Existing mutation/meta-check and E2E/config mitigation duties remain applicable
+under their project calibration. Coverage thresholds still do not prove quality.
+
+ADR-0003's fresh, independently briefed read-only Critic, assurance/isolation
+boundaries and selected-runner route remain intact. ADR-0014's refs-only input,
+evidence-gated findings, disposition and delta-review lineage remain intact;
+the explicit batch correction budget refines that course. ADR-0080's advisory
+parallel-safety predicate remains intact: disjoint outcomes may run concurrently,
+dependencies and colliders wait, safe commit surfaces remain required, and
+an advisory never forces parallelism. These are compatible additive refinements,
+not whole-record supersessions. Do not mark those three original ADRs superseded.
+Historical ADR files and statuses are not edited by this draft producer.
+
+## Consequences
+
+Fewer handoffs and earlier item completion are intended effects. Removing the
+separate test author loses an independent interpretation of requirements:
+code and tests can share the same blind spot. Original-criterion mappings,
+product-caused RED evidence, preserved examiners and fresh independent review
+mitigate that risk but cannot eliminate it. Record actual item delivery,
+integration/closure and wait times by reason before claiming improvement.
+No invented measurement or performance guarantee is part of this decision.
+
+## Affected contracts
+
+- ADR-0005 quality-gate and test-role clause; retained ADR-0003/0014/0080/0081.
+- docs/operating-model.md, roles/elephant.md, roles/goldfish.md, roles/critic.md,
+  guardrails/quality-gates.md, harness/definition-of-done.md,
+  harness/review-protocol.md and dispatch/review checklists.
+- templates/prompts/goldfish-task.md, templates/prompts/critic-review.md and
+  packaged agents, skills and document mirrors.
+- Common dispatch, test-path admission, METHOD observation, item delivery,
+  review-course and Verify evidence consumers; native runner adapters.
+- README.md, PIPELINE_FLOW.md, PIPELINE_FLOW.de.md, docs/usage.md,
+  docs/parallel-work.md and docs/cost-and-measurement.md.
+
+## Required qualification evidence
+
+Candidate-bound checks must exercise actual admission/record/qualification
+consumers: complete-item ownership, original-criterion and RED evidence,
+new-test permission with protected existing examiners, collider waits,
+integration preservation, unchanged targeted evidence retention, conflict/drift
+requalification, frozen batches, full-plus-three delta budget and stop on PASS,
+same Correction Goldfish continuity, independent review of code and tests,
+and final full qualification. Native qualification needs actual host execution
+for each claimed runner/OS combination. Neither this draft nor fixture-only
+evidence reports completion of those obligations.

+#!/usr/bin/env node
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: SUL-1.0
+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import { mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, readFileSync, rmSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
+import { dirname, join } from "node:path";
+import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
+import { registerTestCaseCompletion } from "../../plugins/pipeline-core/lib/test-case-completion.mjs";
+import { verifyCaseCompletionPolicySha256 } from "../../plugins/pipeline-core/lib/verify-case-completion-receipt.mjs";
+import { checkVerifyCaseCompletion, DEFAULT_SCHEMA } from "./check-verify-case-completion.mjs";
+
+const ROOT = fileURLToPath(new URL("../..", import.meta.url));
+const POLICY_SCHEMA = "pipeline.verify-case-completion-policy.v1";
+const VERIFY = "harness/scripts/verify.mjs";
+const AUGMENTATIONS = "harness/config/verify-case-completion-augmentations.v1.json";
+const SUITE = "plugins/pipeline-core/lib/slice-queue.test.mjs";
+const CASES = [];
+const policy = (caseIds = ["SQ01", "SQ02"], maxBytes = 65536) => ({ schema: POLICY_SCHEMA, caseIds, maxBytes });
+const literal = (previous) => `{ schema: "${POLICY_SCHEMA}", caseIds: ${JSON.stringify(previous.caseIds)}, maxBytes: ${previous.maxBytes} }`;
+function write(root, path, content) {
+  mkdirSync(dirname(join(root, path)), { recursive: true });
+  writeFileSync(join(root, path), content);
+}
+function fixture(policySource) {
+  const scratch = join(ROOT, "scratch");
+  mkdirSync(scratch, { recursive: true });
+  const root = mkdtempSync(join(scratch, "verify-builtin-policy-"));
+  write(root, VERIFY, `
+const TEST_SUITES = [
+  { name: "slice-queue-tests", file: join(libDir, "slice-queue.test.mjs")${policySource === null ? "" : `, caseCompletion: ${policySource}`} },
+];
+const SCOPED_VERIFY_SUITES = Object.freeze([
+]);
+const WINDOWS_ASSURANCE_VERIFY_SUITES = Object.freeze([
+]);
+`);
+  write(root, DEFAULT_SCHEMA, readFileSync(join(ROOT, DEFAULT_SCHEMA)));
+  write(root, "harness/config/verify-case-completion.v1.json", JSON.stringify({ schema: "pipeline.verify-case-completion-registry.v1", entries: [
+    { name: "slice-queue-tests", path: SUITE, disposition: "required" },
+  ] }));
+  write(root, SUITE, `import { registerTestCaseCompletion } from "./test-case-completion.mjs";
+registerTestCaseCompletion({ cases: [], fd: 3, maxBytes: 65536 });
+`);
+  return root;
+}
+function augment(root, previous, next, digest = undefined) {
+  write(root, AUGMENTATIONS, JSON.stringify({ schema: "pipeline.verify-case-completion-augmentations.v1", augmentations: [
+    { name: "slice-queue-tests", file: SUITE, ...(previous === null ? {} : { previousPolicySha256: digest ?? verifyCaseCompletionPolicySha256(previous) }), caseCompletion: next },
+  ] }));
+}
+function withFixture(policySource, run) {
+  const root = fixture(policySource);
+  try { run(root); } finally { rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
+}
+function accepted(root) {
+  const result = checkVerifyCaseCompletion({ root });
+  assert.equal(result.ok, true, result.findings.join("\n"));
+  assert.equal(result.registeredCount, 1);
+  assert.equal(result.registryCount, 1);
+}
+function rejected(root, code) {
+  const result = checkVerifyCaseCompletion({ root });
+  assert.equal(result.ok, false);
+  assert.ok(result.findings.some((finding) => finding.includes(code)), result.findings.join("\n"));
+}
+function check(id, name, run) { CASES.push({ id, name, run }); }
+
+check("BCP01", "literal builtin policy survives exact digest-bound extension without rewriting the preimage", () => {
+  const previous = policy();
+  withFixture(literal(previous), (root) => {
+    const before = readFileSync(join(root, VERIFY));
+    augment(root, previous, policy(["SQ01", "SQ02", "SQ03"]));
+    accepted(root);
+    assert.deepEqual(readFileSync(join(root, VERIFY)), before);
+  });
+});
+check("BCP02", "the real SQ01 through SQ34 generator preserves every ID and underscore byte budget", () => {
+  const previous = policy(Array.from({ length: 34 }, (_, index) => `SQ${String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}`));
+  const source = '{ schema: "pipeline.verify-case-completion-policy.v1", caseIds: Array.from({ length: 34 }, (_, index) => `SQ${String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}`), maxBytes: 65_536 }';
+  withFixture(source, (root) => {
+    augment(root, previous, policy([...previous.caseIds, "SQ35", "SQ36", "SQ37"]));
+    accepted(root);
+  });
+});
+check("BCP03", "wrong hashes and exact-prior budget or ID drift remain denied", () => {
+  const previous = policy();
+  for (const digest of ["0".repeat(64), verifyCaseCompletionPolicySha256(policy(previous.caseIds, 66048)), verifyCaseCompletionPolicySha256(policy(["SQ01"]))]) {
+    withFixture(literal(previous), (root) => {
+      augment(root, previous, policy([...previous.caseIds, "SQ03"]), digest);
+      rejected(root, "VERIFY-AUGMENTATION AUG-PREIMAGE");
+    });
+  }
+});
+check("BCP04", "shrinking, replacement, equal case sets and budget reductions remain non-monotone", () => {
+  const previous = policy();
+  for (const next of [policy(["SQ01"]), policy(["SQ01", "SQ03", "SQ04"]), previous, policy(["SQ01", "SQ02", "SQ03"], 65024)]) {
+    withFixture(literal(previous), (root) => {
+      augment(root, previous, next);
+      rejected(root, "VERIFY-AUGMENTATION AUG-NON-MONOTONE");
+    });
+  }
+});
+check("BCP05", "boolean and invalid present policies cannot be treated as absent or a bindable baseline", () => {
+  const previous = policy();
+  for (const source of ["true", "null", "{ ...runtimePolicy }", literal(previous).replace('maxBytes: 65536', 'maxBytes: 0')]) {
+    withFixture(source, (root) => {
+      augment(root, previous, policy([...previous.caseIds, "SQ03"]));
+      rejected(root, "VERIFY-AUGMENTATION AUG-PREIMAGE");
+      augment(root, null, policy([...previous.caseIds, "SQ03"]));
+      rejected(root, "VERIFY-AUGMENTATION AUG-CONFLICT");
+    });
+  }
+});
+check("BCP06", "static parsing never executes unsupported generator callbacks or arbitrary expressions", () => {
+  const previous = policy();
+  globalThis.BCP_UNSAFE_EXECUTED = false;
+  const source = '{ schema: "pipeline.verify-case-completion-policy.v1", caseIds: Array.from({ length: 2 }, (_, index) => (globalThis.BCP_UNSAFE_EXECUTED = true, `SQ${index}`)), maxBytes: 65536 }';
+  withFixture(source, (root) => {
+    augment(root, previous, policy([...previous.caseIds, "SQ03"]));
+    rejected(root, "VERIFY-POLICY");
+    assert.equal(globalThis.BCP_UNSAFE_EXECUTED, false);
+  });
+  delete globalThis.BCP_UNSAFE_EXECUTED;
+});
+check("BCP07", "existing valid policies and supplementary policy for genuinely absent registrations retain admission", () => {
+  withFixture(literal(policy()), accepted);
+  withFixture(null, (root) => {
+    augment(root, null, policy());
+    accepted(root);
+  });
+});
+check("BCP08", "duplicate or unordered IDs and unbounded generators stay closed before allocation", () => {
+  for (const source of [
+    literal(policy(["SQ01", "SQ01"])),
+    literal(policy(["SQ02", "SQ01"])),
+    literal(policy()).replace('["SQ01","SQ02"]', '["SQ01" "SQ02"]'),
+    literal(policy()).replace('maxBytes: 65536', 'maxBytes: 65__536'),
+    '{ schema: "pipeline.verify-case-completion-policy.v1", caseIds: Array.from({ length: 9999999999 }, (_, index) => `SQ${String(index + 1).padStart(2, "0")}`), maxBytes: 65536 }',
+    '{ schema: "pipeline.verify-case-completion-policy.v1", caseIds: Array.from({ length: 2 }, (_, index) => `SQ${String(index + 1).padStart(9999999999, "0")}`), maxBytes: 65536 }',
+  ]) {
+    withFixture(source, (root) => rejected(root, "VERIFY-POLICY"));
+  }
+});
+
+assert.equal(CASES.length, 8);
+const completionFd = Number(process.env.PIPELINE_VERIFY_CASE_COMPLETION_FD ?? "3");
+registerTestCaseCompletion({
+  cases: CASES,
+  fd: completionFd,
+  maxBytes: Number(process.env.PIPELINE_VERIFY_CASE_COMPLETION_MAX_BYTES ?? "8192"),
+});

+// SPDX-License-Identifier: SUL-1.0
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import { submitPlan, approveSubmittedPlan, derivePlanLifecycle, reopenPlanDesign, sha256CanonicalJson } from '../../plugins/pipeline-core/lib/plan-spec-state-v2.mjs';
+import { registerTestCaseCompletion } from '../../plugins/pipeline-core/lib/test-case-completion.mjs';
+const h = n => n.repeat(64);
+const authority = { schema:'pipeline.po-gate-authority.v2', humanFacing:'en', sourceSha256:h('4'),runtimeSha256:h('5'),receiptSha256:h('6'),repositoryFingerprint:h('7'),planPath:'specs/unit/prd.md',planSha256:h('1'),specPath:'specs/unit/spec.md',specSha256:h('2') };
+const profileSha256=h('3');
+const at='2026-10-09T10:00:00.000Z';
+function continuity() { return {
+  schema:'pipeline.continuity.v0',featureId:'unit',revision:0,
+  runtime:{humanFacingLanguage:'en',activeDuty:'Coordinator',sessionCleanup:null},
+  authority:{prd:{path:authority.planPath,sha256:h('8')},spec:{path:authority.specPath,sha256:h('9')},result:null},
+  queueHead:{packageId:'continuity-adoption',actionId:'review-active-feature',nextAction:'review',productRetryCount:0,environmentRerouteCount:0,dispatch:null},
+  blocker:null,acknowledgedFinal:null,resume:{mode:'immediate',sourceRevision:0,reasonCode:'active-turn'},
+  recovery:null,decisionTxn:null,closeTransition:null,
+  capacity:{concurrencyLimit:4,reservedCriticSlots:1,reservedRecoverySlots:1,fallbackPolicy:'defer'}
+}; }
+function draft() { return {schema:'pipeline.state.v0',activeFeature:{id:'unit',planPath:authority.planPath,phase:'design'},planApproved:false,continuity:continuity()}; }
+function submitted(state=draft(), a=authority) {
+  const r=submitPlan({state,expectedStateSha256:sha256CanonicalJson(state),poGateAuthority:a,profile:'mini',profileSha256,by:'Coordinator',at});
+  assert.equal(r.ok,true,JSON.stringify(r)); return r.state;
+}
+function approved(state=submitted(), a=authority) {
+  const r=approveSubmittedPlan({state,expectedStateSha256:sha256CanonicalJson(state),expectedSubmissionSha256:derivePlanLifecycle(state).submissionSha256,poGateAuthority:a,profileSha256,by:'PO',at});
+  assert.equal(r.ok,true,JSON.stringify(r)); return r.state;
+}
+const changed={...authority,planSha256:h('a'),specSha256:h('b')};
+const observation={planSha256:changed.planSha256,specSha256:changed.specSha256,profileSha256};
+function reopened() {
+  const before=approved();
+  const r=reopenPlanDesign({state:before,expectedStateSha256:sha256CanonicalJson(before),by:'PO',at:'2026-10-09T10:05:00.000Z'});
+  assert.equal(r.ok,true,JSON.stringify(r)); return {before,r};
+}
+const cases=[
+  {id:'RPOP001',name:'approved drift recommends reopen',run(){const s=approved();assert.equal(derivePlanLifecycle(s).status,'approved');const d=derivePlanLifecycle(s,observation);assert.equal(d.ok,false);assert.equal(d.nextAction,'reopen-design');}},
+  {id:'RPOP002',name:'actual reopen releases binding and retains history',run(){const {before,r}=reopened();assert.equal(r.replay,false);assert.equal(r.state.planApproved,false);assert.equal(r.state.activeFeature.phase,'design');assert.deepEqual(r.state.planSubmission,before.planSubmission);assert.equal(r.invalidation.invalidatedSubmissionSha256,sha256CanonicalJson(before.planSubmission));assert.equal(r.invalidation.invalidatedApprovalSha256,sha256CanonicalJson(before.planApproval));assert.equal(derivePlanLifecycle(r.state,observation).status,'draft');}},
+  {id:'RPOP003',name:'released draft does not repeat reopen recommendation',run(){const {r}=reopened();const d=derivePlanLifecycle(r.state,observation);assert.equal(d.ok,true);assert.equal(d.status,'draft');assert.equal(d.approvalCurrent,false);assert.equal(d.nextAction,null,'released historical submission must not recommend reopening again');}},
+  {id:'RPOP004',name:'identical reopen replay preserves canonical state',run(){const {r}=reopened();const again=reopenPlanDesign({state:r.state,expectedStateSha256:sha256CanonicalJson(r.state),by:'PO',at:'2026-10-09T10:05:00.000Z'});assert.equal(again.ok,true);assert.equal(again.replay,true);assert.equal(sha256CanonicalJson(again.state),sha256CanonicalJson(r.state));}},
+  {id:'RPOP005',name:'fresh submission is unapproved and fresh approved drift reopens',run(){const {r}=reopened();const s=submitted(r.state,changed);assert.equal(s.planApproved,false);assert.equal(derivePlanLifecycle(s,observation).status,'awaiting-approval');const a=approved(s,changed);assert.equal(derivePlanLifecycle(a,observation).status,'approved');assert.equal(derivePlanLifecycle(a,{...observation,planSha256:h('c')}).nextAction,'reopen-design');}},
+  {id:'RPOP006',name:'malformed authority and stale state remain refused',run(){const s=approved();assert.equal(reopenPlanDesign({state:s,expectedStateSha256:h('0'),by:'PO',at}).ok,false);assert.equal(derivePlanLifecycle({...s,planSubmission:{...s.planSubmission,planSha256:'invalid'}}).ok,false);assert.equal(submitPlan({state:draft(),expectedStateSha256:sha256CanonicalJson(draft()),poGateAuthority:{...authority,planSha256:'invalid'},profile:'mini',profileSha256,by:'Coordinator',at}).ok,false);}}
+].map(c=>({...c,mode:'run'}));
+registerTestCaseCompletion({cases,fd:3,maxBytes:32768});

+// SPDX-License-Identifier: SUL-1.0
+// NEW RGGRAM placement fixture. It does not identify or repair the historical unnamed fixture.
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
+import { discoverSurfaces } from './check-product-capability-inventory.mjs';
+import { registerTestCaseCompletion } from '../../plugins/pipeline-core/lib/test-case-completion.mjs';
+
+const root = fileURLToPath(new URL('../../', import.meta.url));
+const grammar = 'plugins/pipeline-core/lib/guard/shell-grammar.mjs';
+const splitTest = 'plugins/pipeline-core/lib/guard/guard-split-contract.test.mjs';
+const closureTest = 'plugins/pipeline-core/lib/guard-maintenance-window-kernel-closure.test.mjs';
+const ownTest = 'harness/scripts/shell-grammar-capability-placement.test.mjs';
+const suiteName = 'shell-grammar-capability-placement-tests';
+const json = path => JSON.parse(readFileSync(new URL(path, new URL('../../', import.meta.url)), 'utf8'));
+function fixture() {
+  return { inventory: json('docs/product-capability-inventory.json'),
+    split: json('harness/guard-split-map.json'),
+    registry: json('harness/verify-suites.json'),
+    map: readFileSync(new URL('../../architecture/map/pipeline-core.md', import.meta.url), 'utf8') };
+}
+function assertPlacement(value) {
+  const owners = value.inventory.capabilities.filter(capability => capability.productionEvidence.includes(grammar));
+  assert.equal(owners.length, 1, 'RGGRAM has one concrete capability evidence placement');
+  assert.equal(owners[0].id, 'claude-hook-safety', 'shared guard library is placed with command/write-path guardrails');
+  for (const path of [splitTest, closureTest, ownTest]) assert(owners[0].testEvidence.includes(path), `missing placement test evidence: ${path}`);
+  const front = value.map.split('\n---\n')[0];
+  const contracts = front.split('publicContracts:\n')[1]?.split('\nallowedDependencies:')[0] ?? '';
+  const checks = front.split('verificationEntryPoints:\n')[1]?.split('\nadrReferences:')[0] ?? '';
+  assert(contracts.split('\n').includes(`  - ${grammar}`), 'grammar is a declared pipeline-core contract');
+  for (const path of [splitTest, closureTest]) assert(checks.split('\n').includes(`  - ${path}`), 'module evidence maps to existing real verification entry');
+  assert.equal(value.split.moduleDir, 'plugins/pipeline-core/lib/guard');
+  assert.equal(value.split.modules['shell-grammar'].layer, 1, 'existing measured layer1 is conserved');
+  for (const name of ['isReadOnlyDiagnosticCommand', 'isReadOnlySimpleWords', 'simpleWords']) assert.equal(value.split.declarations[name], 'shell-grammar', 'source fixture must point to the real grammar owner');
+  const suite = value.registry.suites.filter(row => row.name === suiteName);
+  assert.equal(suite.length, 1, 'placement fixture is registered exactly once');
+  assert.equal(suite[0].file, ownTest);
+  assert.deepEqual(suite[0].caseCompletion.caseIds, ['RGCP001', 'RGCP002', 'RGCP003', 'RGCP004']);
+}
+const cases = [
+  { id: 'RGCP001', name: 'actual current capability and architecture/split maps place the kernel grammar without an extra capability', run() { assertPlacement(fixture()); } },
+  { id: 'RGCP002', name: 'missing or duplicate production placement is detected even when broad hook evidence remains', run() {
+    const missing = fixture(); missing.inventory.capabilities.find(c => c.id === 'claude-hook-safety').productionEvidence = missing.inventory.capabilities.find(c => c.id === 'claude-hook-safety').productionEvidence.filter(path => path !== grammar);
+    assert.throws(() => assertPlacement(missing), /one concrete capability/);
+    const duplicate = fixture(); duplicate.inventory.capabilities.find(c => c.id === 'deterministic-verification').productionEvidence.push(grammar);
+    assert.throws(() => assertPlacement(duplicate), /one concrete capability/);
+  } },
+  { id: 'RGCP003', name: 'actual product surface discovery does not fabricate a library guard surface and the new suite has one real assignment', run() {
+    const value = fixture(); const discovered = new Set(discoverSurfaces(root).map(row => row.surfaceId));
+    const invented = `guard:${grammar}:shell-grammar`;
+    assert.equal(discovered.has(invented), false, 'library evidence is not a new discoverable hook');
+    assert(value.inventory.capabilities.every(c => !c.surfaceIds.includes(invented)), 'no capability declares a fake library surface');
+    const surface = `verify-phase:harness/scripts/verify.mjs:${suiteName}`;
+    assert(discovered.has(surface), 'actual discoverSurfaces reads the registered suite');
+    assert.deepEqual(value.inventory.capabilities.filter(c => c.surfaceIds.includes(surface)).map(c => c.id), ['deterministic-verification']);
+    const corrupted = structuredClone(value.inventory); corrupted.capabilities.find(c => c.id === 'claude-hook-safety').surfaceIds.push(invented);
+    assert(corrupted.capabilities.some(c => c.surfaceIds.some(id => !discovered.has(id))), 'unknown library assignment is not registered evidence');
+  } },
+  { id: 'RGCP004', name: 'wrong source owner, missing module contract and mismatched registered fixture fail independently', run() {
+    const source = fixture(); source.split.declarations.isReadOnlyDiagnosticCommand = 'read-scope';
+    assert.throws(() => assertPlacement(source), /real grammar owner/);
+    const contract = fixture(); contract.map = contract.map.replace(`  - ${grammar}\n`, '');
+    assert.throws(() => assertPlacement(contract), /declared pipeline-core contract/);
+    const registered = fixture(); registered.registry.suites.find(s => s.name === suiteName).file = 'harness/scripts/foreign-placement.test.mjs';
+    assert.throws(() => assertPlacement(registered));
+  } },
+];
+registerTestCaseCompletion({ cases, fd: 3, maxBytes: 32768 });

+# Draft: Item-owned EGM and retained independent quality gates
+
+## Status and date
+
+Proposed, 2026-10-11. The PO selected complete item ownership and the coherent
+batch correction course in the original EGM optimization conversation. This
+draft records that selected direction and its scope, as relayed in the Source
+dispatch; it is a selection paraphrase, not a quoted chat transcript or an
+approval receipt. Include the exact record and Markdown digest in the existing
+aggregate design package. No separate adoption question or ADR terminal
+signature is required. The configured aggregate approval and sanctioned
+materialization remain necessary where applicable. Numbering follows ADR-0069
+at acceptance. This record confers no accepted or live compiler authority.
+
+## Context
+
+ADR-0005 protects against reported completion without tests, retains a
+two-part Definition of Done, and explicitly states that the implementation
+Goldfish never modifies its own tests. Separate test preparation and code
+ownership can split one outcome across contexts and add rediscovery and waits.
+The PO selected one complete independently verifiable outcome per Goldfish.
+That deliberately relaxes separate test authorship while preserving independent
+judgment and honest evidence. Significance axes 1 and 4 apply: role boundaries
+and reliability policy change. Benefits remain hypotheses, not measurements.
+
+## Decision proposed for the common design package
+
+1. One Goldfish owns one complete independently verifiable acceptance criterion
+   or backlog outcome: analysis, test cases, code, targeted checks and fixes
+   remain in one context. It may author new regression tests. Existing acceptance
+   examiners remain intact; necessary changes are visible, justified and
+   independently reviewed. Assertions map to original criteria. Meaningful RED
+   demonstrates the real defect, not fixture/setup failure. Actual receipts bind
+   commands, results and candidate inputs; author claims never award acceptance.
+2. The Elephant schedules nonoverlapping file owners. Colliding/dependent items
+   wait; Main integrates tested deliveries preserving other owners' changes.
+   Do not routinely repeat targeted tests. After a manual merge conflict, run
+   affected checks; drift/missing evidence requires Goldfish requalification.
+   Original owners end after tested delivery and integration.
+3. Predeclare one coherent batch before its items start; freeze membership after
+   integration and before Critic. Every risk tier uses one independent full
+   Critic over code and tests against the original criteria, never one Critic per
+   mini-item. A singleton requires a documented substantial risk rationale.
+4. After findings, one fresh Correction Goldfish owns the whole batch and keeps
+   context across all findings, fixes and delta reviews. The batch budget is one
+   full Critic plus at most three delta Critics, stops immediately on PASS and
+   cannot restart under a new identifier. Exhaustion retains the existing
+   stop/course path; Elephant self-review cannot substitute for independent PASS.
+5. Full Verify qualifies the integrated reviewed candidate once. Failure still
+   requires repair and applicable requalification; no pending result becomes
+   PASS. Tests alone are not acceptance. Semantic completeness remains an
+   independent judgment duty that mechanical enforcement cannot prove alone.
+6. The methodology scope includes Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity, Windows,
+   Linux and macOS, and user repositories. Actual installed native enforcement
+   qualification remains pending per runner/host; source checks or declarations
+   cannot establish universal native PASS. Prior M2/M3 whole-closure report-only
+   decisions remain report-only. No added human gate arises from routine work.
+
+## Supersession and retained obligations
+
+The machine record proposes replacement of ADR-0005, because its absolute
+test-role separation clause contradicts item-owned regression-test authorship.
+The replacement preserves all still-valid ADR-0005 obligations: one calibrated
+Verify entry, Format/Lint/Typecheck/Tests/Build where applicable, machine-written
+candidate-bound evidence, blocking deterministic requirements before final
+acceptance, CI duties, and the two-part deterministic plus independent judgment
+Definition of Done. Existing boundary-aware Verify under ADR-0081 and the
+content-bound review-before-final-Verify course retain their own authority;
+this replacement does not restore an obsolete mandatory full run before review.
+Existing mutation/meta-check and E2E/config mitigation duties remain applicable
+under their project calibration. Coverage thresholds still do not prove quality.
+
+ADR-0003's fresh, independently briefed read-only Critic, assurance/isolation
+boundaries and selected-runner route remain intact. ADR-0014's refs-only input,
+evidence-gated findings, disposition and delta-review lineage remain intact;
+the explicit batch correction budget refines that course. ADR-0080's advisory
+parallel-safety predicate remains intact: disjoint outcomes may run concurrently,
+dependencies and colliders wait, safe commit surfaces remain required, and
+an advisory never forces parallelism. These are compatible additive refinements,
+not whole-record supersessions. Do not mark those three original ADRs superseded.
+Historical ADR files and statuses are not edited by this draft producer.
+
+## Consequences
+
+Fewer handoffs and earlier item completion are intended effects. Removing the
+separate test author loses an independent interpretation of requirements:
+code and tests can share the same blind spot. Original-criterion mappings,
+product-caused RED evidence, preserved examiners and fresh independent review
+mitigate that risk but cannot eliminate it. Record actual item delivery,
+integration/closure and wait times by reason before claiming improvement.
+No invented measurement or performance guarantee is part of this decision.
+
+## Affected contracts
+
+- ADR-0005 quality-gate and test-role clause; retained ADR-0003/0014/0080/0081.
+- docs/operating-model.md, roles/elephant.md, roles/goldfish.md, roles/critic.md,
+  guardrails/quality-gates.md, harness/definition-of-done.md,
+  harness/review-protocol.md and dispatch/review checklists.
+- templates/prompts/goldfish-task.md, templates/prompts/critic-review.md and
+  packaged agents, skills and document mirrors.
+- Common dispatch, test-path admission, METHOD observation, item delivery,
+  review-course and Verify evidence consumers; native runner adapters.
+- README.md, PIPELINE_FLOW.md, PIPELINE_FLOW.de.md, docs/usage.md,
+  docs/parallel-work.md and docs/cost-and-measurement.md.
+
+## Required qualification evidence
+
+Candidate-bound checks must exercise actual admission/record/qualification
+consumers: complete-item ownership, original-criterion and RED evidence,
+new-test permission with protected existing examiners, collider waits,
+integration preservation, unchanged targeted evidence retention, conflict/drift
+requalification, frozen batches, full-plus-three delta budget and stop on PASS,
+same Correction Goldfish continuity, independent review of code and tests,
+and final full qualification. Native qualification needs actual host execution
+for each claimed runner/OS combination. Neither this draft nor fixture-only
+evidence reports completion of those obligations.

+// SPDX-License-Identifier: SUL-1.0
+import { registerTestCaseCompletion } from "./lib/test-case-completion.mjs";
+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";

+const cases = [];
+// Keep the original case callbacks and observed platform skip, and register all
+// siblings through the official recorder before any callback executes.
+function test(name, options, callback) {
+  const run = typeof options === "function" ? options : callback;
+  const mode = typeof options === "object" && options.skip ? "skip" : "run";
+  cases.push({ id: `AGYIC${String(cases.length + 1).padStart(3, "0")}`, name, mode, run });
+}
+
+function fixture(t) {
+  const scratch = resolve("scratch");
+  mkdirSync(scratch, { recursive: true });
+  const root = mkdtempSync(join(scratch, "agy-inline-candidate-"));
+  t.after(() => rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true }));
+  const main = join(root, "main");
+  const candidate = join(root, "candidate");
+  const selected = join(main, "plugins", "pipeline-core");
+  const candidatePlugin = join(candidate, "plugins", "pipeline-core");
+  const configRoot = join(root, "host");
+  const workspaceRoot = join(root, "consumer");
+  const receiptDirectory = join(configRoot, "receipts");
+  mkdirSync(join(selected, "hooks"), { recursive: true });
+  mkdirSync(join(selected, "skills", "critic-review"), { recursive: true });
+  mkdirSync(join(configRoot, "config", "plugins"), { recursive: true });
+  mkdirSync(receiptDirectory);
+  mkdirSync(workspaceRoot);
+  writeFileSync(join(selected, "plugin.json"), '{"name":"agent-pipeline-core","version":"0.7.0","description":"Independent installer fixture"}\n');
+  writeFileSync(join(selected, "hooks.json"), '{"pipeline-core":{"PreInvocation":[{"type":"command","command":"node hooks/antigravity-start-hint.mjs"}]}}\n');
+  for (const path of ["hooks/antigravity-pretool-guard.mjs", "hooks/antigravity-start-hint.mjs", "skills/critic-review/SKILL.md"]) {
+    writeFileSync(join(selected, path), "// fixture baseline\n");
+  }
+  const git = (repo, args) => execFileSync("git", ["-C", repo, ...args], { encoding: "utf8", stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"] }).trim();
+  const commit = (repo) => {
+    git(repo, ["add", "plugins/pipeline-core"]);
+    git(repo, ["-c", "user.name=Fixture", "-c", "user.email=fixture@example.test", "commit", "-m", "fixture"]);
+  };
+  git(main, ["init", "--initial-branch", "main"]);
+  git(main, ["remote", "add", "origin", "https://example.invalid/synthetic-pipeline.git"]);
+  commit(main);
+  git(main, ["worktree", "add", "-b", "installer-candidate", candidate]);
+  const changedFile = "hooks/antigravity-pretool-guard.mjs";
+  writeFileSync(join(candidatePlugin, changedFile), "// fixture approved candidate\n");
+  commit(candidate);
+  // Main remains the user-selected installation path. Its uncommitted bytes
+  // match the clean candidate, so Main's own Git identity cannot attest it.
+  writeFileSync(join(selected, changedFile), readFileSync(join(candidatePlugin, changedFile)));
+  assert.notEqual(git(main, ["status", "--porcelain=v1", "--", "plugins/pipeline-core"]), "");
+  assert.equal(git(candidate, ["status", "--porcelain=v1", "--", "plugins/pipeline-core"]), "");

+}
+
+function hostFiles(root) {
+  const entries = [];
+  const visit = (dir) => {
+    for (const name of readdirSync(dir).sort()) {
+      const path = join(dir, name);
+      const stat = lstatSync(path);
+      if (stat.isDirectory()) { entries.push([relative(root, path), "directory"]); visit(path); }
+      else entries.push([relative(root, path), readFileSync(path).toString("base64")]);
+    }
+  };
+  visit(root);
+  return entries;
+}
+
+function resolveSelected(f) {

+

+

+  const managed = join(f.configRoot, "config", "plugins", "agent-pipeline-core");
+  const cliCalls = [];
+  const receiptInputs = [];
+  const result = installer.refreshAntigravityInstallation({ configRoot: f.configRoot, workspaceRoot: f.workspaceRoot, approvedSourceRoot: f.selected, attestationSourceRoot: resolved.attestationSourceRoot, scope: "global", globalChangeApproved: true }, {

+      if (argv[1] === "install") {
+        cpSync(f.selected, managed, { recursive: true });

+      } else assert.equal(argv[1], "validate");
+      return { status: "ok" };
+    },
+    writeInstalledReceipt(input) {
+      receiptInputs.push(input);

+    },

+  assert.equal(result.status, "refreshed", JSON.stringify(result));

+  assert.equal(observeAntigravityPluginTopology({ configRoot: f.configRoot, workspaceRoot: f.workspaceRoot, approvedSourceRoot: f.selected }).registries.global.entries[0].root, f.selected);
+  const receipts = readdirSync(f.receiptDirectory).filter((name) => name.endsWith(".json") && !name.endsWith(".source.json"));
+  assert.equal(receipts.length, 1);
+  assert.equal(JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(f.receiptDirectory, receipts[0]), "utf8")).source.commit, resolved.candidate.commit);
+  assert.equal(existsSync(join(f.workspaceRoot, ".git")), false);

+
+test("Agy selected hardlinked files report the physical alias before candidate discovery or host writes", (t) => {
+  const f = fixture(t);
+  linkSync(join(f.selected, f.changedFile), join(f.root, "selected-file-alias"));
+  assert.equal(lstatSync(join(f.selected, f.changedFile)).nlink, 2);
+  const before = hostFiles(f.configRoot);

+  const checked = installer.verifyAntigravityInstallerSource({ configRoot: f.configRoot, workspaceRoot: f.workspaceRoot, sourcePluginRoot: f.selected, attestationSourceRoot: f.candidatePlugin, scope: "global" });

+  assert.deepEqual(checked.reasonCodes, ["SNT-A2-PLUGIN-NONREGULAR"]);

+    runCli() { assert.fail("aliased selected source must refuse before any CLI call"); },

+  assert.equal(result.reason, "ATR-SOURCE-PHYSICAL-UNAVAILABLE");

+for (const [kind, expectedCode, invalidate] of [
+  ["stale committed content", "SNT-A2-CONTENT-MISMATCH", (f) => { writeFileSync(join(f.candidatePlugin, f.changedFile), "// stale candidate\n"); f.commit(f.candidate); }],
+  ["mismatched manifest", "SNT-A2-MANIFEST-MISMATCH", (f) => { const path = join(f.candidatePlugin, "plugin.json"); const value = JSON.parse(readFileSync(path, "utf8")); value.version = "0.7.1"; writeFileSync(path, JSON.stringify(value) + "\n"); f.commit(f.candidate); }],

+
+registerTestCaseCompletion({ cases, fd: 3, maxBytes: 8192 });

+// SPDX-License-Identifier: SUL-1.0
+// Administrative provenance describes changed content, never delegated authorship.
+import { tokenizeArgv } from "./git-cmd.mjs";
+import { resolve } from "node:path";
+import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
+import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
+import { parseCommitTrailerBlock } from "./commit-message-policy.mjs";
+import { parseBacklogItem, parseTransitionLedger, projectBacklog, transitionHash, validateTransitionShape } from "./backlog-state.mjs";
+
+export const ADMINISTRATIVE_DISPATCH = "administrative (elephant)";
+const SHA = (value) => createHash("sha256").update(value).digest("hex");
+export function hasAdministrativeDispatch(message) {
+  return parseCommitTrailerBlock(message).some((entry) => entry.key === "Dispatch" && entry.value === ADMINISTRATIVE_DISPATCH);
+}
+export function isAdministrativePath(path) {
+  if (typeof path !== "string" || !path || path.split("/").some((part) => !part || part === "." || part === "..") || /[\\\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/u.test(path)) return false;
+  return /^backlog\/items\/[^/]+\.md$/u.test(path) && path !== "backlog/items/TEMPLATE.md"
+    || ["backlog/transitions.ndjson", "backlog/STATUS.md", "backlog/index.json"].includes(path)
+    || /^specs\/(?:[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\/)+(?:prd|spec|design|sdp|plan|acceptance|readiness)(?:_[A-Za-z0-9._-]+)?\.md$/u.test(path) && !path.split("/").includes("evidence");
+}
+// Pure view seam for deterministic tests. The production inspector obtains every
+// path/blob from Git itself; no caller-supplied view is used by hooks or readers.
+export function validateAdministrativeCommitView({message, paths, contents, items = [], ledger = null}) {
+  const trailers = parseCommitTrailerBlock(message);
+  if (trailers.length !== 2 || trailers[0].key !== "Dispatch" || trailers[0].value !== ADMINISTRATIVE_DISPATCH || trailers[1].key !== "AI-Assisted" || trailers[1].value !== "true") return {ok:false,code:"GIT-03-ADMINISTRATIVE-TRAILER"};
+  if (!Array.isArray(paths) || !paths.length || new Set(paths).size !== paths.length || !paths.every(isAdministrativePath)) return {ok:false,code:"GIT-03-ADMINISTRATIVE-PATHS"};

+// SPDX-License-Identifier: SUL-1.0
+import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
+import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
+import { readFileSync, realpathSync, lstatSync, openSync, closeSync, fstatSync, constants } from 'node:fs';
+import { resolve, relative, sep } from 'node:path';
+import { inspectSignedDescriptorCustodyRepository } from './worktree-lifecycle.mjs';
+import { inspectGovernedItemDeliveryChecks } from './native-goldfish-host-state.mjs';
+import { scopesOverlap } from './slice-queue.mjs';
+
+const held = new WeakMap();
+const digest = bytes => createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex');
+const equal = (a,b) => JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b);
+const fault = code => { throw Object.assign(new Error(code), {code}); };
+function git(root,args) {
+  return execFileSync('git', ['-C',root,...args], {encoding:'utf8',shell:false,timeout:10000,maxBuffer:4*1024*1024,
+    env:{...process.env,GIT_DIR:undefined,GIT_WORK_TREE:undefined,GIT_COMMON_DIR:undefined,GIT_INDEX_FILE:undefined}}).trim();
+}
+function gitBytes(root,args){return execFileSync('git',['-C',root,...args],{shell:false,timeout:10000,maxBuffer:4*1024*1024,
+  env:{...process.env,GIT_DIR:undefined,GIT_WORK_TREE:undefined,GIT_COMMON_DIR:undefined,GIT_INDEX_FILE:undefined}});}
+function filesAt(root, candidate, files) {
+  return files.map(file => {
+    const path=resolve(root,file.path),rel=relative(root,path),stat=lstatSync(path);
+    if(rel==='..'||rel.startsWith(`..${sep}`)||stat.isSymbolicLink()||!stat.isFile()||stat.size>4*1024*1024||realpathSync(path)!==path)fault('AGY-ITEM-CHECK-PATH');
+    const fd=openSync(path,constants.O_RDONLY|(constants.O_NOFOLLOW??0));let bytes;
+    try {const opened=fstatSync(fd);bytes=readFileSync(fd);const after=fstatSync(fd),current=lstatSync(path);
+      for(const key of ['dev','ino','size','mtimeMs','ctimeMs'])if(opened[key]!==stat[key]||after[key]!==opened[key]||current[key]!==opened[key])fault('AGY-ITEM-CHECK-DEPENDENCY-DRIFT');
+    }finally{closeSync(fd);}
+    const committed=execFileSync('git',['-C',root,'show',`${candidate.commit}:${file.path}`],{shell:false,timeout:10000,maxBuffer:4*1024*1024,
+      env:{...process.env,GIT_DIR:undefined,GIT_WORK_TREE:undefined,GIT_COMMON_DIR:undefined,GIT_INDEX_FILE:undefined}});
+    if(!bytes.equals(committed)||digest(bytes)!==file.sha256||bytes.length!==file.size)fault('AGY-ITEM-CHECK-DEPENDENCY-DRIFT');
+    return file;
+  });
+}
+/** Only an actual common check observation can mint this local delivery handle.
+ * It is evidence, never a Source member or a release capability. */
+export function bindAgyItemDeliveryChecks({root,itemDelivery,candidate,checkHandle,baseCommit,writeScope,changedPaths}) {
+  const evidence=inspectGovernedItemDeliveryChecks({root,itemDelivery,candidate,handle:checkHandle});
+  if(evidence.verdict!=='passed')fault('AGY-ITEM-TARGETED-CHECKS-FAILED');
+  if(!Array.isArray(changedPaths)||!changedPaths.length||changedPaths.some(path=>!writeScope.some(scope=>scopesOverlap([scope],[path]))))fault('AGY-ITEM-DELIVERY-SCOPE');
+  git(root,['merge-base','--is-ancestor',baseCommit,candidate.commit]);
+  const actual=git(root,['diff','--name-only','-z',baseCommit,candidate.commit]).split('\0').filter(Boolean).sort();
+  if(!equal(actual,[...changedPaths].sort()))fault('AGY-ITEM-DELIVERY-PATHS');
+  const paths=actual.map(path=>({path,sha256:digest(gitBytes(root,['show',`${candidate.commit}:${path}`]))}));
+  const value={schema:'pipeline.agy-item-delivery.v1',itemId:itemDelivery.itemId,sliceId:itemDelivery.sliceId,baseCommit,candidate,evidence,paths};
+  const handle=Object.freeze({});held.set(handle,{root:realpathSync(root),value});
+  return {handle,value:structuredClone(value)};
+}
+/** Read Main itself, ancestry, committed dependency bytes and delivered blobs.
+ * The Source journal owner must still perform the release under its boundary. */
+export function inspectAgyItemMainIntegration({root,handle}) {
+  const row=held.get(handle);if(!row||realpathSync(root)!==row.root)fault('AGY-ITEM-DELIVERY-HANDLE');
+  return inspectAgyItemMainIntegrationValue({root,value:row.value});
+}
+/** Read-only proof builder for a value independently recovered from the Source
+ * journal. It grants no reservation, terminal handle or release authority. */
+export function inspectAgyItemMainIntegrationValue({root,value}) {
+  if(value?.schema!=='pipeline.agy-item-delivery.v1'||value.evidence?.schema!=='pipeline.item-targeted-checks.v1'||value.evidence.verdict!=='passed'||!value.evidence.results?.length
+    ||value.evidence.results.some(row=>row.status!==0||row.signal||row.error)||!value.paths?.length)fault('AGY-ITEM-DELIVERY-EVIDENCE');
+  const repository=inspectSignedDescriptorCustodyRepository(root);
+  git(root,['merge-base','--is-ancestor',value.baseCommit,value.candidate.commit]);
+  const initial=git(root,['diff','--name-only','-z',value.baseCommit,value.candidate.commit]).split('\0').filter(Boolean).sort();
+  if(!equal(initial,value.paths.map(file=>file.path).sort()))fault('AGY-ITEM-DELIVERY-PATHS');
+  const branch=git(root,['symbolic-ref','--short','HEAD']);
+  if(!['main','Main'].includes(branch))fault('AGY-ITEM-MAIN-REQUIRED');
+  git(root,['merge-base','--is-ancestor',value.candidate.commit,repository.candidate.commit]);
+  filesAt(root,repository.candidate,value.evidence.files);
+  for(const file of value.paths) {
+    const bytes=gitBytes(root,['show',`${repository.candidate.commit}:${file.path}`]);
+    if(digest(bytes)!==file.sha256)fault('AGY-ITEM-DELIVERED-PATH-DRIFT');
+  }
+  if(!equal(repository,inspectSignedDescriptorCustodyRepository(root)))fault('AGY-ITEM-INTEGRATION-CAS');
+  return {schema:'pipeline.agy-item-main-integration.v1',repository,delivery:structuredClone(value),mainCommit:repository.candidate.commit};
+}

+// SPDX-License-Identifier: SUL-1.0
+/** Pure prospective content validation. It grants no approval or write authority. */
+import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
+import { canonicalizeJson, parseStrictJson } from './governance-event.mjs';
+import { validateArchitectureDecisionSidecar } from './architecture-effective-decisions.mjs';
+export const PROSPECTIVE_ARCHITECTURE_SCHEMA = 'pipeline.architecture-prospective-materialization.v1';
+const hash = value => createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');
+const json = value => `${JSON.stringify(value, null, 2)}\n`;
+const own = (value, keys) => value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)
+  && Object.keys(value).sort().join('\0') === [...keys].sort().join('\0');
+const pathOK = value => typeof value === 'string' && value.length <= 240
+  && /^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._/-]*$/u.test(value)
+  && value.split('/').every(part => part && !part.startsWith('.'));
+const refOK = value => own(value, ['path', 'sha256']) && pathOK(value.path) && /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/u.test(value.sha256);
+function need(value, code) { if (!value) throw new Error(`DDB-PROSPECTIVE-${code}`); }
+
+/** All inputs, including the manifest, must be explicit signed Source companions.
+ * The reader supplies its normal physical custody checks; this function never
+ * accepts a synthetic authority handle or reads an optional caller location. */
+export function inspectProspectiveArchitectureManifest({ manifest, sources, read, existing }) {
+  need(refOK(manifest) && sources.companions.some(ref => ref.path === manifest.path && ref.sha256 === manifest.sha256), 'COMPANION-REQUIRED');
+  const files = [], paths = new Set(), targets = [], decisions = [];
+  const get = ref => {
+    need(refOK(ref) && sources.companions.some(source => source.path === ref.path && source.sha256 === ref.sha256), 'INPUT-COMPANION-REQUIRED');
+    const file = read(ref.path); need(file.sha256 === ref.sha256, 'INPUT-DRIFT'); files.push(file); return file;
+  };
+  const manifestFile = get(manifest), value = parseStrictJson(manifestFile.bytes);
+  need(own(value, ['schema', 'decisions']) && value.schema === PROSPECTIVE_ARCHITECTURE_SCHEMA
+    && Array.isArray(value.decisions) && value.decisions.length > 0 && value.decisions.length <= 16, 'MANIFEST-SHAPE');
+  const add = (path, bytes, sha256) => {
+    need(pathOK(path) && !paths.has(path.toLowerCase()) && !sources.companions.some(ref => ref.path.toLowerCase() === path.toLowerCase())
+      && path !== sources.prd.path && path !== sources.spec.path, 'TARGET-COLLISION');
+    need(hash(bytes) === sha256, 'TARGET-DIGEST'); paths.add(path.toLowerCase());
+    const present = existing(path);
+    need(!present || present.bytes.equals(Buffer.from(bytes)), 'TARGET-DRIFT');
+    targets.push({ path, bytes, sha256, present: !!present });
+    return { path, sha256 };
+  };
+  const ids = [];
+  for (const row of value.decisions) {
+    need(own(row, ['id', 'proposedMarkdown', 'proposedSidecar', 'chatSelection', 'predecessor', 'outputs'])
+      && /^\d{4}-[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$/u.test(row.id), 'ROW-SHAPE');
+    ids.push(row.id);
+    const markdown = get(row.proposedMarkdown), sidecar = get(row.proposedSidecar), selection = get(row.chatSelection);
+    const proposed = parseStrictJson(sidecar.bytes), choice = parseStrictJson(selection.bytes);
+    need(row.proposedMarkdown.path.startsWith('docs/adr/draft-') && row.proposedSidecar.path === row.proposedMarkdown.path.slice(0, -3) + '.json'
+      && validateArchitectureDecisionSidecar(proposed) && proposed.status === 'proposed' && !proposed.exception
+      && proposed.id === row.proposedMarkdown.path.slice('docs/adr/'.length, -3)
+      && proposed.id.startsWith('draft-') && proposed.digest === markdown.sha256, 'PROPOSAL-INVALID');
+    need(own(choice, ['schema', 'id', 'decision', 'markdownSha256', 'sidecarSha256', 'scope', 'moduleIds', 'supersedes', 'attributedTo', 'origin', 'selections'])
+      && choice.schema === 'pipeline.architecture-prospective-chat-selection.v1' && choice.id === proposed.id && choice.decision === 'selected'
+      && choice.markdownSha256 === markdown.sha256 && choice.sidecarSha256 === sidecar.sha256
+      && choice.scope === proposed.scope && canonicalizeJson(choice.moduleIds) === canonicalizeJson(proposed.moduleIds ?? [])
+      && choice.supersedes === (proposed.supersedes ?? null) && typeof choice.attributedTo === 'string'
+      && choice.attributedTo.trim() && choice.attributedTo.length <= 160 && !/[\r\n\0]/u.test(choice.attributedTo), 'SELECTION-INVALID');
+    const origin = parseStrictJson(get(choice.origin).bytes);
+    need(Array.isArray(choice.selections) && choice.selections.length > 0 && choice.selections.length <= 64
+      && Array.isArray(origin.selections) && choice.selections.every(item => own(item, ['topic', 'text'])
+        && typeof item.topic === 'string' && typeof item.text === 'string' && item.text.trim()
+        && origin.selections.some(original => original.topic === item.topic && original.text === item.text)), 'SELECTION-ORIGIN-DRIFT');
+    const acceptedMarkdown = `# ADR-${row.id}: ${proposed.title}\n\nAccepted through the canonical aggregate design approval.\n\n## Approved proposal, preserved verbatim\n\n${markdown.text}`;
+    const acceptedSidecar = { ...proposed, id: row.id, status: 'accepted', digest: hash(acceptedMarkdown) };
+    need(validateArchitectureDecisionSidecar(acceptedSidecar), 'POSTIMAGE-INVALID');
+    const { origin: _origin, selections: _selections, ...selected } = choice;
+    const acceptedChoice = { ...selected, schema: 'pipeline.design-decision-chat-selection.v1', id: row.id, decision: 'accepted', markdownSha256: hash(acceptedMarkdown), sidecarSha256: hash(json(acceptedSidecar)) };
+    need(own(row.outputs, ['markdown', 'sidecar', 'chatSelection']) && Object.values(row.outputs).every(refOK)
+      && row.outputs.markdown.path === `docs/adr/${row.id}.md` && row.outputs.sidecar.path === `docs/adr/${row.id}.json`
+      && row.outputs.chatSelection.path === `project/architecture-chat-selections/${row.id}.json`, 'OUTPUT-SHAPE');
+    const entry = { id: row.id, markdown: add(row.outputs.markdown.path, acceptedMarkdown, row.outputs.markdown.sha256),
+      sidecar: add(row.outputs.sidecar.path, json(acceptedSidecar), row.outputs.sidecar.sha256),
+      chatSelection: add(row.outputs.chatSelection.path, json(acceptedChoice), row.outputs.chatSelection.sha256) };
+    if (proposed.supersedes) {
+      need(own(row.predecessor, ['markdown', 'sidecar']) && refOK(row.predecessor.markdown) && refOK(row.predecessor.sidecar)
+        && row.predecessor.markdown.path === `docs/adr/${proposed.supersedes}.md`
+        && row.predecessor.sidecar.path === `docs/adr/${proposed.supersedes}.json`, 'PREDECESSOR-SHAPE');
+      const historic = get(row.predecessor.markdown);
+      need(historic.text.startsWith(`# ADR-${proposed.supersedes.slice(0,4)}:`), 'PREDECESSOR-TITLE');
+      const record = { schema: 'pipeline.architecture-decision.v1', id: proposed.supersedes,
+        title: historic.text.split('\n')[0].replace(/^# ADR-\d+: /u, ''), status: 'superseded', digest: historic.sha256,
+        scope: proposed.scope, date: proposed.date };
+      need(validateArchitectureDecisionSidecar(record) && record.scope !== 'module', 'PREDECESSOR-INVALID');
+      add(row.predecessor.sidecar.path, json(record), row.predecessor.sidecar.sha256);
+    } else need(row.predecessor === null, 'PREDECESSOR-UNEXPECTED');
+    decisions.push({ entry, record: acceptedSidecar });
+  }
+  need(ids.join('\0') === [...new Set(ids)].sort().join('\0'), 'ORDER');
+  return { files, targets, decisions, materialized: targets.every(target => target.present) };
+}

+// SPDX-License-Identifier: SUL-1.0
+// Transport fidelity only. A caller's binding is not approval verification.
+import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
+
+export const REQUEST_SCHEMA = 'pipeline.bound-artifact-transfer-request.v1';
+export const BUNDLE_SCHEMA = 'pipeline.bound-artifact-transfer.v1';
+export const MAX_ARTIFACT_BYTES = 1024 * 1024;
+export const MAX_TOTAL_BYTES = 8 * MAX_ARTIFACT_BYTES;
+const sha = (bytes) => createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex');
+const object = (value) => value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value);
+const exact = (value, keys) => object(value) && Object.keys(value).sort().join('|') === [...keys].sort().join('|');

+const id = (value) => typeof value === 'string' && /^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$/u.test(value);
+const screenedArtifacts = new WeakMap();
+
+export function transferSourcePath(value) {
+  if (typeof value !== 'string' || value.length > 240 || !/^[a-zA-Z0-9_./-]+$/u.test(value)) return false;
+  const parts = value.split('/');
+  if (parts.some((part) => !part || part === '.' || part === '..' || part.startsWith('.'))) return false;
+  // This route is for declared public evidence/documents; never sessions or key stores.
+  if (!['evidence', 'specs', 'docs', 'backlog'].includes(parts[0])) return false;
+  return !parts.some((part) => /(?:session|transcript|credential|secret|private|key)/iu.test(part))
+    && /\.(?:json|md|txt)$/u.test(value);
+}
+
+export function validateTransferRequest(request) {
+  if (!exact(request, ['schema', 'artifacts']) || request.schema !== REQUEST_SCHEMA
+    || !Array.isArray(request.artifacts) || request.artifacts.length < 1 || request.artifacts.length > 64) return false;
+  const seen = new Set();
+  return request.artifacts.every((entry) => {
+    if (!exact(entry, ['id', 'sourcePath', 'classification', 'binding']) || !id(entry.id) || seen.has(entry.id)
+      || !['public', 'private', 'unknown'].includes(entry.classification)
+      || !exact(entry.binding, ['kind', 'sha256']) || !['state', 'approval', 'gate-receipt'].includes(entry.binding.kind)
+      || !digest(entry.binding.sha256)) return false;
+    // A private/unknown reference is never consumed or echoed. It can be an origin-only locator.
+    if (typeof entry.sourcePath !== 'string' || entry.sourcePath.length < 1 || entry.sourcePath.length > 4096) return false;
+    seen.add(entry.id);
+    return true;
+  });
+}
+
+// A refusal screen, not a redactor: it cannot silently alter any bound bytes.
+// Drive-letter matches require an actual slash after ':' and cannot span a newline.
+// POSIX matches require the real home prefixes, not fragments such as `ly:\n-`.
+export function hasPrivateTransferContent(bytes) {
+  if (!Buffer.isBuffer(bytes) || bytes.length > MAX_ARTIFACT_BYTES) return true;
+  const text = bytes.toString('utf8');

+  return /(?:^|[^A-Za-z0-9])[A-Za-z]:[\\/][^\s"'<>]*|(?:^|[^A-Za-z0-9])(?:\/home\/|\/Users\/|~\/)[^\s"'<>]+|\\\\[^\s\\/]+[\\/][^\s]+/u.test(text)

+    || /-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----|\b(?:sk-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{16,}|AKIA[A-Z0-9]{16})\b/iu.test(text)
+    || /(?:password|passwd|api[_-]?key|access[_-]?token|authorization|credential|secret)\s*["']?\s*[:=]\s*["']?[^\s"',}\]]+/iu.test(text)
+    || /["'](?:messages|transcript|rawSession|session_id|sessionId|prompt)["']\s*:/iu.test(text);
+}
+
+// In-process source-owned screening witness. A shape clone or `screened:true`
+// cannot stand in for the exact byte snapshot this producer inspected.
+export function screenPublicTransferArtifact(bytes) {
+  if (!Buffer.isBuffer(bytes) || bytes.length > MAX_ARTIFACT_BYTES) return { status: 'held', code: 'BT-PRIVACY' };
+  const snapshot = Buffer.from(bytes);
+  if (hasPrivateTransferContent(snapshot)) return { status: 'held', code: 'BT-PRIVACY' };
+  const handle = Object.freeze({ schema: 'pipeline.transfer-screened-artifact.v1',
+    sha256: sha(snapshot), byteLength: snapshot.length });
+  screenedArtifacts.set(handle, snapshot);
+  return { status: 'screened', handle };
+}
+
+export function readScreenedTransferArtifact(handle, expectedSha256) {
+  if (!object(handle) || !digest(expectedSha256)) return null;
+  const snapshot = screenedArtifacts.get(handle);
+  if (!snapshot || handle.sha256 !== expectedSha256 || sha(snapshot) !== expectedSha256) return null;
+  return Buffer.from(snapshot);
+}
+
+function held(entry, code, actualSha256 = null) {
+  return { id: entry.id, classification: entry.classification, bindingKind: entry.binding.kind,
+    expectedSha256: entry.binding.sha256, actualSha256, status: 'held', code,
+    recovery: 'must be copied from the origin device' };
+}
+
+/** readArtifact is invoked only for a safe, explicitly public reference.
+ * Returns a separate public projection and byte-exact transport payloads.
+ * Never returns sourcePath, input text, or exception text in the projection.
+ */
+export function prepareBoundArtifactTransfer(request, readArtifact) {
+  if (!validateTransferRequest(request) || typeof readArtifact !== 'function') {
+    return { schema: BUNDLE_SCHEMA, status: 'refused', code: 'BT-REQUEST', publicProjection: null, payloads: [] };
+  }
+  let total = 0;
+  const entries = [];
+  const payloads = [];
+  for (const entry of request.artifacts) {
+    if (entry.classification !== 'public') {
+      entries.push(held(entry, entry.classification === 'private' ? 'BT-PRIVATE' : 'BT-CLASSIFICATION-UNKNOWN'));
+      continue;
+    }
+    if (!transferSourcePath(entry.sourcePath)) { entries.push(held(entry, 'BT-SOURCE-PATH')); continue; }
+    let bytes;
+    try { bytes = readArtifact(entry.sourcePath, MAX_ARTIFACT_BYTES); } catch { entries.push(held(entry, 'BT-SOURCE-UNAVAILABLE')); continue; }
+    if (!Buffer.isBuffer(bytes) || bytes.length > MAX_ARTIFACT_BYTES) { entries.push(held(entry, 'BT-BYTE-LIMIT')); continue; }
+    bytes = Buffer.from(bytes);
+    const actualSha256 = sha(bytes);
+    if (actualSha256 !== entry.binding.sha256) { entries.push(held(entry, 'BT-DIGEST-MISMATCH', actualSha256)); continue; }
+    const screened = screenPublicTransferArtifact(bytes);
+    if (screened.status !== 'screened') { entries.push(held(entry, 'BT-PRIVACY')); continue; }
+    if (total + bytes.length > MAX_TOTAL_BYTES) { entries.push(held(entry, 'BT-TOTAL-LIMIT')); continue; }
+    total += bytes.length;
+    entries.push({ id: entry.id, classification: 'public', bindingKind: entry.binding.kind,
+      expectedSha256: entry.binding.sha256, actualSha256, bytes: bytes.length,
+      status: 'carried-byte-exact', code: null, recovery: null });
+    payloads.push({ id: entry.id, sha256: actualSha256, bytes: readScreenedTransferArtifact(screened.handle, actualSha256) });
+  }
+  const publicProjection = { schema: 'pipeline.bound-artifact-transfer-public.v1',
+    authority: 'transport-fidelity-only', status: entries.some((entry) => entry.status === 'held') ? 'held' : 'ready', entries };
+  return { schema: BUNDLE_SCHEMA, status: publicProjection.status, code: null,
+    publicProjection, payloads, publicProjectionSha256: sha(Buffer.from(JSON.stringify(publicProjection) + '\n')) };
+}
+
+export function verifyTransferredArtifact(bytes, expectedSha256) {
+  return Buffer.isBuffer(bytes) && digest(expectedSha256) && sha(bytes) === expectedSha256;
+}

+function chain(anchor, target) {

+  for (const part of ["", ...suffix.split(sep).filter(Boolean)]) {

+    const info = lstatSync(cursor);

+  }
+}
+

+    if (!same(identity(before), identity(fstatSync(fd)))) fail("CVCT-CAS");

+
+function approval(repo) {

+function twinAt(repo, path, revision) {

+}
+
+// Select only actual committed and physically present tiers. An omitted legacy
+// peer must be absent in HEAD, index and the physical layout on every recheck.
+function committedCalibrationPaths(repo) {
+  const paths = [];
+  for (const path of PATHS) {
+    const tracked = repo.git(["ls-tree", "-z", "HEAD", "--", path]).length !== 0;
+    let present = false;
+    let cursor = repo.root;
+    const parts = path.split("/");
+    for (let i = 0; i < parts.length; i++) {
+      cursor = join(cursor, parts[i]);

+      try { info = lstatSync(cursor); }

+        if (!info.isDirectory()) fail("CVCT-CALIBRATION");
+      } else {
+        if (!info.isFile() || info.nlink !== 1) fail("CVCT-CALIBRATION");
+        present = true;
+      }
+    }
+    if (tracked !== present || (!tracked && repo.git(["ls-files", "--stage", "-z", "--", path]).length !== 0)) fail("CVCT-CALIBRATION");
+    if (tracked) paths.push(path);
+  }
+  if (paths[0] !== PATHS[0]) fail("CVCT-CALIBRATION");
+  return paths;
+}
+
+export function inspectCommittedCalibrationVerifyLayout({ rootDir } = {}) {
+  try {
+    const repo = repository(rootDir);

+    if (entries.length === 2 && !same(entries[0].value, entries[1].value)) fail("CVCT-TWIN-CAS");
+    for (const entry of entries) {
+      const file = readBounded(repo.root, join(repo.root, entry.path));
+      if (file.sha256 !== entry.sha256 || (file.mode & 0o111 ? "100755" : "100644") !== entry.gitMode) fail("CVCT-TWIN-CAS");
+    }

+    if (finalRepo.head !== repo.head || finalRepo.tree !== repo.tree || !same(committedCalibrationPaths(finalRepo), paths)) fail("CVCT-CAS");

+    return status === "configured" ? { status, command: entries[0].value.verify, paths } : { status, paths };
+  } catch (error) { return { status: "unavailable", code: unavailable(error).code }; }
+}
+
+function transition(repo, currentApproval, command) {
+  if (classifyVerifyCommand(command) !== "configured" || typeof command !== "string" || Buffer.byteLength(command) > 32_768 || /[\r\n\0]/u.test(command)) fail("CVCT-COMMAND");

+export function completeCalibrationVerifyCommitTransition({ preparedHandle } = {}) {
+  const held = preparedHandle && HELD.get(preparedHandle);

+  HELD.delete(preparedHandle);

+    currentFiles(repo, facts, true);

+  } catch (error) {

+  }

+export function inspectCalibrationVerifyCommitTransition({ rootDir, stagedPaths } = {}) {
+  try {
+    const repo = repository(rootDir);
+    const actual = repo.git(["diff", "--cached", "--name-only", "-z", "HEAD"]).toString("utf8").split("\0").filter(Boolean);
+    const paths = committedCalibrationPaths(repo);
+    if (!same([...actual].sort(), [...paths].sort()) || !Array.isArray(stagedPaths)
+      || !same([...stagedPaths].sort(), [...actual].sort())) fail("CVCT-STAGED-SET");
+    const after = paths.map((path) => twinAt(repo, path, ""));
+    if (after.length === 2 && !same(after[0].value, after[1].value)) fail("CVCT-TWIN-CAS");
+    const facts = transition(repo, approval(repo), after[0].value.verify);
+    for (const entry of facts.entries) {
+      const staged = after.find((value) => value.path === entry.path);
+      if (staged.sha256 !== entry.afterSha256 || staged.gitMode !== entry.gitMode) fail("CVCT-STAGED-CAS");
+    }
+    chain(repo.common, repo.directory);
+    if (existsSync(join(repo.directory, "transition.lock"))) fail("CVCT-INCOMPLETE");
+    if (!same(readRecord(repo, recordPath(repo, facts.id, "ready")), { schema: SCHEMA, phase: "ready", facts })) fail("CVCT-RECORD");

+      || !same(finalRepo.git(["diff", "--cached", "--name-only", "-z", "HEAD"]).toString("utf8").split("\0").filter(Boolean), actual)) fail("CVCT-CAS");
+    for (const entry of facts.entries) {
+      const staged = twinAt(finalRepo, entry.path, "");
+      if (staged.sha256 !== entry.afterSha256 || staged.gitMode !== entry.gitMode) fail("CVCT-STAGED-CAS");
+    }
+    return { ok: true, code: "CVCT-COMMIT-READY", paths: facts.entries.map((entry) => entry.path) };
+  } catch (error) { return unavailable(error); }
+}

+// SPDX-License-Identifier: SUL-1.0
+import { DISPATCH_RECORD_SCHEMA, PREVIOUS_DISPATCH_RECORD_SCHEMA, LEGACY_DISPATCH_RECORD_SCHEMA,
+  validateDispatchRecord, validatePreviousDispatchRecord, validateLegacyDispatchRecord,
+  isTerminalOutcome, isNoDeliveryOutcome } from "./dispatch-record.mjs";
+import { parseIntegrationTrailerBlock, parseCommitTrailerBlock } from "./commit-message-policy.mjs";
+import { criticDecisionPathFinding, criticDisposition, classifyCriticChangedPaths } from "./critic-skip-decision.mjs";
+import { inspectReportRange, readReportCandidateFile, reportBytesSha256, reportCandidateIdentity,
+  reportCandidateInventory, readReportCommitPaths, readReportCommitMessage } from "./report-source-readers.mjs";
+
+export const CANDIDATE_COVERAGE_REPORT_SCHEMA = "pipeline.candidate-implementation-coverage-report.v1";
+function unavailable(code) { return { state: "unavailable", code }; }
+
+/** Reverse inventory is diagnostic only; never an enrollment/completion decision. */
+export function reportCandidateImplementationCoverage(handle, { baseCommit } = {}) {
+  const candidate = reportCandidateIdentity(handle);
+  const report = { schema: CANDIDATE_COVERAGE_REPORT_SCHEMA, reportOnly: true, candidate,
+    completionEffect: "none", baseline: unavailable("REPORT-BASE-NOT-SUPPLIED"), comparison: null,
+    records: [], commits: [], pathMappings: [], findings: [] };
+  if (baseCommit === undefined) return { ...report, state: "unknown" };
+  let range;
+  try { range = inspectReportRange(handle, { baseCommit }); }
+  catch (error) { return { ...report, state: "unknown", baseline: unavailable(error.code ?? "REPORT-RANGE-UNAVAILABLE") }; }

+  report.comparison = { baseCommit, source: range.comparisonSource, changedPaths: range.changedPaths,
+    commitCount: range.commits.length, trueEmptyRange: range.commits.length === 0 && range.changedPaths.length === 0,
+    netEmptyChanges: range.changedPaths.length === 0,
+    zeroApplicableRowsIsCoverage: false };
+  const inventory = reportCandidateInventory(handle);
+  const paths = [...inventory.keys()].filter(path => /^evidence\/dispatch-record-[A-Za-z0-9._:-]+\.json$/u.test(path)).sort();
+  if (paths.length > 512) return { ...report, state: "unknown", findings: [{ code: "REPORT-DISPATCH-BOUND" }] };

+    let record, bytes;
+    try {
+      bytes = readReportCandidateFile(handle, path); record = JSON.parse(bytes.toString("utf8"));
+      if (record.schema === DISPATCH_RECORD_SCHEMA) validateDispatchRecord(record);
+      else if (record.schema === PREVIOUS_DISPATCH_RECORD_SCHEMA) validatePreviousDispatchRecord(record);
+      else if (record.schema === LEGACY_DISPATCH_RECORD_SCHEMA) validateLegacyDispatchRecord(record);
+      else throw Error("unsupported");
+    } catch {
+      report.records.push({ path, state: "unknown", code: "REPORT-DISPATCH-INVALID" }); continue;
+    }
+    const commits = Array.isArray(record.commits) ? record.commits : [];
+    const mapped = commits.filter(commit => range.commits.includes(commit));
+    const delivery = record.schema === DISPATCH_RECORD_SCHEMA ? record.outcomeClassification?.kind
+      : isTerminalOutcome(record.outcome) && !isNoDeliveryOutcome(record.outcome) && commits.length > 0 ? "legacy-authored-unverified" : "non-authoring";
+    const applicable = mapped.length > 0 && commits.length === mapped.length
+      && mapped.includes(record.candidateCommit)
+      && ["authored-commit", "legacy-authored-unverified"].includes(delivery)
+      && isTerminalOutcome(record.outcome) && !isNoDeliveryOutcome(record.outcome);
+    const row = { path, sha256: reportBytesSha256(bytes), taskId: record.taskId,
+      sourceCandidateCommit: record.candidateCommit ?? null, delivery: delivery ?? "unknown",
+      commits: mapped, mapping: applicable ? "candidate-range-structural-match" : "not-applicable",
+      admission: unavailable("REPORT-AUTHENTIC-ADMISSION-NOT-PROVED"), review: unavailable("REPORT-BOUND-REVIEW-NOT-PROVED") };
+    // Import/integration commits can be mapped, but never labelled worker authorship.
+    row.authorship = delivery === "authored-commit" ? "declared-native-authorship-unverified"
+      : "unknown";
+    if (applicable && criticDisposition(record) === "skipped") {
+      try {
+        const actual = [...new Set(commits.flatMap(commit => readReportCommitPaths(handle, commit)))].sort();
+        const finding = criticDecisionPathFinding(record.criticSkip, actual);
+        row.review = finding ? { state: "invalid", code: finding.code }
+          : { state: "existing-exemption-path-checked", appliedRow: record.criticSkip.appliedRow,
+            authority: "existing-validated-dispatch-decision", actualChangedPaths: actual };
+      } catch { row.review = unavailable("REPORT-EXEMPTION-PATHS-UNAVAILABLE"); }
+    }
+    report.records.push(row);
+  }
+  report.commits = range.perCommit.map(unit => {
+    const matches = report.records.filter(row => row.mapping === "candidate-range-structural-match" && row.commits.includes(unit.commit));

+    const integration = parseIntegrationTrailerBlock(message);
+    const stageZero = parseCommitTrailerBlock(message).some(entry => entry.key === "Dispatch" && entry.value === "stage-0 (elephant)");
+    return { ...unit, changedPathClassification: classifyCriticChangedPaths(unit.changedPaths),
+      role: integration.ok ? "signed-artifact-integration-not-worker-authorship" : stageZero ? "declared-stage-zero-not-exemption-proof" : "unclassified",
+      roleAuthority: unavailable(integration.ok ? "REPORT-SIGNED-INTEGRATION-VERIFIER-NOT-SUPPLIED" : "REPORT-COMMIT-ROLE-OWNER-NOT-PROVED"),
+      editorialPathHint: unit.changedPaths.length > 0 && unit.changedPaths.every(path => /\.(?:md|txt)$/iu.test(path)),
+      mapping: matches.length === 0 ? "missing" : matches.length > 1 ? "ambiguous" : "structural-match",
+      records: matches.map(row => ({ path: row.path, sha256: row.sha256 })),
+      review: matches.length === 1 ? matches[0].review : unavailable("REPORT-COMMIT-REVIEW-UNMAPPED") };
+  });
+  report.pathMappings = range.changedPaths.map(path => ({ path,
+    commits: range.perCommit.filter(unit => unit.changedPaths.includes(path)).map(unit => unit.commit) }));
+  const unmapped = report.commits.filter(unit => unit.mapping !== "structural-match");
+  report.findings = unmapped.map(unit => ({ code: unit.mapping === "missing" ? "REPORT-IMPLEMENTATION-WITHOUT-DISPATCH-MAPPING" : "REPORT-AMBIGUOUS-DISPATCH-MAPPING", commit: unit.commit }));
+  report.state = report.findings.length ? "gaps" : "unknown";
+  // Empty comparison is explicit, but an unproved baseline cannot certify no work.
+  return report;
+}

+ 'ownership-journal-worker','ownership-journal-child','ownership-journal-exec-admission','ownership-journal-execution','ownership-journal-terminal'

+ 'DAP-PHYSICAL-OPEN','DAP-PHYSICAL-BOUND','DAP-PHYSICAL-DRIFT','DAP-PHYSICAL-PARENT-DRIFT','DAP-UTF8'
