+// SPDX-License-Identifier: SUL-1.0
+import { evaluateRequirementTraceability, requirementMapPath } from "./requirement-traceability.mjs";
+import { validateVerifySuiteReceipt } from "./verify-resume.mjs";
+import { readReportCandidateFile, readReportPublicArtifact, reportBytesSha256,
+  reportCandidateIdentity, reportCandidateInventory } from "./report-source-readers.mjs";
+
+export const DECLARED_CRITERIA_REPORT_SCHEMA = "pipeline.declared-criteria-evidence-report.v1";
+const unavailable = code => ({ state: "unavailable", code });
+const sameCandidate = (a, b) => a?.commit === b.commit && a?.tree === b.tree;
+
+/** Existing evidence is observed and bounded; no criterion is satisfied by name. */
+export function reportDeclaredCriteriaEvidence(handle, { specPath, verifyPath, receiptPaths = [] } = {}) {
+  const candidate = reportCandidateIdentity(handle);
+  const report = { schema: DECLARED_CRITERIA_REPORT_SCHEMA, reportOnly: true, completionEffect: "none", candidate,
+    sources: [], criteria: [], receipts: [], verify: unavailable("REPORT-VERIFY-NOT-SUPPLIED"),
+    conservation: unavailable("REPORT-AUTHORIZED-ORIGINAL-CUSTODY-READER-UNAVAILABLE"),
+    readinessSources: ["original-input", "prd", "spec", "revised-design", "traceability"],
+    browserPolicy: "required-only-if-declared; core-or-structural-evidence-is-not-browser-proof" };
+  if (typeof specPath !== "string" || !/^specs\/.+\.md$/u.test(specPath)) return { ...report, state: "unknown", source: unavailable("REPORT-SPEC-PATH") };
+  let spec, trace;
+  try {
+    spec = readReportCandidateFile(handle, specPath);
+    trace = evaluateRequirementTraceability({ specPath, candidate, candidateFiles: reportCandidateInventory(handle),
+      readCandidateFile: path => readReportCandidateFile(handle, path) });
+  } catch (error) { return { ...report, state: "unknown", source: unavailable(error.code ?? "REPORT-SPEC-UNAVAILABLE") }; }
+  report.sources.push({ kind: "spec", path: specPath, sha256: reportBytesSha256(spec) });
+  report.traceability = { mode: trace.mode, mapPath: requirementMapPath(specPath), map: trace.map ?? null };
+  // Mention inventory is not a normative parser: absence of the opt-in map
+  // cannot erase criteria, and prose identity alone cannot establish disposition.
+  const mentions = [...new Set(spec.toString("utf8").match(/\bAC-[A-Z0-9]+(?:-[A-Z0-9]+)*\b/gu) ?? [])].sort();
+  if (mentions.length > 256 || mentions.some(id => id.length > 80)) return { ...report, state: "unknown", source: unavailable("REPORT-CRITERION-BOUND") };
+  const mapped = new Map(trace.criteria.map(row => [row.id, row]));
+  report.criteria = [...new Set([...mentions, ...mapped.keys()])].sort().map(id => ({ id,
+    identitySource: mapped.has(id) ? "candidate-adjacent-traceability-map" : "spec-text-mention-not-normative-classification",
+    structural: mapped.has(id) ? mapped.get(id) : { status: "unmapped" },
+    executedProductEvidence: unavailable("REPORT-CRITERION-EXECUTION-BINDING-UNAVAILABLE"),
+    acceptedDisposition: unavailable("REPORT-CRITERION-DISPOSITION-OWNER-UNAVAILABLE") }));
+  if (verifyPath !== undefined) {
+    try {
+      const artifact = readReportPublicArtifact(handle, verifyPath), value = JSON.parse(artifact.bytes.toString("utf8"));
+      const identity = value.candidate?.start ?? value.candidate;
+      const candidateBound = sameCandidate(identity, candidate) && (value.candidate?.start === undefined
+        || (sameCandidate(value.candidate.finish, candidate) && value.candidate.binding === "exact"));
+      if (value.schema !== "pipeline.verify-evidence.v0" || !Array.isArray(value.steps) || value.steps.length > 2048
+        || !Number.isInteger(value.exitCode) || value.exitCode < 0 || !value.steps.every(step => typeof step.name === "string" && /^[A-Za-z0-9._:-]{1,128}$/u.test(step.name) && Number.isInteger(step.exitCode))) throw Error("shape");
+      report.verify = { state: !candidateBound ? "stale" : value.exitCode === 0 ? "published-success-not-product-acceptance" : "published-failed",
+        reference: artifact.reference, candidateBound, exitCode: value.exitCode,
+        steps: value.steps.map(step => ({ name: step.name, exitCode: step.exitCode, reused: step.reused === true })),
+        executionAuthenticity: unavailable("REPORT-VERIFY-JOURNAL-READER-NOT-SUPPLIED") };
+    } catch (error) { report.verify = unavailable(error.code ?? "REPORT-VERIFY-INVALID"); }
+  }
+  if (!Array.isArray(receiptPaths) || receiptPaths.length > 64 || new Set(receiptPaths).size !== receiptPaths.length) return { ...report, state: "unknown", source: unavailable("REPORT-RECEIPT-BOUND") };
+  for (const path of receiptPaths) {
+    try {
+      const artifact = readReportPublicArtifact(handle, path), receipt = JSON.parse(artifact.bytes.toString("utf8"));
+      const checked = validateVerifySuiteReceipt(receipt);
+      if (!checked.ok) { report.receipts.push({ reference: artifact.reference, state: "invalid", code: checked.code }); continue; }
+      const drift = receipt.inputs.files.filter(ref => {
+        try { return reportBytesSha256(readReportCandidateFile(handle, ref.path)) !== ref.fileSha256; }
+        catch { return true; }
+      }).map(ref => ref.path);
+      report.receipts.push({ reference: artifact.reference, suite: receipt.suite,
+        state: !sameCandidate(receipt.candidate, candidate) ? "stale" : drift.length ? "input-drift" : receipt.exitCode === 0 ? "recorded-completed-success" : "recorded-completed-failed",
+        candidateBound: sameCandidate(receipt.candidate, candidate), inputDrift: drift, exitCode: receipt.exitCode,
+        inputPaths: receipt.inputs.files.map(ref => ref.path),
+        completionCounts: receipt.caseCompletion?.counts ?? null,
+        executionAuthenticity: unavailable("REPORT-EXECUTION-PRODUCER-READER-UNAVAILABLE"),
+        productClass: unavailable("REPORT-PRODUCT-CLASS-OWNER-UNAVAILABLE") });

+  };
+  const requestCheck = verifyCriticalActionApprovalRequest({
+    request: request.value,
+    trustPolicy,
+    proof: signature,
+    expectedCandidate: request.value.candidate,
+    expectedAction,
+  });
+  if (!requestCheck.verified) return { ok: false, code: "APR-PROOF-INVALID" };
+  const signatureCheck = verifyAgainstTrustAnchors({ intent: request.value.approvalIntent, anchors, proof: signature });
+  return signatureCheck.verified ? { ok: true, by: signature.keyReference } : { ok: false, code: "APR-PROOF-INVALID" };
+}
+
+/** Report-only AC-6 subject used by the signed `authorize-critical` request. */
+export function readInterruptionPromotionSubject({ root } = {}) {
+  if (typeof root !== "string" || root.trim() === "") return { ok: false, code: "APR-IO" };
+  const current = loadCurrentSubject(root);
+  return current.ok ? { ok: true, subject: current.subject, subjectSha256: digest(Buffer.from(canonical(current.subject), "utf8")) } : { ok: false, ...current.result };
+}
+
+/**
+ * Agent-side record verb. It accepts only the public request and detached proof
+ * emitted by `authorize-critical`; trust and the measured baseline are rebuilt
+ * here before the single cache record is atomically replaced.
+ */
+export function recordInterruptionPromotion({ root, requestPath, proofPath } = {}) {
+  if (typeof root !== "string" || root.trim() === "" || typeof requestPath !== "string" || typeof proofPath !== "string") {
+    return { ok: false, status: "unavailable", code: "APR-IO" };
+  }
+  const current = loadCurrentSubject(root);
+  if (!current.ok) return { ok: false, status: current.result.status, code: current.result.code };
+  const requestRead = readRegularUtf8(requestPath, null, MAX_PROOF_BYTES, "APR-PROOF-MISSING", "APR-PROOF-INVALID");
+  const proofRead = readRegularUtf8(proofPath, null, MAX_PROOF_BYTES, "APR-PROOF-MISSING", "APR-PROOF-INVALID");
+  if (!requestRead.ok || !proofRead.ok) return { ok: false, status: "report-only", code: requestRead.code ?? proofRead.code };
+  const request = parseJson(requestRead.text);
+  const signature = parseJson(proofRead.text);
+  if (!plain(request) || !plain(signature)) return { ok: false, status: "report-only", code: "APR-PROOF-INVALID" };
+  const checked = verifiedProof({ value: request }, signature, current.subject);
+  if (!checked.ok) return { ok: false, status: "report-only", code: checked.code ?? "APR-PROOF-INVALID" };
+  const subjectSha256 = digest(Buffer.from(canonical(current.subject), "utf8"));
+  const record = {
+    schema: INTERRUPTION_PROMOTION_APPROVAL_SCHEMA,
+    kind: "interruption-promotion",
+    mode: "signature",
+    by: checked.by,
+    approvedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
+    subject: current.subject,
+    subjectSha256,
+    proof: { request, signature },
+  };
+  if (!recordShape(record) || canonical(request.action) !== canonical({
+    kind: "interruption-promotion",
+    subjectSha256: criticalActionSubjectSha256({ kind: "interruption-promotion", candidate: request.candidate, subject: current.subject }),
+    expiresAt: request.action?.expiresAt,
+  })) return { ok: false, status: "report-only", code: "APR-PROOF-INVALID" };
+
+  const rootDir = path.resolve(root);
+  const directory = path.join(rootDir, "telemetry");
+  const target = path.join(rootDir, INTERRUPTION_PROMOTION_APPROVAL_PATH);
+  const temporary = path.join(directory, `.interruption-promotion.${process.pid}.${randomUUID()}.tmp`);
+  let fd = null;
+  try {
+    const dirStat = lstatSync(directory);
+    if (!dirStat.isDirectory() || dirStat.isSymbolicLink()) return { ok: false, status: "report-only", code: "APR-IO" };
+    try {
+      const prior = lstatSync(target);
+      if (!prior.isFile() || prior.isSymbolicLink() || prior.nlink !== 1) return { ok: false, status: "report-only", code: "APR-IO" };
+    } catch (error) { if (error?.code !== "ENOENT") throw error; }
+    const beforeRename = readRegularUtf8(root, BASELINE_PATH, MAX_BASELINE_BYTES, "APR-BASELINE-MISSING", "APR-BASELINE-INVALID");
+    if (!beforeRename.ok || digest(Buffer.from(beforeRename.text, "utf8")) !== current.subject.baselineSha256) {
+      return { ok: false, status: "report-only", code: "APR-SUBJECT-MISMATCH" };
+    }
+    fd = openSync(temporary, fsConstants.O_WRONLY | fsConstants.O_CREAT | fsConstants.O_EXCL | (fsConstants.O_NOFOLLOW ?? 0), 0o600);
+    writeFileSync(fd, `${JSON.stringify(record, null, 2)}\n`, { encoding: "utf8" });
+    fsyncSync(fd);
+    closeSync(fd); fd = null;
+    renameSync(temporary, target);
+    const dirFd = openSync(directory, fsConstants.O_RDONLY);
+    try { fsyncSync(dirFd); } finally { closeSync(dirFd); }
+  } catch {
+    if (fd !== null) closeSync(fd);
+    try { unlinkSync(temporary); } catch {}
+    return { ok: false, status: "report-only", code: "APR-IO" };
+  }
+  const readback = checkInterruptionPromotion({ root });
+  if (readback.status !== "calibrated-pass" || readback.baselineSha256 !== current.subject.baselineSha256) {
+    return { ok: false, status: readback.status, code: readback.code };
+  }
+  return { ok: true, status: "recorded", code: "APR-RECORD-WRITTEN", path: INTERRUPTION_PROMOTION_APPROVAL_PATH, baselineSha256: current.subject.baselineSha256 };
+}
+
+/** Rebuilds and verifies the signed approval on every status read. */
+export function checkInterruptionPromotion({ root } = {}) {
+  if (typeof root !== "string" || root.trim() === "") return refusal("unavailable", "APR-IO");
+  const current = loadCurrentSubject(root);
+  if (!current.ok) return current.result;
+  const approvalRead = readRegularUtf8(root, INTERRUPTION_PROMOTION_APPROVAL_PATH, MAX_APPROVAL_BYTES, "APR-RECORD-MISSING", "APR-RECORD-INVALID");
+  if (!approvalRead.ok) return refusal("report-only", approvalRead.code, current.subject.baselineSha256);
+  const record = parseJson(approvalRead.text);
+  if (!recordShape(record)) return refusal("report-only", "APR-RECORD-INVALID", current.subject.baselineSha256);
+  if (record.mode !== "signature") return refusal("report-only", "APR-MODE-UNSUPPORTED", current.subject.baselineSha256);
+  if (canonical(record.subject) !== canonical(current.subject)
+    || record.subjectSha256 !== digest(Buffer.from(canonical(current.subject), "utf8"))) {
+    return refusal("report-only", "APR-SUBJECT-MISMATCH", current.subject.baselineSha256);
+  }
+  const checked = verifiedProof({ value: record.proof.request }, record.proof.signature, current.subject);
+  if (!checked.ok || record.by !== checked.by) return refusal("report-only", checked.code ?? "APR-PROOF-INVALID", current.subject.baselineSha256);
+  const status = evaluatePromotionEvidence({ baseline: current.baselineText, poApproval: { baselineSha256: current.subject.baselineSha256 } });
+  return status === "calibrated-pass"
+    ? { status, code: "APR-APPROVED", baselineSha256: current.subject.baselineSha256, mode: "signature" }
+    : refusal(status === "unavailable" ? "unavailable" : "report-only", "APR-BASELINE-NOT-ELIGIBLE", current.subject.baselineSha256);
+}

+// Domain-specific physical source adapters. No handles or authority callbacks are minted here.
+import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
+import { existsSync, lstatSync, realpathSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { join, relative, sep } from 'node:path';
+import { canonical } from './po-approval-proof.mjs';
+import { inspectSignedDescriptorCustodyRepository } from './worktree-lifecycle.mjs';
+import { readAuthorityNamespace, readAuthoritySourceFile } from './session-authority-domain-owner.mjs';
+import { readSourceOwnedAuthorityContext, inspectSourceOwnedCurrentAuthorityContext } from './session-requester-bridge.mjs';
+import { validateNativeGoldfishHostObservation } from './native-goldfish-host-observation.mjs';
+
+export const nativeManagedDigest = value => createHash('sha256').update(typeof value === 'string' || Buffer.isBuffer(value) ? value : canonical(value)).digest('hex');
+export function nativeManagedFault(reason) {
+  const error = new Error(reason); error.name = 'SessionAuthorityError';
+  error.code = 'SDC-AUTHORITY-UNAVAILABLE'; error.reason = reason; return error;
+}
+export function nativeManagedRepository(repository) {
+  const observed = inspectSignedDescriptorCustodyRepository(repository?.primaryRoot);
+  if (canonical(observed) !== canonical(repository)) throw nativeManagedFault('native-managed-repository-drift');
+  return observed;
+}
+export function nativeManagedCurrentOwner(repository) {
+  const context = readSourceOwnedAuthorityContext({ repository });
+  if (context.status !== 'bound') return { association: { state: 'unbound', target: null }, descriptorHandle: null, assurance: 'physical-readback' };
+  const observed = inspectSourceOwnedCurrentAuthorityContext({ repository });
+  const requester = observed.currentRequester;
+  return { association: { state: 'bound', target: { sessionId: requester.sessionId, descriptorSha256: requester.descriptorSha256, ownerNonceSha256: requester.ownerNonceSha256 } },
+    descriptorHandle: observed.descriptorHandle, assurance: observed.assurance === 'controlled-unit-method' ? 'controlled-unit-method' : 'physical-readback' };
+}
+export function nativeManagedSourceRef(repository, path, sourceFact) {
+  const suffix = relative(repository.commonDir, path);
+  if (!suffix || suffix.startsWith(`..${sep}`) || suffix === '..' || suffix.includes('\\')) throw nativeManagedFault('native-managed-source-outside-common');
+  return Object.freeze({ path: `.git/${suffix.split(sep).join('/')}`, sha256: sourceFact.sha256, size: sourceFact.size });
+}
+export function readNativeManagedSource(namespaceId, filePath) {
+  return readAuthoritySourceFile({ namespaceId, filePath, semantic: ({ value }) => {
+    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) throw nativeManagedFault('native-managed-json-required');
+    return value;
+  } });
+}
+export function readNativeManagedInventory(repository, domain) {
+  nativeManagedRepository(repository);
+  const roots = domain === 'native-goldfish' ? [['native-goldfish-host-commit', join(repository.commonDir, 'agent-pipeline/run/native-goldfish-host-commit')]]
+    : [['design-readiness-processes', join(repository.commonDir, 'agent-pipeline/design-readiness-codex')], ['advisor-processes', join(repository.commonDir, 'agent-pipeline/advisor-codex')]];
+  return roots.map(([namespaceId, rootPath]) => readAuthorityNamespace({ namespaceId, rootPath, classifyEntry: ({ relativePath, value }) => {
+    if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) throw nativeManagedFault('native-managed-invalid-record');
+    if (domain === 'native-goldfish') {
+      if (!/^(pending-(claude|codex)-[a-f0-9]{64}|agent-codex-[a-f0-9]{64}|observation-(claude|codex)-[a-f0-9]{64}|authority-owner-[a-f0-9]{64}|authority-terminal-[a-f0-9]{64}|authority-check-[a-f0-9]{64}|authority-scope-[a-f0-9]{64}-[1-9][0-9]{0,3}|authority-recheck-[a-f0-9]{64}-[1-9][0-9]{0,3}|authority-integration-[a-f0-9]{64}|authority-checkpoint-[a-f0-9]{64}-[1-9][0-9]{0,3})\.json$/.test(relativePath)) throw nativeManagedFault('native-managed-unknown-native-entry');
+      if (relativePath.startsWith('pending-') && !['pipeline.native-goldfish-host-state.v1','pipeline.native-goldfish-host-state.v2','pipeline.native-goldfish-host-state.v3'].includes(value.schema)
+        || relativePath.startsWith('agent-') && value.schema !== 'pipeline.native-goldfish-host-agent-binding.v1'
+        || relativePath.startsWith('observation-') && !['pipeline.native-goldfish-host-observation.v1','pipeline.native-goldfish-host-observation.v2','pipeline.native-goldfish-host-observation.v3'].includes(value.schema)
+        || relativePath.startsWith('authority-terminal-') && value.schema !== 'pipeline.native-goldfish-authority-terminal.v1'
+        || relativePath.startsWith('authority-check-') && value.schema !== 'pipeline.native-goldfish-item-check.v1'
+        || relativePath.startsWith('authority-scope-') && value.schema !== 'pipeline.native-goldfish-item-scope.v1'
+        || relativePath.startsWith('authority-recheck-') && value.schema !== 'pipeline.native-goldfish-item-recheck.v1'
+        || relativePath.startsWith('authority-integration-') && value.schema !== 'pipeline.native-goldfish-item-integration.v1'
+        || relativePath.startsWith('authority-checkpoint-') && value.schema !== 'pipeline.native-goldfish-item-checkpoint.v1') throw nativeManagedFault('native-managed-native-schema');
+      if(relativePath.startsWith('authority-owner-')&&value.schema!=='pipeline.native-goldfish-authority-owner.v1')throw nativeManagedFault('native-managed-native-owner-schema');
+      if(relativePath.startsWith('observation-')&&!validateNativeGoldfishHostObservation(value))throw nativeManagedFault('native-managed-native-observation-shape');
+    } else {
+      const names = '(intent|launcher|admission|child-intent|worker|child|exec-admission|execution|terminal|recovered-child|recovery|authority)';
+      if (!(new RegExp(`^[a-f0-9]{64}/processes/codex-host-drh_[a-f0-9]{32}/${names}\\.json$`)).test(relativePath)) throw nativeManagedFault('native-managed-unknown-managed-entry');
+      const name=relativePath.split('/').at(-1).slice(0,-5);
+      const schemas={intent:'pipeline.codex-host-process-intent.v1',launcher:'pipeline.codex-host-launcher.v1',admission:'pipeline.codex-host-admission.v1',
+        'child-intent':'pipeline.codex-host-child-intent.v1',worker:'pipeline.codex-host-worker.v1',child:'pipeline.codex-host-child.v1',
+        'exec-admission':'pipeline.codex-host-exec-admission.v1',execution:'pipeline.codex-host-execution.v1',terminal:'pipeline.codex-host-terminal.v1',
+        recovery:'pipeline.codex-host-recovery.v1',authority:'pipeline.codex-host-authority.v1'};
+      if(!schemas[name]||value.schema!==schemas[name])throw nativeManagedFault('native-managed-managed-schema');
+    }
+    return value;
+  } }));
+}
+export function nativeManagedAssociation(value){
+  if(!value||Object.keys(value).sort().join(',')!=='state,target')throw nativeManagedFault('native-managed-association-shape');
+  if(value.state==='unbound'&&value.target===null)return value;
+  if(value.state!=='bound'||!value.target||Object.keys(value.target).sort().join(',')!=='descriptorSha256,ownerNonceSha256,sessionId'
+    ||!/^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{2,79}$/.test(value.target.sessionId)
+    ||![value.target.descriptorSha256,value.target.ownerNonceSha256].every(v=>/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/.test(v)))throw nativeManagedFault('native-managed-association-binding');
+  return value;
+}
+export function nativeManagedRegistryPresent(repository) {
+  nativeManagedRepository(repository);
+  const path = join(repository.commonDir, 'agent-pipeline/session-authority/catalogue.json');
+  if (!existsSync(path)) return false;
+  const stat = lstatSync(path);
+  if (!stat.isFile() || stat.isSymbolicLink() || stat.nlink !== 1 || realpathSync(path) !== path) throw nativeManagedFault('native-managed-catalogue-unsafe');
+  return true;
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,73 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: SUL-1.0
+/** Versioned native observer dispatch. Serialization does not issue authority. */
+import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
+import {readFileSync,realpathSync} from 'node:fs';
+import {canonicalJson} from './codex-sandbox-compatibility.mjs';
+import {observeNativeDarwinProcess,sameNativeDarwinProcess,listNativeDarwinProcessGroup} from './darwin-native-process-observer.mjs';
+import {observeNativeWindowsProcess,sameNativeWindowsProcess} from './windows-native-process-observer.mjs';
+const hostDigest=value=>createHash('sha256').update(typeof value==='string'||Buffer.isBuffer(value)?value:canonicalJson(value)).digest('hex');
+const hostFault=code=>Object.assign(new Error(code),{code});
+export const NATIVE_PLATFORM_OBSERVER_SCHEMA='pipeline.native-platform-process-observer.v1';
+export function parseLinuxProcessStat(text) {
+  // comm can contain spaces and closing parentheses. Fields after its last
+  // closing parenthesis start with field 3 (state); starttime is field 22.
+  const end = text.lastIndexOf(')');
+  const pid = Number(text.slice(0, text.indexOf(' ')));
+  const fields = text.slice(end + 2).trim().split(/\s+/);
+  if (end < 0 || !Number.isSafeInteger(pid) || pid < 1 || fields.length < 20
+    || !/^\d+$/.test(fields[19])) throw hostFault('host-proc-stat-invalid');
+  return { pid, state: fields[0], parentPid: Number(fields[1]), group: Number(fields[2]),
+    session: Number(fields[3]), start: fields[19] };
+}
+export function observeLinuxProcess(pid) {
+  if (process.platform !== 'linux' || !Number.isSafeInteger(pid) || pid < 1) throw hostFault('host-process-platform-unavailable');
+  try {
+    const before = parseLinuxProcessStat(readFileSync(`/proc/${pid}/stat`, 'utf8'));
+    const status = readFileSync(`/proc/${pid}/status`, 'utf8');
+    const uid = Number(/^Uid:\s+(\d+)/m.exec(status)?.[1]);
+    const argv = readFileSync(`/proc/${pid}/cmdline`).toString('utf8').split('\0').filter(Boolean);
+    const executable = realpathSync(`/proc/${pid}/exe`);
+    const after = parseLinuxProcessStat(readFileSync(`/proc/${pid}/stat`, 'utf8'));
+    if (before.start !== after.start || before.group !== after.group || before.session !== after.session
+      || !Number.isSafeInteger(uid)) throw hostFault('host-process-identity-changed');
+    return { ...after, uid, executable, argvSha256: hostDigest(argv),
+      bootSha256: hostDigest(readFileSync('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id', 'utf8').trim()) };
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (error?.code === 'ENOENT' || error?.code === 'ESRCH') return null;
+    throw error;
+  }
+}
+export function sameProcess(expected, observed) {
+  return observed !== null && ['pid', 'start', 'group', 'session', 'uid', 'executable', 'argvSha256', 'bootSha256']
+    .every(key => expected?.[key] === observed[key]) && !['Z', 'X'].includes(observed.state);
+}
+
+export function observeNativePlatformProcess(pid){
+  if(process.platform==='linux')return observeLinuxProcess(pid);
+  const result=process.platform==='darwin'?observeNativeDarwinProcess({pid}):process.platform==='win32'?observeNativeWindowsProcess({pid}):null;
+  if(result?.status==='absent')return null;
+  if(result?.status!=='present')throw hostFault(result?.code??result?.reason??'host-process-platform-unavailable');
+  return result.process;
+}
+export function sameNativePlatformProcess(a,b){
+  if(process.platform==='darwin')return sameNativeDarwinProcess(a,b);
+  if(process.platform==='win32')return sameNativeWindowsProcess(a,b);
+  return sameProcess(a,b);
+}
+export function listNativePlatformSession(launcher){
+  if(process.platform!=='darwin')throw hostFault('host-native-process-tree-proof-unavailable');
+  if(!sameNativeDarwinProcess(launcher,launcher))throw hostFault('host-session-ownership-unverified');
+  const leader=observeNativePlatformProcess(launcher.pid);
+  if(leader&&!sameNativeDarwinProcess(launcher,leader))throw hostFault('host-session-ownership-unverified');
+  const members=[];
+  const micros=start=>{const [s,u]=start.split(':');return BigInt(s)*1000000n+BigInt(u);};
+  for(const pid of listNativeDarwinProcessGroup(launcher.group)){
+    const observed=observeNativePlatformProcess(pid);if(!observed)continue;
+    if(observed.session!==launcher.session||observed.group!==launcher.group)continue;
+    if(observed.uid!==launcher.uid||observed.bootSha256!==launcher.bootSha256||micros(observed.start)<micros(launcher.start))throw hostFault('host-session-ownership-unverified');
+    members.push(observed);
+  }
+  const after=observeNativePlatformProcess(launcher.pid);
+  if(after&&!sameNativeDarwinProcess(launcher,after))throw hostFault('host-session-ownership-unverified');
+  return members;
+}

+// SPDX-License-Identifier: SUL-1.0
+import {registerTestCaseCompletion} from './test-case-completion.mjs';
+const cases=[];
+function test(name,options,run){
+  if(typeof options==='function'){run=options;options={};}
+  cases.push({id:'NPO'+String(cases.length+1).padStart(3,'0'),name,mode:options.skip?'skip':'run',run});
+}
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import {readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
+import {compileFunction} from 'node:vm';
+import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
+import {observeNativePlatformProcess,sameNativePlatformProcess,observeLinuxProcess,parseLinuxProcessStat,NATIVE_PLATFORM_OBSERVER_SCHEMA} from './native-platform-process-observer.mjs';
+import {observeNativeWindowsProcess} from './windows-native-process-observer.mjs';
+test('shared native adapter retains actual Linux observation and negative identity controls',{skip:process.platform!=='linux'},()=>{
+  assert.equal(NATIVE_PLATFORM_OBSERVER_SCHEMA,'pipeline.native-platform-process-observer.v1');
+  const current=observeNativePlatformProcess(process.pid),legacy=observeLinuxProcess(process.pid);
+  assert.deepEqual(current,legacy);assert.equal(sameNativePlatformProcess(current,legacy),true);
+  const argv=readFileSync('/proc/self/cmdline').toString('utf8').split('\0').filter(Boolean);
+  assert.equal(current.argvSha256,createHash('sha256').update(JSON.stringify(argv,null,2)+'\n').digest('hex'));
+  for(const key of ['pid','start','group','session','uid','executable','argvSha256','bootSha256'])assert.equal(sameNativePlatformProcess(current,{...legacy,[key]:typeof legacy[key]==='number'?legacy[key]+1:legacy[key]+'wrong'}),false,key);
+  assert.throws(()=>observeLinuxProcess(-1),{code:'host-process-platform-unavailable'});
+  assert.throws(()=>parseLinuxProcessStat('broken'),{code:'host-proc-stat-invalid'});
+});
+test('native Windows observer rejects JSON/native-platform claims on foreign hosts',{skip:process.platform==='win32'},()=>{
+  assert.equal(observeNativeWindowsProcess({pid:process.pid}).status,'unavailable');
+  assert.equal(observeNativeWindowsProcess({pid:process.pid,platform:'win32',native:true}).status,'unavailable');
+});
+test('live native shared observer selects actual Darwin kernel; Linux API stays Linux-only',{skip:process.platform!=='darwin'},()=>{
+  const current=observeNativePlatformProcess(process.pid);assert.equal(current.platform,'darwin');
+  assert.equal(sameNativePlatformProcess(current,observeNativePlatformProcess(process.pid)),true);
+  assert.throws(()=>observeLinuxProcess(process.pid),{code:'host-process-platform-unavailable'});
+});
+
+// Portable branch tests execute the actual bridge function bodies. They are
+// regression unit evidence only, never liveWindows or liveDarwin authority.
+const source=readFileSync(new URL('./session-requester-bridge.mjs',import.meta.url),'utf8');
+const between=(start,end)=>{const begin=source.indexOf(start),stop=source.indexOf(end,begin);assert.ok(begin>=0&&stop>begin);return source.slice(begin,stop);};
+test('actual Windows program branch keeps executable/module/argv/cwd custody and rejects drift',()=>{
+  const body=between('function osvProgram(actual){','\n/** Readonly original');
+  const actual={platform:'win32',pid:31,executable:'/node',cwd:'/repo',argv:['/node','/bridge']};
+  let fresh=structuredClone(actual),refs=0;
+  const p={platform:'win32',pid:31,cwd:()=>'/repo',execPath:'/node',argv:['/node','/bridge']};

+// SPDX-License-Identifier: SUL-1.0

+#include <libproc.h>

+#include <sys/socket.h>

+#include <stdio.h>

+#define ARG_BOUND 262144
+static void hex(const unsigned char *p, size_t n) {
+  for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) printf("%02x", p[i]);
+}
+static int bsd(pid_t pid, struct proc_bsdinfo *b) {
+  memset(b, 0, sizeof(*b));
+  return proc_pidinfo(pid, PROC_PIDTBSDINFO, 0, b, sizeof(*b)) == (int)sizeof(*b);
+}
+static int snapshot(pid_t pid, char *exe, struct proc_vnodepathinfo *v,
+                    unsigned char *args, size_t *length) {
+  int mib[3] = {CTL_KERN, KERN_PROCARGS2, pid};
+  memset(v, 0, sizeof(*v));
+  if (proc_pidpath(pid, exe, PROC_PIDPATHINFO_MAXSIZE) <= 0 ||
+      proc_pidinfo(pid, PROC_PIDVNODEPATHINFO, 0, v, sizeof(*v)) != (int)sizeof(*v) ||
+      sysctl(mib, 3, args, length, NULL, 0) != 0) return 0;
+  if (strnlen(exe, PROC_PIDPATHINFO_MAXSIZE) == PROC_PIDPATHINFO_MAXSIZE ||
+      strnlen(v->pvi_cdir.vip_path, MAXPATHLEN) == MAXPATHLEN || *length < sizeof(int)) return 0;
+  int count; memcpy(&count, args, sizeof(count));
+  if (count < 1 || count > 4096) return 0;
+  size_t at = sizeof(int);
+  while (at < *length && args[at]) at++;
+  if (at == *length) return 0;
+  while (at < *length && !args[at]) at++;
+  for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) {
+    while (at < *length && args[at]) at++;
+    if (at == *length) return 0;
+    at++;
+  }
+  *length = at; /* Never emit environment variables. */
+  return 1;
+}
+int main(int argc, char **argv) {
+  if (argc == 3 && strcmp(argv[1], "group") == 0) {
+    char *end; errno = 0; long group = strtol(argv[2], &end, 10);
+    if (errno || *end || group < 1 || group > INT_MAX) return 2;

+    errno = 0;
+    int size = proc_listpids(PROC_PGRP_ONLY, (uint32_t)group, pids, sizeof(pids));

+  }
+  if (argc != 3 || strcmp(argv[1], "process") != 0) return 2;
+  char *end; errno = 0; long value = strtol(argv[2], &end, 10);
+  if (errno || *end || value < 1 || value > INT_MAX) return 2;

+  char boot[128] = {0}, boot2[128] = {0}; size_t bn = sizeof(boot), bn2 = sizeof(boot2);

+  struct proc_vnodepathinfo vnode, vnode2;
+  unsigned char *args = calloc(1, ARG_BOUND), *args2 = calloc(1, ARG_BOUND);

+  size_t an = ARG_BOUND, an2 = ARG_BOUND;
+  pid_t session = getsid(pid);
+  if (session < 1 || sysctlbyname("kern.bootsessionuuid", boot, &bn, NULL, 0) != 0 ||
+      !snapshot(pid, exe, &vnode, args, &an) || !snapshot(pid, exe2, &vnode2, args2, &an2) ||
+      !bsd(pid, &after) || getsid(pid) != session ||
+      sysctlbyname("kern.bootsessionuuid", boot2, &bn2, NULL, 0) != 0 ||
+      bn != bn2 || memcmp(boot, boot2, bn) ||
+      before.pbi_pid != after.pbi_pid || before.pbi_ppid != after.pbi_ppid ||
+      before.pbi_start_tvsec != after.pbi_start_tvsec || before.pbi_start_tvusec != after.pbi_start_tvusec ||
+      before.pbi_uid != after.pbi_uid || before.pbi_gid != after.pbi_gid ||
+      before.pbi_ruid != after.pbi_ruid || before.pbi_rgid != after.pbi_rgid ||
+      before.pbi_svuid != after.pbi_svuid || before.pbi_svgid != after.pbi_svgid ||
+      before.pbi_pgid != after.pbi_pgid || after.pbi_status == 5 ||
+      (after.pbi_flags & PROC_FLAG_INEXIT) || strcmp(exe, exe2) ||
+      strcmp(vnode.pvi_cdir.vip_path, vnode2.pvi_cdir.vip_path) ||
+      vnode.pvi_cdir.vip_vi.vi_stat.vst_ino != vnode2.pvi_cdir.vip_vi.vi_stat.vst_ino ||
+      vnode.pvi_cdir.vip_vi.vi_stat.vst_dev != vnode2.pvi_cdir.vip_vi.vi_stat.vst_dev ||
+      an != an2 || memcmp(args, args2, an)) return 2;
+  if (bn < 2 || bn > sizeof(boot) || boot[bn-1] != 0) return 2;
+  printf("{\"pid\":%u,\"parentPid\":%u,\"group\":%u,\"session\":%d,\"uid\":%u,\"gid\":%u,\"ruid\":%u,\"rgid\":%u,\"svuid\":%u,\"svgid\":%u,\"start\":\"%llu:%llu\",\"boot\":\"%s\",\"executableHex\":\"",
+    after.pbi_pid, after.pbi_ppid, after.pbi_pgid, session, after.pbi_uid, after.pbi_gid,
+    after.pbi_ruid, after.pbi_rgid, after.pbi_svuid, after.pbi_svgid,
+    (unsigned long long)after.pbi_start_tvsec, (unsigned long long)after.pbi_start_tvusec, boot);
+  hex((unsigned char *)exe, strlen(exe)); printf("\",\"cwdHex\":\"");
+  hex((unsigned char *)vnode.pvi_cdir.vip_path, strlen(vnode.pvi_cdir.vip_path));
+  printf("\",\"procargsHex\":\""); hex(args, an); puts("\"}");
+  free(args); free(args2); return ferror(stdout) ? 2 : 0;
+}

+// SPDX-License-Identifier: SUL-1.0
+// The existing observation-governance policy/inventory validator, shared by Verify and the staged commit boundary.
+const AUDIENCES = Object.freeze(["public-user", "maintainer", "machine"]);
+const DOCUMENT_LIFECYCLES = Object.freeze([
+  "maintained",
+  "normative-record",
+  "compatibility-redirect",
+  "review-candidate",
+]);
+
+function exactKeys(value, expected) {
+  if (!value || typeof value !== "object" || Array.isArray(value)) return false;
+  const actual = Object.keys(value).sort();
+  const wanted = [...expected].sort();
+  return actual.length === wanted.length && actual.every((key, index) => key === wanted[index]);
+}
+
+function exactArray(actual, expected) {
+  return Array.isArray(actual)
+    && actual.length === expected.length
+    && actual.every((entry, index) => entry === expected[index]);
+}
+
+function requireExactPolicy(policy, findings) {
+  if (!exactKeys(policy, ["schema", "canonicalIssue", "lifecycle", "backlog", "privateOverlay", "documentation"])) {
+    findings.push("OG-POLICY-SCHEMA root keys are not exact");
+    return;
+  }
+  if (policy.schema !== "pipeline.observation-doc-governance.v1") findings.push("OG-POLICY-SCHEMA unsupported schema");
+
+  const issue = policy.canonicalIssue;
+  if (!exactKeys(issue, ["scope", "branchIndependent", "initialFormLabels", "controlledAreaLabelAllowed", "securityRoute"])
+      || issue.scope !== "repository-global"
+      || issue.branchIndependent !== true
+      || !exactArray(issue.initialFormLabels, ["kind:observation", "triage:needs-review"])
+      || issue.controlledAreaLabelAllowed !== true
+      || issue.securityRoute !== "private-vulnerability-reporting") {
+    findings.push("OG-ISSUE-AUTHORITY canonical Issue contract drifted");
+  }
+
+  const lifecycle = policy.lifecycle;
+  const expectedTransitions = {
+    observation: ["triage"],
+    triage: ["confirmed"],
+    confirmed: ["known-error", "backlog-link"],
+    "known-error": ["backlog-link"],
+    "backlog-link": [],
+  };
+  if (!exactKeys(lifecycle, ["states", "transitions"])
+      || !exactArray(lifecycle?.states, Object.keys(expectedTransitions))
+      || !exactKeys(lifecycle?.transitions, Object.keys(expectedTransitions))
+      || Object.entries(expectedTransitions).some(([state, targets]) => !exactArray(lifecycle?.transitions?.[state], targets))) {
+    findings.push("OG-LIFECYCLE observation lifecycle drifted");
+  }
+
+  const backlog = policy.backlog;
+  if (!exactKeys(backlog, ["promotion", "requiresStablePublicBranch", "reciprocalLinksRequired", "automaticPromotion"])
+      || backlog.promotion !== "explicit-after-triage"
+      || backlog.requiresStablePublicBranch !== true
+      || backlog.reciprocalLinksRequired !== true
+      || backlog.automaticPromotion !== false) {
+    findings.push("OG-BACKLOG backlog promotion contract drifted");
+  }
+
+  const overlay = policy.privateOverlay;
+  if (!exactKeys(overlay, ["allowedContent", "mayReplacePublicIssue", "mayDuplicatePublicObservation"])
+      || !exactArray(overlay.allowedContent, ["private-deltas", "public-issue-links", "public-backlog-links"])
+      || overlay.mayReplacePublicIssue !== false
+      || overlay.mayDuplicatePublicObservation !== false) {
+    findings.push("OG-OVERLAY private overlay contract drifted");
+  }
+}
+
+function checkInventory(policy, docsPaths, findings) {
+  const documentation = policy?.documentation;
+  if (!exactKeys(documentation, ["audiences", "lifecycles", "inventory"])
+      || !exactArray(documentation?.audiences, AUDIENCES)
+      || !exactArray(documentation?.lifecycles, DOCUMENT_LIFECYCLES)) {
+    findings.push("OG-DOC-AXES documentation audience/lifecycle axes drifted");
+    return;
+  }
+  if (!Array.isArray(documentation.inventory)) {
+    findings.push("OG-DOC-INVENTORY inventory must be an array");
+    return;
+  }
+  const paths = [];
+  for (const [index, entry] of documentation.inventory.entries()) {
+    if (!exactKeys(entry, ["audience", "lifecycle", "paths"])
+        || !AUDIENCES.includes(entry.audience)
+        || !DOCUMENT_LIFECYCLES.includes(entry.lifecycle)
+        || !Array.isArray(entry.paths)
+        || entry.paths.some((path) => typeof path !== "string" || !path.startsWith("docs/"))) {
+      findings.push(`OG-DOC-INVENTORY invalid entry ${index}`);
+      continue;
+    }
+    if (!exactArray(entry.paths, [...entry.paths].sort())) findings.push(`OG-DOC-ORDER inventory group ${index} paths must be sorted`);
+    paths.push(...entry.paths);
+  }
+  if (new Set(paths).size !== paths.length) findings.push("OG-DOC-DUPLICATE inventory paths must be unique");
+  const inventory = new Set(paths);
+  const discovered = new Set(docsPaths);
+  for (const path of docsPaths) if (!inventory.has(path)) findings.push(`OG-DOC-UNCLASSIFIED ${path}`);
+  for (const path of paths) if (!discovered.has(path)) findings.push(`OG-DOC-INVENTORY-STALE ${path}`);
+}
+
+export function checkObservationDocumentation(policy, docsPaths) {
+  const findings = [];
+  requireExactPolicy(policy, findings);
+  checkInventory(policy, docsPaths, findings);
+  findings.sort();
+  return { ok: findings.length === 0, findings };
+}

diff --git a/plugins/pipeline-core/lib/project-calibration-identity.mjs b/plugins/pipeline-core/lib/project-calibration-identity.mjs

index 000000000..22aace40c
--- /dev/null
+++ b/plugins/pipeline-core/lib/project-calibration-identity.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,160 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: SUL-1.0
+import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
+import { existsSync, lstatSync, readFileSync, realpathSync } from "node:fs";
+import { basename, join, resolve } from "node:path";
+import { AUTHORITY_ARTIFACTS, resolveAuthorityArtifactPath } from "./project-authority.mjs";
+import { repositoryPathIdentityOrSelf } from "./repository-path-identity.mjs";
+
+const SCHEMA = "pipeline.project-calibration-identity.v1";
+const ROOT_DOMAIN = "pipeline.project-calibration-root.v1\0";
+const MAX_LABEL_BYTES = 512;
+const MAX_CALIBRATION_BYTES = 1024 * 1024;
+const SHA256 = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/u;
+const object = value => value !== null && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value);
+const hash = value => createHash("sha256").update(value).digest("hex");
+function ioFor(deps) {
+  return {
+    existsSync: deps.existsSync ?? existsSync,
+    lstatSync: deps.lstatSync ?? lstatSync,
+    readFileSync: deps.readFileSync ?? readFileSync,
+    realpathSync: deps.realpathSync ?? realpathSync,
+  };
+}
+function validLabel(value) {
+  return typeof value === "string" && value.trim() !== ""
+    && Buffer.byteLength(value, "utf8") <= MAX_LABEL_BYTES
+    && !/[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/u.test(value);
+}
+function observeRoot(rootDir, io) {
+  if (typeof rootDir !== "string" || rootDir.length === 0) throw new Error("root unavailable");
+  const requested = resolve(rootDir);
+  const requestedInfo = io.lstatSync(requested);
+  if (!requestedInfo.isDirectory() || requestedInfo.isSymbolicLink()) throw new Error("root unavailable");
+  const root = typeof io.realpathSync.native === "function"
+    ? io.realpathSync.native(requested) : io.realpathSync(requested);
+  if (typeof root !== "string") throw new Error("root unavailable");
+  const physicalInfo = io.lstatSync(root);
+  if (!physicalInfo.isDirectory() || physicalInfo.isSymbolicLink()) throw new Error("root unavailable");
+  const project = basename(root);
+  if (!validLabel(project)) throw new Error("root unavailable");
+  return { root, project, rootSha256: hash(`${ROOT_DOMAIN}${repositoryPathIdentityOrSelf(root)}`) };
+}
+
+/** Factual selected-root label only; never accepts an independent project string. */
+export function buildRootProjectCalibrationIdentity({ rootDir, deps = {} } = {}) {
+  try {
+    const current = observeRoot(rootDir, ioFor(deps));
+    return Object.freeze({ schema: SCHEMA, status: "resolved", kind: "root-derived",
+      project: current.project, rootSha256: current.rootSha256 });
+  } catch {
+    return Object.freeze({ schema: SCHEMA, status: "unavailable", kind: null,
+      project: null, rootSha256: null, code: "PCI-ROOT-UNAVAILABLE" });
+  }
+}
+
+function readBoundCalibration(root, relative, io) {
+  if (![AUTHORITY_ARTIFACTS.calibration.neutral, AUTHORITY_ARTIFACTS.calibration.legacy].includes(relative)) {
+    throw new Error("unbounded calibration");
+  }
+  let target = root;
+  let before;
+  const parts = relative.split("/");
+  for (let index = 0; index < parts.length; index += 1) {
+    target = join(target, parts[index]);
+    let info;
+    try { info = io.lstatSync(target); }
+    catch (error) { if (error?.code === "ENOENT") return null; throw error; }
+    if (info.isSymbolicLink() || (index < parts.length - 1 && !info.isDirectory())) {
+      throw new Error("unsafe calibration");
+    }
+    if (index === parts.length - 1) before = info;
+  }
+  if (!before.isFile() || before.size > MAX_CALIBRATION_BYTES) throw new Error("unsafe calibration");
+  const physical = typeof io.realpathSync.native === "function"
+    ? io.realpathSync.native(target) : io.realpathSync(target);
+  if (physical !== target) throw new Error("unsafe calibration");
+  const bytes = io.readFileSync(target);
+  const after = io.lstatSync(target);
+  if (!Buffer.isBuffer(bytes) || bytes.length > MAX_CALIBRATION_BYTES || !after.isFile()
+    || after.isSymbolicLink() || before.dev !== after.dev || before.ino !== after.ino
+    || before.size !== after.size || before.mtimeMs !== after.mtimeMs || before.ctimeMs !== after.ctimeMs
+    || before.nlink !== after.nlink || bytes.length !== after.size) throw new Error("unstable calibration");
+  return bytes;
+}
+function unavailable(reason, code, rootSha256 = null, source = null) {
+  return Object.freeze({ schema: SCHEMA, status: "unavailable", kind: null,
+    project: null, rootSha256,
+    configuredValue: Object.freeze({ status: "unavailable", reason }), source, code });
+}
+function resolved(current, project, kind, source, placeholder = false) {
+  return Object.freeze({ schema: SCHEMA, status: "resolved", kind, project,
+    rootSha256: current.rootSha256,
+    configuredValue: Object.freeze({ status: placeholder ? "unavailable" : "selected",
+      reason: placeholder ? "legacy-placeholder" : null }), source });
+}
+
+/**
+ * Selected calibration is the only alias source. Root provenance is freshly
+ * observed, not supplied by that JSON and not a replacement for Git/PO custody.
+ * This reader creates no files, receipts, commands or authority.
+ */
+export function readProjectCalibrationIdentity({ rootDir = process.cwd(), deps = {} } = {}) {
+  let io;
+  let current;
+  try { io = ioFor(deps); current = observeRoot(rootDir, io); }
+  catch { return unavailable("root-unavailable", "PCI-ROOT-UNAVAILABLE"); }
+  let artifact;
+  try { artifact = resolveAuthorityArtifactPath("calibration", { rootDir: current.root }); }
+  catch { return unavailable("authority-unavailable", "PCI-AUTHORITY-UNAVAILABLE", current.rootSha256); }
+  if (!["ready", "missing"].includes(artifact.authorityStatus)
+    || !["neutral", "legacy"].includes(artifact.source)
+    || artifact.relPath !== AUTHORITY_ARTIFACTS.calibration[artifact.source]) {
+    return unavailable("authority-unavailable", "PCI-AUTHORITY-UNAVAILABLE", current.rootSha256);
+  }
+  let bytes;
+  let otherBytes;
+  try {
+    bytes = readBoundCalibration(current.root, artifact.relPath, io);
+    if (bytes === null) return unavailable("calibration-missing", "PCI-CALIBRATION-MISSING", current.rootSha256);
+    const other = artifact.source === "neutral" ? "legacy" : "neutral";
+    otherBytes = readBoundCalibration(current.root, AUTHORITY_ARTIFACTS.calibration[other], io);
+  } catch { return unavailable("calibration-unsafe", "PCI-CALIBRATION-UNSAFE", current.rootSha256); }
+  const source = Object.freeze({ kind: artifact.source, path: artifact.relPath,
+    sha256: hash(bytes), authorityStatus: artifact.authorityStatus });
+  if (otherBytes !== null && !bytes.equals(otherBytes)) {
+    return unavailable("calibration-drift", "PCI-CALIBRATION-DRIFT", current.rootSha256, source);
+  }
+  let calibration;
+  try {
+    const text = bytes.toString("utf8");
+    if (!Buffer.from(text, "utf8").equals(bytes)) throw new Error("invalid UTF8");
+    calibration = JSON.parse(text);
+    if (!object(calibration)) throw new Error("invalid calibration");
+  } catch { return unavailable("calibration-invalid", "PCI-CALIBRATION-INVALID", current.rootSha256, source); }
+  const project = calibration.project;
+  if (project === undefined || project === null || (typeof project === "string" && project.trim() === "")) {
+    return unavailable("project-missing", "PCI-PROJECT-MISSING", current.rootSha256, source);
+  }
+  if (!validLabel(project)) return unavailable("project-invalid", "PCI-PROJECT-INVALID", current.rootSha256, source);
+  const metadata = calibration.projectIdentity;
+  if (metadata !== undefined) {
+    if (!object(metadata) || Object.keys(metadata).length !== 3
+      || !["schema", "kind", "rootSha256"].every(key => Object.hasOwn(metadata, key))
+      || metadata.schema !== SCHEMA || !["root-derived", "configured-alias"].includes(metadata.kind)
+      || !SHA256.test(metadata.rootSha256 ?? "")) {
+      return unavailable("metadata-invalid", "PCI-METADATA-INVALID", current.rootSha256, source);
+    }
+    if (metadata.rootSha256 !== current.rootSha256) {
+      return unavailable("root-mismatch", "PCI-ROOT-MISMATCH", current.rootSha256, source);
+    }
+    if (metadata.kind === "root-derived" && project !== current.project) {
+      return unavailable("name-mismatch", "PCI-NAME-MISMATCH", current.rootSha256, source);
+    }
+    return resolved(current, project, metadata.kind, source);
+  }
+  // The historical seed is unavailable as a configured identity. Its factual
+  // physical-root replacement is a different observed source, even if the
+  // real directory itself is legitimately called "new-project".
+  if (project === "new-project") return resolved(current, current.project, "root-derived", source, true);
+  return resolved(current, project, "configured-alias", source);
+}

+import { devNull, tmpdir } from "node:os";
+import { basename, dirname, join, resolve } from "node:path";
+import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
+import { applyProjectOnboardingV3, planProjectOnboardingV3 } from "./project-onboarding-v3.mjs";
+import { registerTestCaseCompletion } from "./test-case-completion.mjs";
+
+const self = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
+const repoRoot = resolve(dirname(self), "../../..");
+const probeMode = process.argv[2];
+function runSharedTempProbe() {
+  const mode = process.argv[3];
+  const fakeTemp = realpathSync(process.env.TMPDIR);
+  const home = process.env.HOME;
+  assert.equal(realpathSync(tmpdir()), fakeTemp, "child must use the owned simulated OS temporary root");
+  const root = mode === "child" ? mkdtempSync(join(fakeTemp, "eligible-project-")) : fakeTemp;
+  // A real authenticated plan is minted while this root is still eligible,
+  // then the OS temp root changes before apply. No hand-built plan bypasses authentication.
+  if (mode === "apply") process.env.TMPDIR = home;
+  const rootDir = mode === "alias" ? `${root}/../${basename(root)}/.` : root;
+  const deps = { homedir: () => home };
+  const plan = planProjectOnboardingV3({ rootDir, runner: "codex", deps });
+  if (mode === "apply") process.env.TMPDIR = fakeTemp;
+  const applied = ["apply", "child"].includes(mode)
+    ? applyProjectOnboardingV3(plan, { rootDir, activate: true, deps }) : null;
+  const gitReadback = applied?.status === "applied" ? spawnSync("git", ["rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"], {
+    cwd: root, encoding: "utf8", timeout: 10_000,
+  }) : null;
+  if (gitReadback) {
+    assert.equal(gitReadback.error, undefined);
+    assert.equal(gitReadback.status, 0, gitReadback.stderr);
+  }
+  console.log(JSON.stringify({ mode, tempRoot: tmpdir(), root, planStatus: plan.status,
+    planTargets: plan.targets?.length ?? 0, initializesGit: plan.git?.initializesGit ?? false,
+    applyStatus: applied?.status ?? null, gitExists: existsSync(join(root, ".git")),
+    gitTopLevel: gitReadback?.stdout?.trim() ?? null,
+    entries: readdirSync(root), diagnostics: applied?.diagnostics ?? plan.diagnostics ?? [] }));
+  // This CLI child owns only the probe; normal entry registers the four cases below.
+  process.exit(0);
+}
+if (probeMode === "--shared-temp-probe") runSharedTempProbe();
+
+function probe(mode) {
+    const scratch = join(repoRoot, "scratch");
+    mkdirSync(scratch, { recursive: true });
+    const owned = mkdtempSync(join(scratch, "onboarding-shared-temp-"));
+    try {
+      const fakeTemp = join(owned, "os-temp");
+      const home = join(owned, "home");
+      mkdirSync(fakeTemp); mkdirSync(home);
+      const env = { ...process.env, TMPDIR: fakeTemp, TMP: fakeTemp, TEMP: fakeTemp,

+        GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: devNull, GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES: owned };
+      // Exclude inherited Git repository selection and author credentials.
+      for (const key of Object.keys(env)) if (/^GIT_(DIR|WORK_TREE|COMMON_DIR|INDEX_FILE|OBJECT_DIRECTORY|ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES|CONFIG_COUNT|CONFIG_KEY_|CONFIG_VALUE_|AUTHOR_|COMMITTER_)/u.test(key)) delete env[key];

+      assert.equal(child.error, undefined, String(child.error));
+      assert.equal(child.status, 0, child.stderr);
+      const observed = JSON.parse(child.stdout.trim().split("\n").at(-1));

+    { id: "POTR01", name: "plan rejects the exact shared OS temporary root without writes", run() {
+      const seen = probe("plan"); assert.equal(seen.planStatus, "unsafe");

+    } },
+    { id: "POTR02", name: "apply rechecks an authenticated root that became the shared OS temporary root", run() {

+      assert.notEqual(seen.applyStatus, "applied"); assert.equal(seen.gitExists, false);

+    } },
+    { id: "POTR03", name: "normalized exact-root path alias is rejected", run() {
+      const seen = probe("alias"); assert.equal(seen.planStatus, "unsafe");
+      assert.equal(seen.planTargets, 0); assert.deepEqual(seen.entries, []);
+    } },
+    { id: "POTR04", name: "unique child of the OS temporary root remains eligible for plan and apply", run() {
+      const seen = probe("child"); assert.equal(seen.planStatus, "ready");
+      assert.equal(seen.initializesGit, true); assert.equal(seen.applyStatus, "applied");
+      assert.equal(seen.gitExists, true);
+      assert.equal(seen.gitTopLevel, seen.root);
+    } },

@@ -0,0 +1,118 @@
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: SUL-1.0
+/**
+ * Report arithmetic over declared project observations. This helper neither
+ * authenticates source digests nor runs measurements or grants compliance.
+ * Limits come from the project's existing criterion, never a pipeline profile.
+ */
+export class ResourceHeadroomError extends Error {
+  constructor(message) {
+    super(message);
+    this.name = 'ResourceHeadroomError';
+    this.code = 'RESOURCE-HEADROOM-INPUT';
+  }
+}
+
+const fail = (message) => { throw new ResourceHeadroomError(message); };
+const OID = /^(?:[a-f0-9]{40}|[a-f0-9]{64})$/u;
+const SHA256 = /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/u;
+const CONTROL = /[\x00-\x1f\x7f]/u;
+const IDENTIFIER = /^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$/u;
+
+function keys(value, expected, label) {
+  if (value === null || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) fail(`${label} must be an object.`);
+  const actual = Object.keys(value);
+  if (actual.length !== expected.length || expected.some(key => !Object.hasOwn(value, key))) fail(`${label} has invalid keys.`);
+}
+
+function text(value, maximum, label, identifier = false) {
+  if (typeof value !== 'string' || value.trim() === '' || value.length > maximum
+    || CONTROL.test(value) || (identifier && !IDENTIFIER.test(value))) fail(`${label} is invalid.`);
+}
+
+function path(value) {
+  text(value, 500, 'Source reference path');
+  if (/[\\:]/u.test(value) || value.split('/').some(part => part === '' || part === '.' || part === '..')) fail('Source reference path must be repository-relative.');
+}
+
+function candidate(value) {
+  keys(value, ['commit', 'tree'], 'Candidate');
+  if (!OID.test(value.commit ?? '') || !OID.test(value.tree ?? '')
+    || typeof value.commit !== 'string' || typeof value.tree !== 'string') fail('Candidate identifiers are invalid.');
+}
+
+function ref(value, withLocator) {
+  keys(value, withLocator ? ['path', 'sha256', 'locator'] : ['path', 'sha256'], 'Source reference');
+  path(value.path);
+  if (typeof value.sha256 !== 'string' || !SHA256.test(value.sha256)) fail('Source reference digest is invalid.');
+  if (withLocator) text(value.locator, 500, 'Criterion locator');
+}
+
+function numeric(value) {
+  if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0) fail('Resource value must be a nonnegative finite number.');
+}
+
+function validateResource(value) {
+  keys(value, ['id', 'limit', 'measurement'], 'Resource');
+  text(value.id, 80, 'Resource identifier', true);
+  if (value.limit !== null) {
+    keys(value.limit, ['value', 'unit', 'sourceRef'], 'Limit');
+    numeric(value.limit.value);
+    text(value.limit.unit, 32, 'Limit unit', true);
+    ref(value.limit.sourceRef, true);
+  }
+  if (value.measurement !== null) {
+    const measurement = value.measurement;
+    keys(measurement, ['value', 'unit', 'candidate', 'limitSourceSha256', 'command', 'artifactRef', 'exitCode'], 'Measurement');
+    numeric(measurement.value);
+    text(measurement.unit, 32, 'Measurement unit', true);
+    candidate(measurement.candidate);
+    if (typeof measurement.limitSourceSha256 !== 'string' || !SHA256.test(measurement.limitSourceSha256)) fail('Measured limit-source digest is invalid.');
+    text(measurement.command, 2048, 'Measurement command');
+    ref(measurement.artifactRef, false);
+    if (!Number.isFinite(measurement.exitCode) || !Number.isInteger(measurement.exitCode)) fail('Measurement exit must be an integer.');
+  }
+}
+
+/** Pure reporting: no file access, subprocess, authority or input mutation. */
+export function reportProjectResourceHeadroom(input) {
+  keys(input, ['schema', 'candidate', 'resources'], 'Observation input');
+  if (input.schema !== 'pipeline.project-resource-observations.v1') fail('Observation schema is invalid.');
+  candidate(input.candidate);
+  if (!Array.isArray(input.resources)) fail('Resources must be an array.');
+  // Validate the whole input before returning any partial-looking result.
+  for (const resource of input.resources) validateResource(resource);
+  return {
+    schema: 'pipeline.project-resource-headroom-report.v1',
+    candidate: { ...input.candidate },
+    assurance: 'declared-observations',
+    compliance: 'not-certified',
+    resources: input.resources.map(resource => {
+      const { limit, measurement } = resource;
+      let status = 'unknown';
+      let headroom = null;
+      if (limit !== null && measurement !== null) {
+        if (measurement.candidate.commit !== input.candidate.commit
+          || measurement.candidate.tree !== input.candidate.tree
+          || measurement.limitSourceSha256 !== limit.sourceRef.sha256) status = 'stale';
+        else if (measurement.unit !== limit.unit) status = 'incompatible-units';
+        else if (measurement.exitCode !== 0) status = 'measurement-failed';
+        else {
+          headroom = limit.value - measurement.value;
+          status = headroom >= 0 ? 'within-limit' : 'exceeded';
+        }
+      }
+      return {
+        id: resource.id,
+        status,
+        unit: limit?.unit ?? measurement?.unit ?? null,
+        limit: limit?.value ?? null,
+        measured: measurement?.value ?? null,
+        headroom,
+        limitSourceRef: limit === null ? null : { ...limit.sourceRef },
+        measurementRef: measurement === null ? null : { ...measurement.artifactRef },
+        measurementCommand: measurement?.command ?? null,
+        measurementExitCode: measurement?.exitCode ?? null,
+      };
+    }),
+  };
+}

+// SPDX-License-Identifier: SUL-1.0
+// Read-only reporting inputs. Handles carry source observations, never admission.
+import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
+import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
+import { closeSync, fstatSync, lstatSync, openSync, readFileSync, realpathSync } from "node:fs";
+import { isAbsolute, relative, resolve } from "node:path";
+import { GIT_NULL_DEVICE } from "./git-null-device.mjs";
+import { resolveTrustedSystemExecutable } from "./trusted-tool-resolution.mjs";

+const OID = /^(?:[a-f0-9]{40}|[a-f0-9]{64})$/u;
+const contexts = new WeakMap();
+const MAX_BYTES = 1024 * 1024;

+function context(handle) { const value = contexts.get(handle); if (!value) fail("REPORT-SOURCE-HANDLE"); return value; }
+function oid(value) { if (typeof value !== "string" || !OID.test(value)) fail("REPORT-REF"); return value; }
+function publicPath(value) {
+  if (typeof value !== "string" || value.length === 0 || value.length > 512 || value.includes("\\")
+    || /[\0-\x1f\x7f]/u.test(value) || value.startsWith("/") || value.startsWith("-")) fail("REPORT-PUBLIC-PATH");
+  const parts = value.split("/");
+  if (parts.some(part => !part || part === "." || part === ".."
+    || /^(?:\.git|\.ssh|\.aws|\.gnupg|\.netrc|\.env(?:\..*)?|private|node_modules)$/iu.test(part))) fail("REPORT-PUBLIC-PATH");
+  return value;
+}
+function git(source, args, maxBuffer = MAX_BYTES) {
+  try { return execFileSync(source.gitPath, args, { cwd: source.root, env: source.env,
+    encoding: "buffer", stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "ignore"], timeout: 10_000, maxBuffer }); }
+  catch { fail("REPORT-GIT-UNAVAILABLE"); }
+}
+function env() {
+  const value = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(process.env).filter(([key]) => !/^GIT_/iu.test(key)));
+  return { ...value, GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1", GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM: GIT_NULL_DEVICE,
+    GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: GIT_NULL_DEVICE, GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS: "0", GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT: "0", LANG: "C", LC_ALL: "C" };

+
+/** Resolve exact commit/tree and tracked inventory without consulting mutable HEAD. */
+export function openReportCandidate({ repoRoot, candidateCommit } = {}) {
+  oid(candidateCommit);
+  if (typeof repoRoot !== "string" || !isAbsolute(repoRoot)) fail("REPORT-ROOT");
+  const root = realpathSync(repoRoot);
+  const tool = resolveTrustedSystemExecutable("git", { homeDir: null });
+  if (!tool.ok) fail("REPORT-GIT-UNAVAILABLE");
+  const source = { root, gitPath: tool.path, env: env(), files: new Map() };

+// Private implementation of runner-transcript-recovery's consented metadata lane.

+function physical(path, directory) {
+  const resolved = resolve(path);
+  if (realpathSync(resolved) !== resolved) fail('path-alias');
+  for (let part = resolved; ; part = dirname(part)) {
+    if (lstatSync(part).isSymbolicLink()) fail('path-alias');
+    if (dirname(part) === part) break;
+  }
+  const stat = lstatSync(resolved);
+  if (directory ? !stat.isDirectory() : !stat.isFile() || stat.nlink !== 1) fail('path-alias');
+  return resolved;
+}

+  physical(path, false);
+  if (constants.O_NOFOLLOW === undefined) fail('nofollow-unavailable');

+    const before = fstatSync(fd);
+    if (!before.isFile() || before.nlink !== 1) fail('path-alias');
+    const count = Math.min(before.size, cap);
+    budget.bytes += count;
+    if (budget.bytes > LIMIT.total) fail('scan-bound-exceeded');
+    const bytes = Buffer.alloc(count);
+    let offset = 0;
+    while (offset < count) {
+      const got = readSync(fd, bytes, offset, count - offset, offset);

+      offset += got;
+    }

+  }

+  return true;
+}
+
+/** No supplied session selector, storage pathname, transcript body, or read grant. */
+export function auditCurrentRunnerSession(options = {}) {
+  if (!options || typeof options !== 'object' || Array.isArray(options)
+    || Object.keys(options).some(key => !['rootDir', 'runner', 'metadataConsent', 'operation'].includes(key))

+  if (metadataConsent !== 'approved') return result('metadata-consent-required');
+  if (runner !== 'codex') return result('runner-unavailable');
+  const identity = resolveModelRoleHostSessionIdentity({ runner });
+  if (!identity.ok) return result(identity.code);

+    if (typeof rootDir !== 'string' || !isAbsolute(rootDir)) fail('repository-unavailable');
+    const root = physical(rootDir, true);
+    const configured = process.env.CODEX_HOME;
+    if (configured !== undefined && !isAbsolute(configured)) fail('storage-unavailable');
+    const storage = physical(join(configured ?? join(homedir(), '.codex'), 'sessions'), true);

+    while (queue.length) {
+      const directory = queue.pop();
+      if (++directories > LIMIT.directories || directory.depth > LIMIT.depth) fail('scan-bound-exceeded');
+      physical(directory.path, true);
+      const handle = opendirSync(directory.path);
+      try { for (let entry; (entry = handle.readSync()) !== null;) {
+        if (++entries > LIMIT.entries) fail('scan-bound-exceeded');
+        if (entry.isSymbolicLink()) fail('path-alias');
+        const path = join(directory.path, entry.name);
+        if (entry.isDirectory()) queue.push({ path, depth: directory.depth + 1 });

+          const prefix = snapshot(path, LIMIT.prefix, budget);

+          }

+      } } finally { handle.closeSync(); }
+    }
+    if (!selected) fail('current-session-unavailable');
+    if (selected.prefix.size > LIMIT.file) fail('session-bound-exceeded');
+    const current = snapshot(selected.path, LIMIT.file, budget);
+    if (current.identity !== selected.prefix.identity) fail('snapshot-changed');
+    const observed = records(current.bytes, current.bytes.at(-1) === 10);
+    if (!authenticate(observed, identity.sessionId, root)) fail('session-identity-changed');

+    for (const row of observed) {
+      if (row?.type === 'turn_context' && typeof row.payload?.model === 'string'
+        && /^(?:gpt-|codex-|o[1-9])[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,80}$/u.test(row.payload.model)) modelIdentity = row.payload.model;
+      if (row?.type === 'event_msg' && row.payload?.type === 'token_count') {
+        const usage = row.payload.info?.total_token_usage;
+        const keys = ['input_tokens', 'cached_input_tokens', 'output_tokens', 'reasoning_output_tokens', 'total_tokens'];
+        if (usage && keys.every(key => Number.isSafeInteger(usage[key]) && usage[key] >= 0)) {
+          tokenCounters = Object.fromEntries(keys.map(key => [key, usage[key]]));
+        } else tokenCounters = 'unavailable';
+      }
+    }
+    const fresh = resolveModelRoleHostSessionIdentity({ runner });
+    if (!fresh.ok || fresh.sessionId !== identity.sessionId || physical(root, true) !== root
+      || physical(storage, true) !== storage) fail('session-identity-changed');
+    return { schema: 'pipeline.runner-own-session-audit.v1', runner, status: 'available',
+      identityAssurance: 'host-environment-and-local-session-metadata',
+      sessionSha256: digest(identity.sessionId), repositorySha256: digest(root),
+      modelIdentity, phaseWallTime: 'unavailable', tokenCounters };
+  } catch (error) {
+    const known = new Set(['path-alias', 'nofollow-unavailable', 'scan-bound-exceeded', 'snapshot-changed',
+      'record-bound-exceeded', 'metadata-malformed', 'session-repository-conflict', 'repository-unavailable',
+      'storage-unavailable', 'session-identity-ambiguous', 'current-session-unavailable', 'session-bound-exceeded', 'session-identity-changed']);
+    return result(known.has(error.message) ? error.message : 'host-metadata-unavailable');
+  }
+}

+// SPDX-License-Identifier: SUL-1.0
+// Read-only scratch-custody reporting. This module never writes, stages, or
+// removes files. It emits paths, hashes and typed statuses only; artifact bytes
+// and host-absolute paths never enter the report.
+import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
+import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
+import { lstatSync, readFileSync, readdirSync, realpathSync } from "node:fs";
+import { join, relative, resolve, sep } from "node:path";
+
+export const SCRATCH_CUSTODY_SCHEMA = "pipeline.scratch-custody.v1";
+export const SCRATCH_CUSTODY_REPORT_SCHEMA = "pipeline.scratch-custody-report.v1";
+export const MAX_CUSTODY_BYTES = 8 * 1024 * 1024;
+const MAX_MARKDOWN_PATHS = 500;
+const MAX_CUSTODY_ENTRIES = 1000;
+const SHA256 = /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/u;
+const SAFE_PATH = /^(?!\/)(?!.*(?:^|\/)\.\.?($|\/))[A-Za-z0-9._-]+(?:\/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+)*$/u;
+const MANIFEST_PATH = "project/scratch-custody.v1.json";
+
+function digest(bytes) {
+  return createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex");
+}
+
+function gitBytes(root, spec) {
+  try {
+    const value = execFileSync("git", ["show", spec], {
+      cwd: root, encoding: "buffer", stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"],
+      timeout: 5000, maxBuffer: MAX_CUSTODY_BYTES + 1, windowsHide: true,
+    });
+    return value.length <= MAX_CUSTODY_BYTES ? value : null;
+  } catch {
+    return null;
+  }
+}
+
+function gitMode(root, path, view) {
+  if (typeof path !== "string" || !SAFE_PATH.test(path)) return null;
+  try {
+    const args = view === ":"
+      ? ["ls-files", "--stage", "-z", "--", path]
+      : ["ls-tree", "-z", view, "--", path];
+    const output = execFileSync("git", args, {
+      cwd: root, encoding: "utf8", stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"],
+      timeout: 5000, maxBuffer: 16 * 1024, windowsHide: true,
+    });
+    // -z gives an unquoted path and a terminal NUL. One exact stage-zero
+    // index entry is required: conflicts, aliases and extra records cannot
+    // supply a regular-file mode for the requested path.
+    const records = output.split("\0");
+    if (records.length !== 2 || records[1] !== "" || records[0] === "") return null;
+    const record = records[0];
+    const match = view === ":"
+      ? /^(100644|100755) ([0-9a-f]{40}|[0-9a-f]{64}) 0\t([^\0\t\r\n]+)$/u.exec(record)
+      : /^(100644|100755) blob ([0-9a-f]{40}|[0-9a-f]{64})\t([^\0\t\r\n]+)$/u.exec(record);

+    // OIDs, nonregular modes and unresolved stages are held.
+    if (!match || match[0] !== record || match[3] !== path || /^0+$/u.test(match[2])) return null;
+    return match[1];
+  } catch { return null; }
+}
+
+function safeRepoFile(root, rel) {
+  if (typeof rel !== "string" || !SAFE_PATH.test(rel)) return { status: "invalid-path" };
+  const absolute = resolve(root, rel);
+  const fromRoot = relative(root, absolute);
+  if (fromRoot === "" || fromRoot === ".." || fromRoot.startsWith(`..${sep}`) || fromRoot.startsWith(sep)) {
+    return { status: "invalid-path" };
+  }
+  let cursor = root;
+  try {
+    for (const part of rel.split("/")) {
+      cursor = join(cursor, part);
+      const info = lstatSync(cursor);
+      if (info.isSymbolicLink()) return { status: "symlink" };
+    }
+    const info = lstatSync(absolute);
+    if (!info.isFile()) return { status: "not-regular" };
+    if (info.nlink !== 1) return { status: "multiply-linked" };

+  const base = join(root, "scratch");

+    const physicalRoot = realpathSync(root);
+    const rel = relative(physicalRoot, realpathSync(base));

+    let entries;
+    try { entries = readdirSync(directory, { withFileTypes: true }); } catch { return; }

+      if (found.length > MAX_MARKDOWN_PATHS) return;
+      if (entry.isSymbolicLink()) continue;
+      const child = join(directory, entry.name);
+      const rel = `${prefix}/${entry.name}`;
+      let info;
+      try { info = lstatSync(child); } catch { continue; }
+      if (info.isDirectory()) walk(child, rel);
+      else if (info.isFile() && /\.md$/iu.test(entry.name) && found.length <= MAX_MARKDOWN_PATHS) found.push(rel);

+  };
+  walk(base, "scratch");

+
+function readManifest(root, view) {
+  if (view === "worktree") {
+    try {
+      execFileSync("git", ["ls-files", "--error-unmatch", "--", MANIFEST_PATH], {
+        cwd: root, encoding: "utf8", stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"],
+        timeout: 5000, maxBuffer: 16 * 1024, windowsHide: true,
+      });
+    } catch { return { status: "manifest-untracked", entries: [] }; }
+  }

+      || (entry.disposition !== "durable" && entry.disposition !== "not-durable")

+  }

+
+function observedBytes(root, path, view) {
+  if (view === "worktree") return safeRepoFile(root, path);
+  const bytes = gitBytes(root, view === ":" ? `:${path}` : `${view}:${path}`);
+  const mode = gitMode(root, path, view);
+  return bytes && mode ? { status: "readable", bytes, sha256: digest(bytes), mode } : { status: "missing-or-unreadable" };
+}
+
+function gitPathAbsent(root, path, view) {
+  try {
+    const args = view === ":" ? ["ls-files", "--stage", "-z", "--", path]
+      : ["ls-tree", "-z", view, "--", path];
+    const output = execFileSync("git", args, {
+      cwd: root, encoding: "utf8", stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"],
+      timeout: 5000, maxBuffer: 16 * 1024, windowsHide: true,
+    });
+    // An invalid mode, conflicted entry, unreadable view or transport failure
+    // is not absence and cannot enable the physical-source fallback.
+    return output === "";
+  } catch { return false; }
+}
+
+function ignoredScratchSource(root, path) {
+  try {
+    execFileSync("git", ["check-ignore", "--quiet", "--", path], {
+      cwd: root, stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"],
+      timeout: 5000, maxBuffer: 16 * 1024, windowsHide: true,
+    });
+    return true;
+  } catch { return false; }
+}
+
+function checkEntry(root, entry, view) {
+  // Local scratch may deliberately remain ignored. The selected Git manifest
+  // supplies the expected digest; durability comes from its regular public
+  // counterpart in that SAME view, never from publishing the scratch source.
+  // Preserve existing tracked-source historical views when they are present.
+  let source = observedBytes(root, entry.path, view);
+  if (view !== "worktree" && view !== ":" && source.status === "missing-or-unreadable"
+    && gitPathAbsent(root, entry.path, view) && ignoredScratchSource(root, entry.path)
+    && gitMode(root, MANIFEST_PATH, view) !== null) {
+    source = safeRepoFile(root, entry.path);
+  }
+  if (source.status !== "readable") return { path: entry.path, disposition: entry.disposition, status: source.status };
+  if (source.sha256 !== entry.sha256) return { path: entry.path, disposition: entry.disposition, status: "source-mismatch", sourceSha256: source.sha256, sourceMode: source.mode };
+  if (entry.disposition === "not-durable") {
+    return { path: entry.path, disposition: "not-durable", status: "not-durable", reason: entry.reason, sourceSha256: source.sha256, sourceMode: source.mode };
+  }
+  const counterpart = observedBytes(root, entry.counterpartPath, view);
+  if (counterpart.status !== "readable") return { path: entry.path, disposition: "durable", counterpartPath: entry.counterpartPath, status: counterpart.status, sourceSha256: source.sha256, sourceMode: source.mode };
+  if (counterpart.sha256 !== entry.sha256) return { path: entry.path, disposition: "durable", counterpartPath: entry.counterpartPath, status: "counterpart-mismatch", sourceSha256: source.sha256, counterpartSha256: counterpart.sha256, sourceMode: source.mode, counterpartMode: counterpart.mode };
+  if (counterpart.mode !== source.mode) return { path: entry.path, disposition: "durable", counterpartPath: entry.counterpartPath, status: "counterpart-mode-mismatch", sourceSha256: source.sha256, counterpartSha256: counterpart.sha256, sourceMode: source.mode, counterpartMode: counterpart.mode };
+  const status = view === "worktree" ? "scratch-only"
+    : view === ":" ? "staged-only"
+      : view === "HEAD" ? "durable" : "durable-for-push";
+  return { path: entry.path, disposition: "durable", counterpartPath: entry.counterpartPath, status, sourceSha256: source.sha256, counterpartSha256: counterpart.sha256, sourceMode: source.mode, counterpartMode: counterpart.mode };
+}
+
+/** Bounded report over worktree, index, HEAD, and an optional exact push commit. */
+export function reportScratchCustody({ root, pushCommit = null } = {}) {
+  const canonicalRoot = resolve(root);
+  const markdown = listMarkdown(canonicalRoot);
+  const markdownTruncated = markdown.length > MAX_MARKDOWN_PATHS;
+  const visibleMarkdown = markdown.slice(0, MAX_MARKDOWN_PATHS);
+  const views = ["worktree", ":", "HEAD", ...(pushCommit ? [pushCommit] : [])];
+  const viewNames = ["scratch-only", "staged", "HEAD", ...(pushCommit ? ["pushed"] : [])];
+  const results = views.map((view, index) => {
+    const manifest = readManifest(canonicalRoot, view);
+    if (manifest.status !== "ok") return { view: viewNames[index], status: manifest.status, entries: [], unclassifiedMarkdown: visibleMarkdown };
+    const paths = new Set(manifest.entries.map((entry) => entry.path.normalize("NFC").toLowerCase()));
+    return {
+      view: viewNames[index], status: "checked",
+      entries: manifest.entries.map((entry) => checkEntry(canonicalRoot, entry, view)),
+      unclassifiedMarkdown: visibleMarkdown.filter((path) => !paths.has(path.normalize("NFC").toLowerCase())),
+    };
+  });
+  if (!pushCommit) results.push({ view: "pushed", status: "candidate-unavailable", entries: [], unclassifiedMarkdown: [] });
+  const warnings = [];
+  for (const result of results) {
+    if (result.status !== "checked") warnings.push({ code: result.status, view: result.view });
+    if (result.unclassifiedMarkdown.length) warnings.push({ code: "unclassified-markdown", view: result.view, paths: result.unclassifiedMarkdown });
+    for (const entry of result.entries) {
+      const durableForView = result.view === "HEAD" ? "durable" : result.view === "pushed" ? "durable-for-push" : null;
+      if (entry.status !== durableForView) warnings.push({ code: `custody-${entry.status}`, view: result.view, path: entry.path });
+    }
+  }
+  if (markdownTruncated) warnings.push({ code: "unclassified-markdown-scan-truncated", maximumPaths: MAX_MARKDOWN_PATHS });
+  return { schema: SCRATCH_CUSTODY_REPORT_SCHEMA, mode: "report-only", warnings, views: results };
+}

+const owners = Object.freeze([
+  ['onboarding-continuity', onboarding, 'OnboardingContinuity'],
+  ['human-guard-override', hgo, 'HumanGuardOverride'],
+  ['chat-gate', chat, 'ChatGate'],

+  ['afk-ledger', afk, 'AfkLedger'],
+  ['session-power', power, 'SessionPower'],
+  ['local-worker-supervisor', worker, 'LocalWorkerSupervisor'],

+  const error = new Error(reason);
+  error.name = 'SessionAuthorityObserverError';
+  error.code = 'SDC-AUTHORITY-UNAVAILABLE';

+  error.reason = reason;

+  if(parent.executable!==floor.program.executable.path||floor.program.cwd!==c.binding.repository.primaryRoot)osvFail('OSV-INPUT-DRIFT');
+  if(!Array.isArray(floor.program.nativePrivateRefs)||floor.program.nativePrivateRefs.length<2||floor.program.nativePrivateRefs.length>3)osvFail('OSV-INPUT-DRIFT');

+function osvWindowsEvidence(path,maxBytes,json){

+}
+
+// Initial approved Controller custody is a Source event, never a portable grant.
+const approvedControllerRuntimes=new Map();
+function approvedControllerCourse(rootDir,currentStatePath=null){
+  let observed;
+  if(currentStatePath===null)observed=continuityVerificationIssuer.observeSessionCleanupState(rootDir);
+  else{
+    // The existing I03 bind owns a temporary private-binding/State publication
+    // interval. Recheck real approval bytes here; I03 retains its own private
+    // tuple/member CAS, rather than recursively inspecting that interval.
+    const before=osvPhysicalRef(currentStatePath),bytes=readFileSync(currentStatePath);
+    if(hash(bytes)!==before.sha256)osvFail('OSV-INPUT-DRIFT');
+    osvSame(before,osvPhysicalRef(currentStatePath));
+    observed={path:currentStatePath,state:parseStrictJson(bytes),stateSha256:before.sha256};
+  }
+  const state=observed.state;
+  if((currentStatePath===null&&(!observed.neutral||observed.mode!=='active'||observed.orphanBinding))||state?.schema!=='pipeline.state.v0'||state?.planApproved!==true
+    ||!state.activeFeature||typeof state.activeFeature.id!=='string')osvFail('OSV-COURSE-UNAVAILABLE');
+  const submission=state.planSubmission;
+  if(!submission||typeof submission.planPath!=='string'||typeof submission.specPath!=='string')osvFail('OSV-COURSE-UNAVAILABLE');
+  const paths=[submission.planPath,submission.specPath];
+  const refs=paths.map(path=>{if(typeof path!=='string'||isAbsolute(path)||path.includes('\\')||path.split('/').some(p=>!p||p==='.'||p==='..'))osvFail('OSV-COURSE-UNAVAILABLE');return osvPhysicalRef(resolve(rootDir,path));});
+  const lifecycle=deriveApprovedControllerPlanLifecycle(state,{planSha256:refs[0].sha256,specSha256:refs[1].sha256});
+  if(!lifecycle.ok||lifecycle.approvalCurrent!==true||!['approved','implementing'].includes(lifecycle.status))osvFail('OSV-COURSE-UNAVAILABLE');
+  const accepted=state.planApproval?.acceptedContract;
+  if(accepted){const read=readApprovedControllerAcceptedContract({dir:rootDir,envelopePath:accepted.path});
+    if(!read.ok||read.envelopeSha256!==accepted.sha256)osvFail('OSV-COURSE-UNAVAILABLE');
+    refs.push(osvPhysicalRef(resolve(rootDir,accepted.path)));}
+  const selectedStateRef=osvPhysicalRef(observed.path);
+  // Reobserve the real state reader after physical capture; no caller JSON is accepted.
+  if(currentStatePath===null){const again=continuityVerificationIssuer.observeSessionCleanupState(rootDir);
+    if(digest(again.state)!==digest(state)||again.path!==observed.path||again.revision!==observed.revision)osvFail('OSV-INPUT-DRIFT');}

+}
+function approvedControllerProgram(rootDir){
+  const controller=osvObservedProcess(process.pid),program=osvProgram(controller);
