+/** Fixed production entry only; no session/PID/origin/dependency issuer inputs. */
+export function createSourceOwnedApprovedControllerRequesterRuntime(input){
+  osvExact(input,['rootDir']);
+  if(typeof input.rootDir!=='string'||!isAbsolute(input.rootDir)||resolve(input.rootDir)!==input.rootDir)osvFail('OSV-OWNER-UNAVAILABLE');
+  const r=retiredDescriptorOwner.inspectSignedDescriptorCustodyRepository(input.rootDir);
+  if(r.primaryRoot!==input.rootDir||approvedControllerRuntimes.has(repositoryHash(r)))osvFail('OSV-REPLAY');
+  const capture=approvedControllerProgram(r.primaryRoot),approved=approvedControllerCourse(r.primaryRoot);
+  if(approved.observed.sessionCleanup!==null)osvFail('OSV-OWNER-UNAVAILABLE');
+  const key=repositoryHash(r),lifetime={live:true};approvedControllerRuntimes.set(key,lifetime);
+  let runtimePort;
+  try{
+    // All checks precede the unchanged Source-owned descriptor producer.
+    const started=startSessionDescriptor(r.primaryRoot,{sessionId:'controller-'+randomBytes(12).toString('hex')});
+    const descriptorHandle=createSourceOwnedDescriptorHandle({repository:r,sessionId:started.sessionId,expectedDescriptorSha256:started.descriptorSha256,ownerNonceFile:null});
+    const source={schema:'pipeline.approved-owning-controller-invocation.v1',repositorySha256:key,process:capture.controller,
+      program:capture.program,taskSourceRef:capture.taskSourceRef,suiteId:capture.suiteId,course:approved.course,
+      approvalRefs:approved.refs,initialStateRef:approved.selectedStateRef,assurance:'physical-readback',eventId:randomBytes(16).toString('hex')};
+    const sourceRef=publish(r,join(ensureNamespace(r),'invocations','controller-'+randomBytes(12).toString('hex')+'.json'),source);
+    runtimePort=runtimePortFor({repository:r,disposed:false,children:new Set()});
+    const recheck=()=>{
+      if(!lifetime.live)osvFail('OSV-OWNER-UNAVAILABLE');
+      const freshProgram=approvedControllerProgram(r.primaryRoot),freshCourse=approvedControllerCourse(r.primaryRoot,approved.selectedStateRef.path);
+      if(!osvSameProcess(capture.controller,freshProgram.controller))osvFail('OSV-OWNER-UNAVAILABLE');
+      osvSame(capture.program,freshProgram.program);osvSame(capture.taskSourceRef,freshProgram.taskSourceRef);
+      osvSame(approved.course,freshCourse.course);osvSame(approved.refs,freshCourse.refs);readPrivate(r,sourceRef);
+    };
+    const currentInvocationHandle=opaque(invocations,{repository:r,process:capture.controller,sourceRef,
+      invocationBindingSha256:digest(source),producerId:'approved-owning-controller',assurance:'physical-readback',port:runtimePort,sourceOwnerRecheck:recheck});
+    const bound=bindSourceOwnedRequesterInvocation({repository:r,descriptorHandle,currentInvocationHandle},runtimePort);
+    return Object.freeze({descriptorHandle,currentInvocationHandle,runtimePort,...bound,
+      sessionCleanup:Object.freeze({sessionId:started.sessionId,descriptorSha256:started.descriptorSha256}),
+      expectedStateSha256:approved.selectedStateRef.sha256,expectedRevision:approved.observed.revision,
+      run:callback=>withSourceOwnedAuthorityContext({requesterHandle:bound.requesterHandle,runtimePort},callback),
+      dispose:async()=>{lifetime.live=false;const port=ports.get(runtimePort);port.disposed=true;
+        // Expiry never releases descriptor/history or a still-held Registry member.
+        return {status:[...port.children].some(child=>!child.closed)?'held':'closed',sourceRefs:[sourceRef,bound.bindingRef]};}});
+  }catch(error){lifetime.live=false;if(runtimePort)ports.get(runtimePort).disposed=true;throw error;}
+}
+
+/** Read-only current-course facts for preflight; never an enrollment grant. */
+export function inspectSourceOwnedApprovedControllerCourse(input){
+  osvExact(input,['rootDir']);
+  if(typeof input.rootDir!=='string'||!isAbsolute(input.rootDir)||resolve(input.rootDir)!==input.rootDir)osvFail('OSV-OWNER-UNAVAILABLE');
+  const repository=retiredDescriptorOwner.inspectSignedDescriptorCustodyRepository(input.rootDir);
+  if(repository.primaryRoot!==input.rootDir)osvFail('OSV-OWNER-UNAVAILABLE');
+  const approved=approvedControllerCourse(repository.primaryRoot);
+  if(approved.observed.sessionCleanup!==null)osvFail('OSV-OWNER-UNAVAILABLE');
+  osvSame(repository,retiredDescriptorOwner.inspectSignedDescriptorCustodyRepository(input.rootDir));

+  const freeze=value=>{if(value&&typeof value==='object'){Object.values(value).forEach(freeze);Object.freeze(value);}return value;};

+    approvalRefs:approved.refs,expectedStateSha256:approved.selectedStateRef.sha256,
+    expectedRevision:approved.observed.revision,sessionCleanup:null});
+}

+// SPDX-License-Identifier: SUL-1.0
+// Shared declarative suite schema/loader. The harness and installed runtime use
+// this one plugin-local implementation; loading it does not run Verify.
+import {existsSync,readFileSync} from 'node:fs';
+import {validateVerifyOwningControllerMetadata} from './verify-owning-controller-route.mjs';
+
+export function validateDeclarativeVerifySuites(data) {
+  if (!data || typeof data !== "object" || Array.isArray(data)) {
+    return { ok: false, error: "root must be an object" };
+  }
+  const allowedRootKeys = new Set(["schema", "suites"]);
+  for (const key of Object.keys(data)) {
+    if (!allowedRootKeys.has(key)) {
+      return { ok: false, error: `unexpected root property "${key}"` };
+    }
+  }
+  if (data.schema !== "pipeline.verify-suites.v1") {
+    return { ok: false, error: `schema must be "pipeline.verify-suites.v1", got ${JSON.stringify(data.schema)}` };
+  }
+  if (!Array.isArray(data.suites)) {
+    return { ok: false, error: "suites must be an array" };
+  }
+  for (let i = 0; i < data.suites.length; i++) {
+    const suite = data.suites[i];
+    if (!suite || typeof suite !== "object" || Array.isArray(suite)) {
+      return { ok: false, error: `suites[${i}] must be an object` };
+    }
+    const allowedKeys = new Set(["name", "file", "caseCompletion", "durationMs", "invariantPinned", "nonOverlapNote", "owningController", "owningControllerSupport"]);
+    for (const key of Object.keys(suite)) {
+      if (!allowedKeys.has(key)) {
+        return { ok: false, error: `suites[${i}] has unexpected property "${key}"` };
+      }
+    }
+    const owningRoute = validateVerifyOwningControllerMetadata(suite);
+    if (!owningRoute.ok) return { ok: false, error: `suites[${i}] ${owningRoute.error}` };
+    if (typeof suite.name !== "string" || suite.name.length === 0) {
+      return { ok: false, error: `suites[${i}].name must be a non-empty string` };
+    }
+    if (typeof suite.file !== "string" || suite.file.length === 0) {
+      return { ok: false, error: `suites[${i}].file must be a non-empty string` };
+    }
+        if (suite.durationMs !== undefined && typeof suite.durationMs !== "number") {
+      return { ok: false, error: `suites[${i}].durationMs must be a number` };
+    }
+    if (suite.invariantPinned !== undefined && (typeof suite.invariantPinned !== "string" || suite.invariantPinned.trim().length === 0)) {
+      return { ok: false, error: `suites[${i}].invariantPinned must be a non-empty string` };
+    }
+    if (suite.nonOverlapNote !== undefined && (typeof suite.nonOverlapNote !== "string" || suite.nonOverlapNote.trim().length === 0)) {
+      return { ok: false, error: `suites[${i}].nonOverlapNote must be a non-empty string` };
+    }
+    if (suite.caseCompletion !== undefined) {
+      const cc = suite.caseCompletion;
+      if (!cc || typeof cc !== "object" || Array.isArray(cc)) {
+        return { ok: false, error: `suites[${i}].caseCompletion must be an object` };
+      }
+      const allowedCCKeys = new Set(["schema", "caseIds", "maxBytes"]);
+      for (const key of Object.keys(cc)) {
+        if (!allowedCCKeys.has(key)) {
+          return { ok: false, error: `suites[${i}].caseCompletion has unexpected property "${key}"` };
+        }
+      }
+      if (cc.schema !== "pipeline.verify-case-completion-policy.v1") {
+        return { ok: false, error: `suites[${i}].caseCompletion.schema must be "pipeline.verify-case-completion-policy.v1"` };
+      }
+      if (!Array.isArray(cc.caseIds) || !cc.caseIds.every((id) => typeof id === "string")) {
+        return { ok: false, error: `suites[${i}].caseCompletion.caseIds must be an array of strings` };
+      }
+      if (!Number.isSafeInteger(cc.maxBytes) || cc.maxBytes < 512) {
+        return { ok: false, error: `suites[${i}].caseCompletion.maxBytes must be an integer >= 512` };
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  return { ok: true };
+}
+
+export function loadDeclarativeVerifySuites(declarativePath) {
+  if (!existsSync(declarativePath)) {
+    return { ok: true, exists: false, suites: [] };
+  }
+  let raw;
+  try {
+    raw = readFileSync(declarativePath, "utf8");
+  } catch (error) {
+    return { ok: false, exists: true, errorType: "READ-ERROR", error: `could not read ${declarativePath} (${error.code ?? error.message})` };
+  }
+  let data;
+  try {
+    data = JSON.parse(raw);
+  } catch (error) {
+    return { ok: false, exists: true, errorType: "PARSE-ERROR", error: `could not parse ${declarativePath} (${error.message})` };
+  }
+  const validation = validateDeclarativeVerifySuites(data);
+  if (!validation.ok) {
+    return { ok: false, exists: true, errorType: "SCHEMA-ERROR", error: `${declarativePath} does not conform to pipeline.verify-suites.v1: ${validation.error}` };
+  }
+  return { ok: true, exists: true, suites: data.suites };
+}

+// Native read-only process facts. No invocation/requester brand or authority is issued.
+import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';

+import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';

+import {readWindowsAuthoritySourceModule,observeWindowsAuthorityAncestor} from './windows-owned-authority-backend.mjs';
+import {isSuccessfulSpawn} from './successful-spawn.mjs';
+import {parseStrictJson} from './governance-event.mjs';
+
+const HELPER_SHA256='6c55d97eba1c18ef37befab1c6e6052301f8ecc0b90d1521a49e158a49fc4d40';
+const HELPER=fileURLToPath(new URL('./windows-native-process-observer.ps1',import.meta.url));

+const processKeys=[...nativeKeys.filter(key=>key!=='status'),'platform','argvSha256','cwd'];
+const digest=value=>createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');
+const exact=(value,keys)=>value!==null&&typeof value==='object'&&!Array.isArray(value)&&Object.keys(value).sort().join(',')===[...keys].sort().join(',');
+const unavailable=reason=>Object.freeze({status:'unavailable',reason});
+const pid=value=>Number.isSafeInteger(value)&&value>=1&&value<=2147483647;
+const sha=value=>typeof value==='string'&&SHA.test(value);
+const ticks=value=>typeof value==='string'&&TICKS.test(value)&&BigInt(value)<=3155378975999999999n;
+const sid=value=>typeof value==='string'&&value.length<=184&&SID.test(value);

+ return exact(value,nativeKeys)&&value.status==='present'&&pid(value.pid)&&pid(value.parentPid)&&value.pid!==value.parentPid
+  &&ticks(value.start)&&ticks(value.parentStart)&&BigInt(value.parentStart)<=BigInt(value.start)
+  &&Number.isSafeInteger(value.sessionId)&&value.sessionId>=0&&value.sessionId<=4294967295
+  &&sid(value.principalSid)&&sid(value.parentPrincipalSid)&&path(value.executable)
+  &&sha(value.executableSha256)&&sha(value.executableFactsSha256)&&sha(value.commandLineSha256)
+  &&typeof value.bootIdentity==='string'&&value.bootIdentity.startsWith('win32-boot-')&&ticks(value.bootIdentity.slice(11))
+  &&BigInt(value.bootIdentity.slice(11))<=BigInt(value.parentStart)
+  &&Array.isArray(value.argv)&&value.argv.length>=1&&value.argv.length<=256
+  &&value.argv.every(arg=>typeof arg==='string'&&arg.length<=32768&&!arg.includes('\0'))

+}
+function currentCwd(){
+ const named=process.cwd(),resolved=realpathSync(named),stat=lstatSync(named);

+}
+function sameCwd(a,b){return a.path===b.path&&a.dev===b.dev&&a.ino===b.ino&&a.facts===b.facts&&a.hash===b.hash;}
+
+/** No injectable runner/platform/record can assert native observations. */
+export function observeNativeWindowsProcess(input){

+  });

+ }catch{return unavailable('WPO-OBSERVATION-UNAVAILABLE');}

+
+function validProcess(value){
+ if(!exact(value,processKeys)||value.platform!=='win32'||!sha(value.argvSha256)||(value.cwd!==null&&!path(value.cwd)))return false;
+ const {platform,argvSha256,cwd,...native}=value;
+ return validNative({status:'present',...native})&&argvSha256===digest(JSON.stringify(native.argv));
+}
+/** Equality is observation only; it neither creates nor validates an authority handle. */
+export function sameNativeWindowsProcess(expected,observed){
+ if(!validProcess(expected)||!validProcess(observed))return false;
+ return processKeys.filter(key=>key!=='argv').every(key=>expected[key]===observed[key])
+  &&expected.argv.length===observed.argv.length&&expected.argv.every((arg,index)=>arg===observed.argv[index]);
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,198 @@
+# Reader-review protocol
+
+Reader review evaluates comprehensibility, order, granularity and weighting.
+It is separate from technical Critic review and implementation verification.
+
+## Bounded 2+1 course
+
+Freeze the checker's complete document set at each reviewed commit. Run two
+fresh read-only readers: phase one receives only the frozen public documents;
+phase two receives those documents, the immutable phase-one report, capability
+inventory, governance input and this protocol. Preserve reports unchanged.
+One paired round means both stages, not two independent round credits.
+
+New courses have two regular paired rounds: a complete review and correction
+batch, then a fresh re-review and second correction batch. Round two may be
+corrections-only or honestly disclosed complete. Every round receives the full
+frozen document set and may flag surrounding regressions. One optional third
+paired round must be complete and requires a committed, digest-bound
+justification after round two and before either third-round reader launches.
+Apply a final correction batch after that round. There are at most three
+paired rounds and three correction batches. No new course may launch a fourth.
+
+Count a batch once across multiple commits. Preserve the same course ID,
+reviewed snapshots, report pairs, counts, batches and remaining findings across
+edits, commits, restarts and evidence renaming. Deleting a report or making an
+evidence-only commit does not reset the course. A clean round with no further
+public-document edits closes through the ordinary v1 binding; this includes a
+single clean round. At terminal correction, every finding needs an exact
+resolution commit or explicit documentation-owner acceptance. An unresolved
+finding leaves the course open and cannot yield a passing source binding.
+Distinct new documentation scope may require a new course, but cannot erase
+outstanding previous findings. Do not silently start another course for the
+same findings. Record existing authority; this is no new PO approval gate.
+
+## Fixed committed inputs
+
+The lexical, unique `READER_REVIEW_PATHS` in
+`harness/scripts/check-doc-reader-binding.mjs` owns the sixteen public document
+paths. Evidence, state, archives, ADRs and backlog content are excluded. Inputs
+are `docs/product-capability-inventory.json`,
+`governance/observation-doc-governance.json` and this protocol. Read raw Git
+blobs only: covered files must be mode 100644, at most 512 KiB each and 4 MiB
+combined; inputs are at most 1 MiB each. SHA-256 identity uses the actual NUL:
+
+```
+SHA-256("pipeline.doc-reader-docset.v1\0" + canonicalJson({
+  coverage: [{ path, sha256 }, ...],
+  capabilityInventorySha256, governanceSha256, readerProtocolSha256
+}))
+```
+
+Snapshots discover committed inputs; they are not Reader evidence.
+
+## Ordinary unchanged-state binding
+
+`pipeline.doc-reader-binding-record.v1` remains valid. It has exactly `schema`,
+`reviewedCommit`, `reviewedTree`, `docsetSha256`, `coverage`, `inputs`,
+`phaseOne`, `phaseTwo`, `disposition`. The full reviewed commit is an ancestor
+of the candidate, its tree is exact, and coverage/inputs/docset must equal both
+committed states. Report and disposition references have exactly `path` and
+`sha256`, under `specs/<feature-id>/evidence/reader-review/phase-one/`,
+`phase-two/` and `disposition/`, with one matching safe round ID.
+
+Reports are distinct, nonempty UTF-8 regular blobs, at most 1 MiB each.
+Disposition is at most 256 KiB. Its closed schema is
+`pipeline.doc-reader-disposition.v1`, with `schema`, `round`, `status`,
+`findings`. `no-findings` requires an empty array; `resolved` a nonempty one.
+Each finding has `id`, `class`, `status`, `resolutionCommit`. Unique safe IDs,
+classes `cut`, `fileline`, `reordering`, and statuses `resolved`, `no-change`
+are required. A resolved commit must be real and an ancestor of the reviewed
+state; no-change requires null. Commit reports/disposition, then `record.json`
+last. Covered document or input drift invalidates this binding.
+
+## Terminal correction binding for new courses
+
+`pipeline.doc-reader-terminal-record.v2` at the same `record.json` path
+distinguishes the last reviewed state from the final editorially corrected
+state. It does not claim that the final correction was freshly read. Its exact
+closed field set is `schema`, `courseId`, `rounds`, `correctionBatches`,
+`ownerDecision`, `final`, `policyTransition`, `escalation`.
+
+| Field | Contract |
+| --- | --- |
+| `schema`, `courseId` | Exact v2 schema and safe course identifier. |
+| `rounds` | Two or three ordered entries, each `id`, `mode`, `reviewed`, `phaseOne`, `phaseTwo`, `disposition`. |
+| `correctionBatches` | Same length as `rounds`; each `afterRound` (1..2 or 1..3) and 1..32 ordered unique correction `commits`. |
+| `ownerDecision` | Exact `path`/`sha256` reference to committed `owner-decision.json`. |
+| `final` | Exact snapshot of the final correction commit. |
+| `policyTransition` | Null if protocol bytes match; otherwise exact `fromSha256`, `toSha256`, `commit`. |
+| `escalation` | Null for two rounds; for three, exactly `afterRound: 2`, `reason`, `source`. |
+
+The escalation reason must be nonblank and at most 500 characters. Its source
+has exactly `path` and `sha256`, referencing committed justification introduced
+after round two and before the third reviewed state. Commit that justification
+before launching either reader for the third round. Reject missing, late,
+malformed or mismatched justification; a two-round record cannot carry an
+escalation. The closure checker binds publication timing and bytes, not actual
+launch timing or the truthfulness of the reason.
+
+Every `reviewed` and `final` snapshot has exactly `commit`, `tree`, `coverage`,
+`inputs`, `docsetSha256`; recompute all bytes and identities. Modes are
+`complete` for round one and optional round three; round two is
+`corrections-only` or honestly disclosed `complete`. Each batch follows its
+reviewed commit and precedes the next reviewed state (or final state). Its
+commit list must equal the Git history of covered document/input changes in
+that interval. Evidence-only commits do not count as document correction
+commits. Historical reviewed coverage comes from the literal
+`READER_REVIEW_PATHS` array in that round's committed checker, parsed as data
+without executing old code. It must be unique, lexical and within the current
+public scope. Bind that actual coverage and its digest; do not invent earlier
+review of a document added in a later correction. Final/candidate coverage
+still uses the current fixed set. Missing or malformed historical scope
+declarations fail.
+
+Every report reference has `path`, `sha256`, `publication`. Publication has
+exactly `kind` (`raw` or `path-normalized`) and `rawSha256`. Raw publication
+requires equality with the public digest. A normalized copy discloses the
+private raw digest without publishing private bytes or pretending byte
+identity. The checker binds the public copy's first committed publication,
+and rejects subsequent rewrites or delete/re-add histories.
+
+Each matching disposition uses `pipeline.doc-reader-terminal-disposition.v1`
+and exactly `schema`, `round`, `status: resolved`, `findings` (1..256 entries).
+Findings have `id`, `class`, `status`, `resolutionCommit`, as above. A `resolved`
+finding names a commit in that round's correction batch. An `accepted` finding
+requires null and its exact `<round>/<finding-id>` in the owner's acceptance
+list. Open, unknown, duplicated or malformed findings fail. An empty earlier
+round belongs to early ordinary closure rather than a manufactured terminal
+course. This disposition contract is unchanged; no `openFindings` key belongs
+in terminal v2.
+
+The closed owner record uses
+`pipeline.doc-reader-terminal-owner-decision.v2` with exactly `schema`,
+`courseId`, `authority: documentation-owner`, `by`,
+`decision: authorize-terminal-correction`, `maxRounds: 3`,
+`maxCorrectionBatches: 3`, `prohibitFourthReview: true`,
+`lastReviewedCommit`, `acceptedFindingIds`, `source`. `lastReviewedCommit`
+equals the last round's reviewed commit. Source is a digest-bound reference to
+the adopted Reader skill, this protocol, or a safe Markdown course-decision
+document directly under the feature's Reader evidence root. It records existing
+authority; the JSON is not a signature or proof of human identity. Acceptance
+keys must exactly match findings actually marked accepted.
+
+Reject extra committed round evidence, including a fourth report subsequently
+deleted from the candidate. Capability inventory and governance must match
+the last reviewed inputs. A protocol change must be an explicit transition in
+the final batch, bound to its actual committed bytes. Candidate coverage and
+all inputs must match `final`; later drift fails. Publish reports, dispositions
+and owner evidence, then commit the terminal record last.
+
+## Historical v1 compatibility
+
+Historically completed ordinary v1 and terminal v1 bindings remain valid under
+their unchanged validation contracts. Preserve exact historical evidence
+bytes, schemas, counters, reports and decisions; do not migrate them to v2.
+Historical terminal v1 uses `pipeline.doc-reader-terminal-record.v1`, exactly
+four rounds and four batches, and its existing closed fields without
+`escalation`. Its modes remain complete in rounds one/three, and
+corrections-only or honestly disclosed complete in rounds two/four. Its owner
+schema remains `pipeline.doc-reader-terminal-owner-decision.v1`, with
+`maxRounds: 4`, `maxCorrectionBatches: 4`, `prohibitFifthReview: true`, and
+`fourthReviewedCommit`; other owner fields and values remain identical. Its
+unchanged checks retain fourth-reviewed inventory/governance equality, no fifth
+evidence, publication immutability, exhaustive correction commits, final
+equality and explicit protocol transition.
+
+An incomplete historical four-round record can be completed only under its
+already-established historical decision and unchanged v1 requirements. Derive
+the adoption boundary from committed policy/course evidence, never a
+caller-supplied legacy boolean. Neither this compatibility rule nor a schema
+conversion grants permission to launch a new fourth round or repairs existing
+drift, provenance or finding gaps.
+
+The checker validates Git bytes, ancestry, bounds and declared dispositions.
+It cannot prove reader identity/freshness, sandbox isolation, truthfulness,
+semantic finding completeness, whether an edit resolves prose, or ownership
+from a JSON claim. Retain honest host provenance and the immutable reports.
+Do not substitute coordinator self-review or fabricate a final Reader verdict.
+Closure validation does not provide a shipped prelaunch course controller.
+
+## Checker and release interface
+
+```
+node harness/scripts/check-doc-reader-binding.mjs \
+  --root <root> --candidate <full40hex> --feature-id <safe-id> [--snapshot]
+```
+
+Unknown, duplicate and incomplete arguments fail. The check returns
+`pipeline.doc-reader-binding-check.v1`, `passed`/`failed`, candidate and actual
+reviewed identities, final docset digest, findings and
+`committed-state-and-evidence-presence-only` assurance. Exit codes remain 0 for
+pass, 1 for findings, 2 for usage/environment errors. `--snapshot` returns
+`pipeline.doc-reader-docset-snapshot.v1`, never review success.
+
+Source release preflight accepts only the exact committed checker result and
+candidate-matching local checker/dependency bytes. It does not launch Reader
+agents. Complete a valid ordinary or terminal binding before freezing the
+release candidate; release gates remain separate.

+#!/usr/bin/env node
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: SUL-1.0
+import { resolve } from "node:path";
+import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
+import { openReportCandidate } from "../lib/report-source-readers.mjs";
+import { reportCandidateImplementationCoverage } from "../lib/candidate-implementation-coverage-report.mjs";
+import { reportDeclaredCriteriaEvidence } from "../lib/declared-criteria-evidence-report.mjs";
+
+export function runAcceptanceCoverageReport(argv = process.argv.slice(2)) {
+  const options = {}, receiptPaths = [];
+  const allowed = new Set(["--kind", "--root", "--candidate", "--base", "--spec", "--verify", "--receipt"]);
+  try {
+    if (!Array.isArray(argv) || argv.length > 142 || argv.some(value => typeof value !== "string" || value.length > 4096)) throw Error("REPORT-ARGUMENTS");
+    for (let index = 0; index < argv.length; index += 2) {
+      const key = argv[index], value = argv[index + 1];
+      if (!allowed.has(key) || typeof value !== "string" || !value || value.startsWith("--")
+        || (key !== "--receipt" && Object.hasOwn(options, key))) throw Error("REPORT-ARGUMENTS");
+      if (key === "--receipt") receiptPaths.push(value); else options[key] = value;
+    }
+    if (!["candidate", "criteria", "both"].includes(options["--kind"]) || !options["--candidate"]
+      || (options["--kind"] === "candidate" && (options["--spec"] || options["--verify"] || receiptPaths.length))) throw Error("REPORT-ARGUMENTS");
+    const handle = openReportCandidate({ repoRoot: resolve(options["--root"] ?? process.cwd()), candidateCommit: options["--candidate"] });
+    const result = { schema: "pipeline.acceptance-coverage-report.v1", reportOnly: true, completionEffect: "none" };
+    if (options["--kind"] !== "criteria") result.candidateCoverage = reportCandidateImplementationCoverage(handle, { baseCommit: options["--base"] });
+    if (options["--kind"] !== "candidate") result.criteriaEvidence = reportDeclaredCriteriaEvidence(handle, { specPath: options["--spec"], verifyPath: options["--verify"], receiptPaths });
+    return { exitCode: 0, report: result };
+  } catch (error) {
+    return { exitCode: error.message === "REPORT-ARGUMENTS" ? 2 : 0,
+      report: { schema: "pipeline.acceptance-coverage-report.v1", reportOnly: true, completionEffect: "none", state: "unavailable", code: error.code ?? "REPORT-ARGUMENTS-OR-SOURCE-UNAVAILABLE" } };
+  }
+}
+if (process.argv[1] && resolve(process.argv[1]) === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) {
+  const result = runAcceptanceCoverageReport();
+  process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify(result.report)}\n`); process.exitCode = result.exitCode;
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,119 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env node
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: SUL-1.0
+import { constants, closeSync, fstatSync, fsyncSync, lstatSync, mkdirSync, openSync, readSync, realpathSync, statfsSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { isAbsolute, relative, resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
+import { prepareBoundArtifactTransfer, verifyTransferredArtifact } from '../lib/bound-artifact-transfer.mjs';
+
+// Explicit local runtime-transfer producer. No Git, network, lifecycle writes,
+// signatures, private-state discovery, guessed bindings, or in-place redaction.
+// Descriptor anchoring is currently Linux-only; other hosts get a typed hold.
+const anchor = (fd) => `/proc/self/fd/${fd}`;
+const same = (left, right) => left.dev === right.dev && left.ino === right.ino;
+const directoryFlags = constants.O_RDONLY | constants.O_DIRECTORY | constants.O_NOFOLLOW;
+function openChildDirectory(parent, name) {
+  const path = `${anchor(parent)}/${name}`;
+  const before = lstatSync(path);
+  if (!before.isDirectory() || before.isSymbolicLink()) throw new Error('BT-DIRECTORY');
+  const fd = openSync(path, directoryFlags);
+  if (!same(before, fstatSync(fd))) { closeSync(fd); throw new Error('BT-DRIFT'); }
+  return fd;
+}
+function openRoot(root) {
+  let fd = openSync('/', directoryFlags);
+  try {
+    for (const part of root.split('/').filter(Boolean)) {
+      const child = openChildDirectory(fd, part);
+      closeSync(fd); fd = child;
+    }
+    return fd;
+  } catch (error) { closeSync(fd); throw error; }
+}
+function readBytes(fd, cap) {
+  const buffer = Buffer.alloc(cap + 1);
+  let offset = 0;
+  while (offset < buffer.length) {
+    const count = readSync(fd, buffer, offset, buffer.length - offset, offset);
+    if (!count) break;
+    offset += count;
+  }
+  if (offset > cap) throw new Error('BT-LIMIT');
+  return buffer.subarray(0, offset);
+}
+function boundedRead(rootFd, root, name, limit) {
+  const path = resolve(root, name);
+  const rel = relative(root, path);
+  if (!rel || isAbsolute(rel) || rel.split('/').some((part) => part === '..' || !part || part.startsWith('.'))
+    || /[\\\x00-\x1f]/u.test(name)) throw new Error('BT-PATH');
+  const parts = rel.split('/');
+  let dir = openSync(`${anchor(rootFd)}/.`, directoryFlags);
+  let fd = null;
+  try {
+    for (const part of parts.slice(0, -1)) { const child = openChildDirectory(dir, part); closeSync(dir); dir = child; }
+    const filePath = `${anchor(dir)}/${parts.at(-1)}`;
+    const pathStat = lstatSync(filePath);
+    if (!pathStat.isFile() || pathStat.isSymbolicLink()) throw new Error('BT-SOURCE');
+    fd = openSync(filePath, constants.O_RDONLY | constants.O_NOFOLLOW);
+    const before = fstatSync(fd);
+    if (!same(pathStat, before) || !before.isFile() || before.nlink !== 1 || before.size > limit) throw new Error('BT-SOURCE');
+    const bytes = readBytes(fd, limit);
+    const after = fstatSync(fd);
+    const now = lstatSync(filePath);
+    if (!same(before, now) || bytes.length !== before.size || before.size !== after.size
+      || before.mtimeMs !== after.mtimeMs || before.ctimeMs !== after.ctimeMs) throw new Error('BT-DRIFT');
+    return bytes;
+  } finally { if (fd !== null) closeSync(fd); closeSync(dir); }
+}
+
+export function runTransferCli(argv) {
+  const refusal = (code) => ({ schema: 'pipeline.bound-artifact-transfer-cli.v1', status: 'refused', code });
+  if (argv.length !== 7 || argv[0] !== 'prepare' || argv[1] !== '--root' || argv[3] !== '--manifest' || argv[5] !== '--output') return refusal('BT-ARGV');
+  if (process.platform !== 'linux' || !constants.O_NOFOLLOW || !constants.O_DIRECTORY) return refusal('BT-HOST-CAPABILITY');
+  let rootFd = null;
+  let scratchFd = null;
+  let outputFd = null;
+  let outputCreated = false;
+  try {
+    if (statfsSync('/proc').type !== 0x9fa0) return refusal('BT-HOST-CAPABILITY');
+    const root = realpathSync(argv[2]);
+    rootFd = openRoot(root);
+    // A root-relative local manifest stays in custody; no paths enter the projection.
+    if (!/^scratch\/[A-Za-z0-9_./-]+\.json$/u.test(argv[4])) return refusal('BT-MANIFEST');
+    const request = JSON.parse(boundedRead(rootFd, root, argv[4], 128 * 1024).toString('utf8'));
+    const outputName = argv[6];
+    if (!/^scratch\/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,80}$/u.test(outputName)) return refusal('BT-OUTPUT');
+    const outcome = prepareBoundArtifactTransfer(request, (name, cap) => boundedRead(rootFd, root, name, cap));
+    if (outcome.status === 'refused') return refusal(outcome.code);
+    scratchFd = openChildDirectory(rootFd, 'scratch');
+    const basename = outputName.slice('scratch/'.length);
+    // Exclusive creation prevents replacing existing export/source/custody files.
+    mkdirSync(`${anchor(scratchFd)}/${basename}`, { mode: 0o700 });
+    outputCreated = true;
+    outputFd = openChildDirectory(scratchFd, basename);
+    for (const payload of outcome.payloads) {
+      const target = `${anchor(outputFd)}/${payload.id}.artifact`;
+      writeFileSync(target, payload.bytes, { mode: 0o600, flag: 'wx' });
+      const fd = openSync(target, constants.O_RDONLY | constants.O_NOFOLLOW);
+      try {
+        if (!verifyTransferredArtifact(readBytes(fd, payload.bytes.length), payload.sha256)) throw new Error('BT-READBACK');
+        fsyncSync(fd);
+      } finally { closeSync(fd); }
+    }
+    writeFileSync(`${anchor(outputFd)}/witness.json`, JSON.stringify({ schema: 'pipeline.bound-artifact-transfer-witness.v1',
+      publicProjectionSha256: outcome.publicProjectionSha256,
+      artifacts: outcome.payloads.map(({ id, sha256, bytes }) => ({ id, sha256, bytes: bytes.length })) }) + '\n', { mode: 0o600, flag: 'wx' });
+    // Published last: an incomplete directory is never a successful bundle.
+    writeFileSync(`${anchor(outputFd)}/public-projection.json`, JSON.stringify(outcome.publicProjection) + '\n', { mode: 0o600, flag: 'wx' });
+    fsyncSync(outputFd);
+    return { schema: 'pipeline.bound-artifact-transfer-cli.v1', status: outcome.status, code: null,
+      publicProjectionSha256: outcome.publicProjectionSha256,
+      carried: outcome.payloads.length, held: outcome.publicProjection.entries.filter((entry) => entry.status === 'held').length };
+  } catch { return refusal(outputCreated ? 'BT-EXPORT-INCOMPLETE' : 'BT-IO'); }
+  finally { for (const fd of [outputFd, scratchFd, rootFd]) if (fd !== null) closeSync(fd); }
+}
+
+if (process.argv[1] && resolve(process.argv[1]) === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) {
+  const result = runTransferCli(process.argv.slice(2));
+  console.log(JSON.stringify(result));
+  process.exitCode = result.status === 'ready' ? 0 : 2;
+}

+ }catch{return 2;}
+}

+import { after } from 'node:test';
+import { mkdtempSync, chmodSync, lstatSync, realpathSync, rmSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { join, dirname, resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { userInfo } from 'node:os';
+import { registerTestCaseCompletion } from '../lib/test-case-completion.mjs';
+import { cases } from './existing-public-anchor-fixtures/cases.mjs';
+
+// Fixture transport only. Product constructors/callbacks and inherited policies
+// are unchanged. A safe home matches the already-qualified Root fixture recipe;
+// this does not claim EPA reaches Registry's separate /tmp ancestry refusal.
+const previousParent = process.env.EPA_FIXTURE_PARENT;
+function identity(s) { return [String(s.dev), String(s.ino), s.mode, s.uid, s.gid]; }
+function same(a, b) { return JSON.stringify(a) === JSON.stringify(b); }
+function chain(home) {
+  const rows = [];
+  for (let p = home; ; p = dirname(p)) {
+    const s = lstatSync(p);
+    if (!s.isDirectory() || s.isSymbolicLink() || realpathSync(p) !== p || (s.mode & 0o022) !== 0)
+      throw Error('EPA-FIXTURE-ANCESTRY');
+    try { lstatSync(join(p, '.git')); throw Error('EPA-FIXTURE-INSIDE-GIT'); }
+    catch (e) { if (e.code !== 'ENOENT') throw e; }
+    rows.push({ path: p, identity: identity(s) });
+    if (dirname(p) === p) return rows;
+  }
+}
+const user = userInfo(), home = resolve(user.homedir);
+if (home !== user.homedir || realpathSync(home) !== home) throw Error('EPA-FIXTURE-HOME-CANONICAL');
+const ancestors = chain(home), homeStat = lstatSync(home);
+if ((typeof process.getuid === 'function' && (user.uid !== process.getuid() || homeStat.uid !== process.getuid()))
+    || homeStat.uid !== user.uid) throw Error('EPA-FIXTURE-HOME-OWNER');
+const parent = mkdtempSync(join(home, '.pipeline-existing-public-anchor-'));
+chmodSync(parent, 0o700);
+const owned = lstatSync(parent);
+if (!owned.isDirectory() || owned.isSymbolicLink() || realpathSync(parent) !== parent
+    || (owned.mode & 0o777) !== 0o700 || owned.uid !== user.uid
+    || !same(ancestors, chain(home))) throw Error('EPA-FIXTURE-CREATION-CAS');
+process.env.EPA_FIXTURE_PARENT = parent;
+after(() => {
+  if (previousParent === undefined) delete process.env.EPA_FIXTURE_PARENT;
+  else process.env.EPA_FIXTURE_PARENT = previousParent;
+  const current = lstatSync(parent);
+  if (!current.isDirectory() || current.isSymbolicLink() || realpathSync(parent) !== parent
+      || !same(identity(owned), identity(current)) || !same(ancestors, chain(home)))
+    throw Error('EPA-FIXTURE-CLEANUP-CAS');
+  const beforeRemove = lstatSync(parent);
+  if (!same(identity(current), identity(beforeRemove))) throw Error('EPA-FIXTURE-CLEANUP-CAS');
+  rmSync(parent, { recursive: true });
+});
+registerTestCaseCompletion({ cases, fd: 3, maxBytes: 65536 });

+#!/usr/bin/env node
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: SUL-1.0
+// Pure diagnostic projection: no readiness, enrollment, repair or housekeeping authority.
+import {lstatSync,realpathSync} from 'node:fs';
+import {isAbsolute,resolve} from 'node:path';
+import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';
+import {observeGovernanceScope,governanceScopeFailureDiagnostic} from '../lib/governance-scope.mjs';
+import {isDirectInvocation} from '../lib/entrypoint.mjs';
+const exact=(v,keys)=>v!==null&&typeof v==='object'&&!Array.isArray(v)&&Object.keys(v).sort().join('|')===[...keys].sort().join('|');
+export function parseGovernanceScopeDiagnosticArgs(argv,{realpathSyncFn=realpathSync,lstatSyncFn=lstatSync}={}){
+  if(!Array.isArray(argv)||argv.length!==2||argv[0]!=='--root')return {ok:false,code:'GSD-ARGS'};
+  const rootDir=argv[1];
+  try{if(typeof rootDir!=='string'||!isAbsolute(rootDir)||resolve(rootDir)!==rootDir||/[\x00-\x1f\x7f]/u.test(rootDir))return {ok:false,code:'GSD-ROOT'};
+    const st=lstatSyncFn(rootDir);if(!st.isDirectory()||st.isSymbolicLink()||realpathSyncFn(rootDir)!==rootDir)return {ok:false,code:'GSD-ROOT'};
+    return {ok:true,rootDir};
+  }catch{return {ok:false,code:'GSD-ROOT'};}
+}
+function validScope(v){
+  return exact(v,['schema','state','root','scopeKey','repositoryKind','provenance','diagnostics','requiresEnforcement','hintAllowed'])
+    &&v.schema==='pipeline.governance-scope.v1'&&['active','inactive','declined','unverifiable-active'].includes(v.state)
+    &&(v.root===null||typeof v.root==='string'&&isAbsolute(v.root)&&resolve(v.root)===v.root)
+    &&(v.scopeKey===null||typeof v.scopeKey==='string'&&/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/u.test(v.scopeKey))
+    &&['git','non-git','unavailable'].includes(v.repositoryKind)
+    &&exact(v.provenance,['kind','refs'])&&typeof v.provenance.kind==='string'&&Array.isArray(v.provenance.refs)
+    &&v.provenance.refs.every(r=>exact(r,['path','sha256'])&&typeof r.path==='string'&&/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/u.test(r.sha256??''))
+    &&Array.isArray(v.diagnostics)&&v.diagnostics.every(d=>typeof d==='string'&&/^GS-[A-Z0-9-]+$/u.test(d))
+    &&v.requiresEnforcement===['active','unverifiable-active'].includes(v.state)
+    &&typeof v.hintAllowed==='boolean'&&(!v.hintAllowed||v.state==='inactive'&&v.root!==null);
+}
+function validDiagnostic(v){
+  return exact(v,['cause','topologyDiagnostic'])&&exact(v.cause,['gitExitCode','stderrFirstLine'])
+    &&(v.cause.gitExitCode===null||Number.isSafeInteger(v.cause.gitExitCode))
+    &&typeof v.cause.stderrFirstLine==='string'&&v.cause.stderrFirstLine.length<=500&&!/[\x00-\x1f\x7f]/u.test(v.cause.stderrFirstLine)
+    &&exact(v.topologyDiagnostic,['reason','errno','gitCode','gitReportsNotRepository','boundary','ancestorDepth'])
+    &&typeof v.topologyDiagnostic.reason==='string'&&/^[a-z-]+$/u.test(v.topologyDiagnostic.reason)
+    &&(v.topologyDiagnostic.errno===null||typeof v.topologyDiagnostic.errno==='string'&&/^[A-Z0-9_-]+$/u.test(v.topologyDiagnostic.errno))
+    &&(v.topologyDiagnostic.gitCode===null||typeof v.topologyDiagnostic.gitCode==='string'&&/^[A-Z0-9_-]+$/u.test(v.topologyDiagnostic.gitCode))
+    &&typeof v.topologyDiagnostic.gitReportsNotRepository==='boolean'&&['selected-root','ancestor','filesystem-root'].includes(v.topologyDiagnostic.boundary)
+    &&Number.isSafeInteger(v.topologyDiagnostic.ancestorDepth)&&v.topologyDiagnostic.ancestorDepth>=0;
+}
+export function diagnoseGovernanceScope({rootDir},{observeGovernanceScopeFn=observeGovernanceScope,governanceScopeFailureDiagnosticFn=governanceScopeFailureDiagnostic}={}){
+  const base={schema:'pipeline.governance-scope-diagnosis.v1',status:'unavailable',root:rootDir,governanceScope:null,cause:null,topologyDiagnostic:null,authority:false,mutation:false,pipelineWorkPerformed:false};
+  try{const scope=observeGovernanceScopeFn({rootDir});if(!validScope(scope))return base;
+    const diagnostic=governanceScopeFailureDiagnosticFn(scope);
+    return {...base,status:'observed',governanceScope:scope,...(validDiagnostic(diagnostic)?diagnostic:{})};
+  }catch{return base;}
+}
+export function run(argv=process.argv.slice(2),deps={}){
+  const emit=deps.writeStdoutFn??(text=>process.stdout.write(text)),error=deps.writeStderrFn??(text=>process.stderr.write(text));
+  const parsed=parseGovernanceScopeDiagnosticArgs(argv,deps);
+  if(!parsed.ok){error(parsed.code+'\n');return 2;}
+  const value=diagnoseGovernanceScope({rootDir:parsed.rootDir},deps);emit(JSON.stringify(value)+'\n');return value.status==='observed'?0:2;
+}
+if(isDirectInvocation(import.meta.url)){
+  try{const self=fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);if(process.argv[1]!==self||realpathSync(self)!==self||lstatSync(self).isSymbolicLink()){
+    process.stderr.write('GSD-SCRIPT\n');process.exitCode=2;
+  }else process.exitCode=run();}catch{process.stderr.write('GSD-UNAVAILABLE\n');process.exitCode=2;}
+}

+#!/usr/bin/env node

+import {resolve} from 'node:path';
+import {readGreenfieldPublicComparisonInput,buildGreenfieldPublicComparison,publishGreenfieldPublicComparison} from '../lib/greenfield-public-comparison.mjs';
+export function runGreenfieldPublicComparison(argv,{stdout=process.stdout,rootDir=process.cwd()}={}){
+  const keys=['--input','--input-sha256','--output'];
+  if(argv.length!==6||!keys.every((k,i)=>argv[i*2]===k&&typeof argv[i*2+1]==='string')){stdout.write(JSON.stringify({status:'held',code:'GPC-ARGS'})+'\n');return 2;}
+  const input=readGreenfieldPublicComparisonInput({rootDir,inputPath:argv[1],inputSha256:argv[3]});
+  if(input.status!=='read'){stdout.write(JSON.stringify(input)+'\n');return 2;}
+  const built=buildGreenfieldPublicComparison({inputHandle:input.handle});
+  const result=built.status==='built'?publishGreenfieldPublicComparison({rootDir,outputPath:argv[5],built}):built;

+}

+#!/usr/bin/env node
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: SUL-1.0
+
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import {spawnSync} from 'node:child_process';
+import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
+import {cpSync,existsSync,lstatSync,mkdirSync,mkdtempSync,readFileSync,readdirSync,rmSync} from 'node:fs';
+import {dirname,join,resolve} from 'node:path';
+import {registerTestCaseCompletion} from '../lib/test-case-completion.mjs';
+import {fileURLToPath,pathToFileURL} from 'node:url';
+
+// An alternate COMPLETE plugin package lets the same regression qualify an
+// assembled candidate. No dependency overlays, text replacements or stubs.
+const sourcePluginRoot=resolve(process.env.PIPELINE_INSTALLED_IMPORT_SOURCE_ROOT
+  ?? join(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)),'..'));
+const scratchRoot=resolve(process.cwd(),'scratch');
+
+function inventory(root,rel='') {
+  const rows=[];
+  for(const name of readdirSync(join(root,rel)).sort()) {
+    const path=join(rel,name),absolute=join(root,path),stat=lstatSync(absolute);
+    assert.notEqual(name,'.git','standalone package must contain no Git metadata');
+    assert.equal(stat.isSymbolicLink(),false,`package link could escape isolation: ${path}`);
+    if(stat.isDirectory())rows.push(...inventory(root,path));
+    else {
+      assert.equal(stat.isFile(),true,`unsupported package entry: ${path}`);
+      rows.push({path,sha256:createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(absolute)).digest('hex')});
+    }
+  }
+  return rows;
+}
+
+registerTestCaseCompletion({fd:3,maxBytes:8192,cases:[{id:'IBIC001',
+  name:'installed bootstrap links the actual standalone plugin without an external harness',run:()=>{
+  mkdirSync(scratchRoot,{recursive:true});
+  const fixture=mkdtempSync(join(scratchRoot,'installed-bootstrap-import-'));
+  try {
+    const packageRoot=join(fixture,'package');
+    const pluginRoot=join(packageRoot,'plugins','pipeline-core');
+    const sourceInventory=inventory(sourcePluginRoot);
+    cpSync(sourcePluginRoot,pluginRoot,{recursive:true,errorOnExist:true,force:false});
+    assert.deepEqual(inventory(pluginRoot),sourceInventory,'copied package must match the actual production source bytes');
+    assert.deepEqual(readdirSync(packageRoot),['plugins']);
+    assert.deepEqual(readdirSync(join(packageRoot,'plugins')),['pipeline-core']);
+    assert.equal(existsSync(join(packageRoot,'.git')),false);
+    assert.equal(existsSync(join(packageRoot,'harness')),false,'no external harness overlay is permitted');
+    // This is the exact target of the historical ../../../harness import.
+    assert.equal(existsSync(resolve(pluginRoot,'lib','../../../harness/scripts/check-verify-suite-registration.mjs')),false);
+    const moduleUrl=pathToFileURL(join(pluginRoot,'scripts','pipeline-start-preflight.mjs')).href;
+    const childEnv={...process.env};
+    for(const key of Object.keys(childEnv)) {
+      if(['NODE_OPTIONS','NODE_PATH'].includes(key.toUpperCase()))delete childEnv[key];
+    }
+    // -e leaves argv[1] absent. Importing cannot accidentally select preflight's
+    // direct-invocation branch; no bootstrap/onboarding action is requested.
+    const code=`const loaded=await import(${JSON.stringify(moduleUrl)}); if(typeof loaded.observePipelineStartPreflight!=='function')throw new Error('missing bootstrap export'); console.log('standalone-bootstrap-import-ok');`;
+    const result=spawnSync(process.execPath,['--input-type=module','-e',code],{
+      cwd:packageRoot,env:childEnv,encoding:'utf8',shell:false,timeout:30000,maxBuffer:1024*1024,
+    });
+    assert.ifError(result.error);
+    assert.equal(result.signal,null,`bootstrap import was terminated: ${result.signal}`);
+    assert.equal(result.status,0,`standalone bootstrap module linking failed:\n${result.stderr}`);
+    assert.equal(result.stdout.trim(),'standalone-bootstrap-import-ok');
+    assert.equal(result.stderr,'');
+    assert.equal(existsSync(join(packageRoot,'harness')),false);
+    assert.equal(existsSync(join(packageRoot,'.git')),false);
+    assert.deepEqual(inventory(pluginRoot),sourceInventory,'module import must preserve the copied package bytes');
+  } finally {
+    rmSync(fixture,{recursive:true,force:true});
+  }
+}}]});

+#!/usr/bin/env node
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: SUL-1.0
+/** Agent-side AC-6 subject, signed-record, and status commands. */
+import { isDirectInvocation } from "../lib/entrypoint.mjs";
+import {
+  checkInterruptionPromotion,
+  readInterruptionPromotionSubject,
+  recordInterruptionPromotion,
+} from "../lib/interruption-promotion.mjs";
+
+const USAGE = "Usage: interruption-promotion.mjs subject --root ROOT | record --root ROOT --request REQUEST_JSON --proof PROOF_JSON | status --root ROOT";
+
+function parse(argv) {
+  const [command, ...rest] = argv;
+  if (!["subject", "record", "status"].includes(command)) return null;
+  const result = { command, root: null, requestPath: null, proofPath: null };
+  const seen = new Set();
+  for (let i = 0; i < rest.length; i++) {
+    const key = rest[i];
+    if (!["--root", "--request", "--proof"].includes(key) || seen.has(key) || i + 1 >= rest.length || rest[i + 1].startsWith("--")) return null;
+    seen.add(key);
+    result[key.slice(2) === "request" ? "requestPath" : key.slice(2) === "proof" ? "proofPath" : "root"] = rest[++i];
+  }
+  if (typeof result.root !== "string" || !result.root.trim()) return null;
+  if (command === "record" && (!result.requestPath || !result.proofPath)) return null;
+  if (command !== "record" && (result.requestPath || result.proofPath)) return null;
+  return result;
+}
+
+export function main(argv = process.argv.slice(2)) {
+  const args = parse(argv);
+  if (!args) {
+    process.stderr.write(`${JSON.stringify({ schema: "pipeline.interruption-promotion-cli-result.v1", status: "rejected", code: "APR-CLI-SHAPE" })}\n`);
+    process.stderr.write(`${USAGE}\n`);
+    return 2;
+  }
+  const result = args.command === "subject"
+    ? readInterruptionPromotionSubject({ root: args.root })
+    : args.command === "record"
+      ? recordInterruptionPromotion({ root: args.root, requestPath: args.requestPath, proofPath: args.proofPath })
+      : checkInterruptionPromotion({ root: args.root });
+  process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify({ schema: "pipeline.interruption-promotion-cli-result.v1", ...result })}\n`);
+  if (args.command === "status") return 0;
+  return result.ok === false ? 2 : 0;
+}
+
+if (isDirectInvocation(import.meta.url)) process.exitCode = main(process.argv.slice(2));

@@ -0,0 +1,69 @@
+// Real elapsed-time and real owning-lifetime controls. No clock, transport,
+// spawn, backend, or authority callback is supplied to product code.
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import fs from 'node:fs';
+import path from 'node:path';
+import {setTimeout as wait} from 'node:timers/promises';
+
+export const REAL_ATTEMPT_TTL_MS = 120000;
+
+export function createRealLifetimeSuiteSource({kind, recorderModuleSpecifier, markerRelative = null}) {
+  assert.ok(kind === 'deadline' || kind === 'disconnect');
+  assert.equal(typeof recorderModuleSpecifier, 'string');
+  assert.ok((recorderModuleSpecifier.startsWith('./') || recorderModuleSpecifier.startsWith('../')) && recorderModuleSpecifier.endsWith('/test-case-completion.mjs'));
+  let imports = `import assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nimport {registerTestCaseCompletion} from ${JSON.stringify(recorderModuleSpecifier)};\n`;
+  let progress = '';
+  if (kind === 'disconnect') {
+    assert.equal(typeof markerRelative, 'string');
+    assert.ok(markerRelative.startsWith('scratch/osv-independent/') && !markerRelative.split('/').some(x => !x || x === '.' || x === '..'));
+    imports += "import {writeFileSync} from 'node:fs';\n";
+    // Actual child writes one declared disposable progress marker. This is not
+    // completion, origin, member, invocation or execution authority evidence.
+    progress = `writeFileSync(${JSON.stringify(markerRelative)},'actual-suite-running\\n',{flag:'wx',mode:0o600});\n`;
+  }
+  const source = `${imports}registerTestCaseCompletion({cases:[{id:'OSVF001',name:'Actual bounded lifetime control',async run(){${progress}await new Promise(resolve=>setTimeout(resolve,150000));assert.equal(19+23,42);}}],fd:3,maxBytes:65536});\n`;
+  return Object.freeze({source, caseIds:Object.freeze(['OSVF001']), maxBytes:65536});
+}
+
+export function assertActualDeadlineRefusal({result, startedAt, endedAt}) {
+  assert.ok(Number.isFinite(startedAt) && Number.isFinite(endedAt));
+  assert.ok(endedAt - startedAt >= REAL_ATTEMPT_TTL_MS, 'An earlier generic refusal is not the actual TTL vector');
+  assert.equal(result?.status, 'unavailable');
+  assert.equal(result.code, 'OSV-EXPIRED', 'Require the genuine declared expiration result; do not relabel a hidden generic failure');
+}
+
+export async function disposeActualOwnerAfterOwnedSuiteProgress({fixture, markerRelative}) {
+  assert.equal(typeof fixture.runtime?.dispose, 'function', 'Use the actual Source-issued runtime disposal entry');
+  assert.ok(markerRelative.startsWith('scratch/osv-independent/'));
+  const file = path.resolve(fixture.repository, markerRelative);
+  const relative = path.relative(fixture.ownedRoot, file);
+  assert.ok(relative && !relative.startsWith(`..${path.sep}`) && relative !== '..' && !path.isAbsolute(relative));
+  const deadline = performance.now() + 60000;
+  let observed = false;
+  while (performance.now() < deadline) {
+    try {
+      const before = fs.lstatSync(file);
+      assert.ok(before.isFile() && !before.isSymbolicLink());
+      assert.equal(before.nlink, 1);
+      assert.equal(fs.realpathSync(file), file);
+      const bytes = fs.readFileSync(file);
+      const after = fs.lstatSync(file);
+      assert.equal(after.dev, before.dev);
+      assert.equal(after.ino, before.ino);
+      assert.equal(after.mode, before.mode);
+      assert.equal(bytes.toString('utf8'), 'actual-suite-running\n');
+      observed = true;
+      break;
+    } catch (error) { if (error.code !== 'ENOENT') throw error; }
+    await wait(25);
+  }
+  assert.equal(observed, true, 'Missing real suite progress is not a passing disconnect control');
+  // No PID lookup, adopted handle, caller Promise or outside-family signal.
+  await fixture.runtime.dispose();
+}
+
+export function assertActualLostOwnerRefusal(result) {
+  assert.ok(result?.status === 'failed' || result?.status === 'unavailable');
+  assert.ok(['OSV-OWNER-UNAVAILABLE','OSV-EXCHANGE-UNAVAILABLE','OSV-VERIFY-FAILED','OSV-TERMINAL-UNAVAILABLE','OSV-EXPIRED'].includes(result.code));
+  assert.notEqual(result.status, 'succeeded');
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,106 @@
+// Real subprocess negative controls. This module does not issue an OSV context.
+// It is evaluated only by Root in a coherent selected Source closure.
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import fs from 'node:fs';
+import path from 'node:path';
+import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
+import {spawn} from 'node:child_process';
+
+const GUARD_RELATIVE = 'plugins/pipeline-core/hooks/guard-lifecycle-ready.mjs';
+const GUARD_SHA = '2b6d85ab59df759326d24745cf582124c7188e32c131060ff580932b102bd8a2';
+const FIXED_TAIL = Object.freeze(['--runner', 'codex', '--consume-owned-verification-guard', '--channel-fd', '4']);
+const PUBLIC_CODES = Object.freeze(['OSV-GUARD-INVOCATION-INVALID', 'OSV-GUARD-EXCHANGE-FAILED']);
+const MAX_CAPTURE = 65536;
+const MAX_MS = 15000;
+const digest = bytes => createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex');
+
+function inspectGuard(graphRoot) {
+  assert.equal(typeof graphRoot, 'string');
+  assert.equal(fs.realpathSync(graphRoot), path.resolve(graphRoot), 'Actual selected graph root must be canonical');
+  const file = path.join(graphRoot, GUARD_RELATIVE);
+  const before = fs.lstatSync(file);
+  assert.ok(before.isFile() && !before.isSymbolicLink(), 'Actual guard must be a regular Source file');
+  assert.equal(before.nlink, 1, 'Selected owned guard copy must be single-link');
+  assert.equal(fs.realpathSync(file), file, 'Guard path must preserve physical Source identity');
+  const bytes = fs.readFileSync(file);
+  assert.equal(digest(bytes), GUARD_SHA, 'Bind exact independently declared guard Source');
+  const after = fs.lstatSync(file);
+  assert.equal(after.dev, before.dev);
+  assert.equal(after.ino, before.ino);
+  assert.equal(after.mode, before.mode);
+  assert.equal(after.size, before.size);
+  assert.equal(after.mtimeMs, before.mtimeMs);
+  return {file, dev: before.dev, ino: before.ino, mode: before.mode, sha256: GUARD_SHA};
+}
+
+export async function runActualUnauthenticatedGuard({graphRoot, repository, kind}) {
+  assert.ok(['missing-channel', 'public-frame', 'extra-argv', 'ordinary-command'].includes(kind));
+  const guard = inspectGuard(graphRoot);
+  assert.equal(fs.realpathSync(repository), path.resolve(repository), 'Use the actual fixture repository');
+  if (kind === 'ordinary-command' && process.env.CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR !== undefined) {
+    assert.equal(fs.realpathSync(process.env.CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR), repository, 'Ordinary policy control must address the same actual owning repository; never override inherited environment');
+  }
+  const tail = kind === 'ordinary-command' ? ['--runner', 'codex'] : kind === 'extra-argv' ? [...FIXED_TAIL, '--unowned-extra'] : [...FIXED_TAIL];
+  const stdio = kind === 'ordinary-command' ? ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'] : kind === 'public-frame' ? ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe', 'ignore', 'pipe'] : ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'];
+  // This is the genuine test-owned ChildProcess. No Source backend/spawn is injected.
+  const child = spawn(process.execPath, [...process.execArgv, guard.file, ...tail], {cwd: repository, env: process.env, stdio});
+  const captured = {stdout: [], stderr: [], stdoutBytes: 0, stderrBytes: 0, overflow: false, timedOut: false, spawned: false, errorCode: null};
+  child.once('spawn', () => { captured.spawned = true; });
+  child.once('error', error => {
+    const code = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(error, 'code');
+    captured.errorCode = code && Object.hasOwn(code, 'value') && ['ENOENT', 'EACCES', 'EPERM', 'EINVAL'].includes(code.value) ? code.value : 'UNCLASSIFIED';
+  });
+  for (const name of ['stdout', 'stderr']) {
+    child[name].on('data', bytes => {
+      const chunk = Buffer.from(bytes);
+      captured[`${name}Bytes`] += chunk.length;
+      if (captured[`${name}Bytes`] > MAX_CAPTURE) {
+        captured.overflow = true;
+        child.kill('SIGTERM');
+      } else captured[name].push(chunk);
+    });
+  }
+  if (kind === 'public-frame') {
+    child.stdio[4].on('error', () => {});
+    // This deliberately untrusted public frame is negative input, never a grant.
+    child.stdio[4].end('{"schema":"unowned-public-context","ready":true}\n');
+  }
+  if (kind === 'ordinary-command') {
+    const executor = path.join(graphRoot, 'plugins/pipeline-core/scripts/owned-continuity-verification.mjs');
+    assert.equal(fs.realpathSync(executor), executor);
+    const quote = value => "'" + String(value).replaceAll("'", "'\\''") + "'";
+    const command = [fs.realpathSync(process.execPath), ...process.execArgv, executor, '--consume-owned-verification', '--channel-fd', '4'].map(quote).join(' ');
+    child.stdin.on('error', () => {});
+    child.stdin.end(JSON.stringify({tool_name:'Bash',tool_input:{command}}));
+  }
+  const timer = setTimeout(() => { captured.timedOut = true; child.kill('SIGTERM'); }, MAX_MS);
+  const terminal = await new Promise(resolve => child.once('close', (code, signal) => resolve({code, signal})));
+  clearTimeout(timer);
+  const output = Buffer.concat(captured.stdout);
+  const errors = Buffer.concat(captured.stderr);
+  const text = errors.toString('utf8');
+  const codes = PUBLIC_CODES.filter(code => text.split('\n').some(line => line.startsWith(`${code}:`)));
+  const after = inspectGuard(graphRoot);
+  assert.equal(after.dev, guard.dev);
+  assert.equal(after.ino, guard.ino);
+  assert.equal(after.mode, guard.mode);
+  // Only closed process facts and digests leave this private capture helper.
+  return Object.freeze({kind, spawned: captured.spawned, code: terminal.code, signal: terminal.signal, errorCode: captured.errorCode, timedOut: captured.timedOut, overflow: captured.overflow, stdoutBytes: captured.stdoutBytes, stderrBytes: captured.stderrBytes, stdoutSha256: digest(output), stderrSha256: digest(errors), codes: Object.freeze(codes)});
+}
+
+export async function assertActualGuardRefusal({graphRoot, repository, kind}) {
+  const actual = await runActualUnauthenticatedGuard({graphRoot, repository, kind});
+  assert.equal(actual.spawned, true, 'The actual fixed guard process must execute');
+  assert.equal(actual.errorCode, null, 'A setup/spawn error is not authenticated refusal evidence');
+  assert.equal(actual.timedOut, false, 'A timed-out guard is not a passing negative');
+  assert.equal(actual.overflow, false, 'Overflow is not a passing negative');
+  assert.equal(actual.signal, null, 'A signaled guard is not a passing negative');
+  assert.equal(actual.code, 2, 'Actual production guard must refuse without authority');
+  assert.equal(actual.stdoutBytes, 0, 'Unauthenticated guard must not publish a success result');
+  if (kind === 'ordinary-command') assert.ok(actual.stderrBytes > 0, 'Require an actual ordinary-policy denial, not silent non-enforcement');
+  else {
+    const expected = kind === 'extra-argv' ? 'OSV-GUARD-INVOCATION-INVALID' : 'OSV-GUARD-EXCHANGE-FAILED';
+    assert.ok(actual.codes.includes(expected), 'The exact original guard refusal branch must be reached');
+  }
+  return actual;
+}

--- /dev/null
+++ b/plugins/pipeline-core/scripts/osv-owned-file-controls.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,85 @@
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import fs from 'node:fs';
+import path from 'node:path';
+import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
+
+const sha = bytes => createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex');
+function identity(stat) {
+  return {dev: String(stat.dev), ino: String(stat.ino), mode: String(stat.mode), uid: String(stat.uid), gid: String(stat.gid), nlink: String(stat.nlink)};
+}
+function contained(root, file) {
+  const relative = path.relative(root, file);
+  assert.ok(relative && !relative.startsWith(`..${path.sep}`) && relative !== '..' && !path.isAbsolute(relative), 'Fault/snapshot path must belong to this actual exclusively owned fixture');
+  assert.equal(fs.realpathSync(root), path.resolve(root));
+  assert.equal(fs.realpathSync(file), path.resolve(file));
+}
+export function readOwnedPhysicalFile({root, file}) {
+  contained(root, file);
+  const named = fs.lstatSync(file, {bigint: true});
+  assert.ok(named.isFile() && !named.isSymbolicLink(), 'Actual fixture resource must be a regular file');
+  assert.equal(named.nlink, 1n, 'Actual fixture resource must be single-link');
+  const fd = fs.openSync(file, fs.constants.O_RDONLY | (fs.constants.O_NOFOLLOW ?? 0));
+  try {
+    const opened = fs.fstatSync(fd, {bigint: true});
+    assert.deepEqual(identity(opened), identity(named));
+    const bytes = fs.readFileSync(fd);
+    const after = fs.fstatSync(fd, {bigint: true});
+    const last = fs.lstatSync(file, {bigint: true});
+    assert.deepEqual(identity(after), identity(opened));
+    assert.deepEqual(identity(last), identity(opened));
+    assert.equal(after.size, opened.size);
+    assert.equal(after.mtimeNs, opened.mtimeNs);
+    assert.equal(after.ctimeNs, opened.ctimeNs);
+    assert.equal(BigInt(bytes.length), opened.size);
+    return {file, bytes, sha256: sha(bytes), identity: identity(opened)};
+  } finally { fs.closeSync(fd); }
+}
+export function captureOwnedPhysicalFiles({root, files}) {
+  assert.ok(Array.isArray(files) && files.length > 0, 'Use actual declared authority/resource paths');
+  assert.equal(new Set(files).size, files.length);
+  return files.map(file => readOwnedPhysicalFile({root, file}));
+}
+export function assertOwnedPhysicalConservation({root, before}) {
+  for (const row of before) {
+    const current = readOwnedPhysicalFile({root, file: row.file});
+    assert.deepEqual(current.identity, row.identity, 'Conserve actual physical inode/mode/ownership/link identity');
+    assert.equal(current.sha256, row.sha256, 'Conserve actual authority/resource bytes');
+    assert.equal(current.bytes.length, row.bytes.length);
+  }
+}
+function writeSameOwnedInode({root, file, expected, replacement}) {
+  const current = readOwnedPhysicalFile({root, file});
+  assert.deepEqual(current.identity, expected.identity, 'Never mutate or restore a foreign replacement');
+  assert.equal(current.sha256, expected.sha256, 'Physical write CAS must match the actual expected bytes');
+  const fd = fs.openSync(file, fs.constants.O_RDWR | (fs.constants.O_NOFOLLOW ?? 0));
+  try {
+    assert.deepEqual(identity(fs.fstatSync(fd, {bigint: true})), expected.identity);
+    let offset = 0;
+    while (offset < replacement.length) {
+      const written = fs.writeSync(fd, replacement, offset, replacement.length - offset, offset);
+      assert.ok(written > 0);
+      offset += written;
+    }
+    fs.ftruncateSync(fd, replacement.length);
+    fs.fsyncSync(fd);
+  } finally { fs.closeSync(fd); }
+  const written = readOwnedPhysicalFile({root, file});
+  assert.deepEqual(written.identity, expected.identity);
+  assert.equal(written.sha256, sha(replacement));
+  return written;
+}
+export function changeActualOwnedFileBytes({root, file, replacement}) {
+  assert.ok(Buffer.isBuffer(replacement));
+  const original = readOwnedPhysicalFile({root, file});
+  assert.ok(!replacement.equals(original.bytes), 'The independently specified drift must change actual bytes');
+  const fault = writeSameOwnedInode({root, file, expected: original, replacement});
+  let restored = false;
+  return Object.freeze({
+    original, fault,
+    restore() {
+      assert.equal(restored, false, 'Restore this own physical fault once');
+      writeSameOwnedInode({root, file, expected: fault, replacement: original.bytes});
+      restored = true;
+    }
+  });
+}

+// Test task DATA for the genuine Source-owned authoring producer. These strings
+// carry no course, identity, registration, requester or verification authority.
+// Root alone executes a suite after the real production association is issued.
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+
+const variants = Object.freeze(['complete', 'duplicate-declaration', 'incomplete', 'malformed', 'missing', 'real-failure']);
+export const suiteControlVariants = variants;
+
+export function createSuiteSourceControl({kind, recorderModuleSpecifier}) {
+  assert.ok(variants.includes(kind), 'Unknown real suite control');
+  assert.equal(typeof recorderModuleSpecifier, 'string');
+  assert.ok(recorderModuleSpecifier.startsWith('./') || recorderModuleSpecifier.startsWith('../'), 'Recorder import must be a real contained relative module');
+  assert.ok(recorderModuleSpecifier.endsWith('/test-case-completion.mjs'), 'Use the official completion recorder');
+  assert.ok(!recorderModuleSpecifier.includes('\0'));
+  const importLine = `import {registerTestCaseCompletion,createTestCaseCompletionRecorder} from ${JSON.stringify(recorderModuleSpecifier)};\n`;
+  const declared = kind === 'incomplete' ? ['OSVF001', 'OSVF002'] : ['OSVF001'];
+  let source;
+  if (kind === 'complete') {
+    source = `${importLine}import assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nregisterTestCaseCompletion({cases:[{id:'OSVF001',name:'Actual owning verification arithmetic',run(){assert.equal(19+23,42);}}],fd:3,maxBytes:65536});\n`;
+  } else if (kind === 'real-failure') {
+    source = `${importLine}import assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nregisterTestCaseCompletion({cases:[{id:'OSVF001',name:'Actual intentional child assertion failure',run(){assert.fail('Intentional independently specified Verify child failure');}}],fd:3,maxBytes:65536});\n`;
+  } else if (kind === 'duplicate-declaration') {
+    source = `${importLine}import assert from 'node:assert/strict';\ncreateTestCaseCompletionRecorder({caseIds:['OSVF001'],fd:3,maxBytes:65536});\nconst second=createTestCaseCompletionRecorder({caseIds:['OSVF001'],fd:3,maxBytes:65536});\nassert.equal(19+23,42);\nsecond.dispose('OSVF001','pass');\n`;
+  } else if (kind === 'incomplete') {
+    source = `${importLine}import assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nconst recorder=createTestCaseCompletionRecorder({caseIds:['OSVF001','OSVF002'],fd:3,maxBytes:65536});\nassert.equal(19+23,42);\nrecorder.dispose('OSVF001','pass');\n`;
+  } else if (kind === 'malformed') {
+    source = `import {writeSync} from 'node:fs';\nwriteSync(3,Buffer.from('{not-valid-json}\\n'));\n`;
+  } else {
+    source = `import assert from 'node:assert/strict';\nassert.equal(19+23,42);\n// Deliberately does not publish the required completion stream.\n`;
+  }
+  return Object.freeze({kind, source, caseIds: Object.freeze(declared), maxBytes: 65536});
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,85 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env node
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: SUL-1.0
+// A fixed consumer of the Source-issued verification exchange. No suite selector.
+import {realpathSync} from 'node:fs';
+import {resolve} from 'node:path';
+import {
+  consumeSourceOwnedContinuityVerificationExecutorExchange,
+  inspectSourceOwnedContinuityVerificationExecutorContext,
+  finalizeSourceOwnedContinuityVerificationExecutorExchange,
+} from '../lib/session-requester-bridge.mjs';
+
+const FIXED_ARGUMENTS=['--consume-owned-verification','--channel-fd','4'];
+const INPUT_KEYS=['candidate','gitCommonDir','policyInputs','repoRoot','suites'];
+const REFUSAL_CODES=new Set([
+  'OSV-OWNER-UNAVAILABLE','OSV-COURSE-UNAVAILABLE','OSV-ASSOCIATION-UNAVAILABLE',
+  'OSV-INPUT-DRIFT','OSV-EXCHANGE-UNAVAILABLE','OSV-REPLAY','OSV-EXPIRED',
+  'OSV-VERIFY-FAILED','OSV-TERMINAL-UNAVAILABLE',
+]);
+
+function refuse(code) {
+  const error=new Error(code);
+  error.code=code;
+  throw error;
+}
+
+function requireContext(context, expectedBindingSha256=null) {
+  if(!context || !/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/u.test(context.bindingSha256 ?? '')
+    || (expectedBindingSha256!==null && context.bindingSha256!==expectedBindingSha256)
+    || !(context.signal instanceof AbortSignal)) refuse('OSV-EXCHANGE-UNAVAILABLE');
+  if(context.signal.aborted) refuse('OSV-EXPIRED');
+  const inputs=context.binding?.journalInputs;
+  if(!inputs || Array.isArray(inputs)
+    || JSON.stringify(Object.keys(inputs).sort())!==JSON.stringify(INPUT_KEYS))
+    refuse('OSV-INPUT-DRIFT');
+  if(typeof inputs.repoRoot!=='string' || resolve(inputs.repoRoot)!==inputs.repoRoot
+    || realpathSync(inputs.repoRoot)!==inputs.repoRoot || process.cwd()!==inputs.repoRoot)
+    refuse('OSV-INPUT-DRIFT');
+  return inputs;
+}
+
+async function execute() {
+  if(JSON.stringify(process.argv.slice(2))!==JSON.stringify(FIXED_ARGUMENTS))
+    refuse('OSV-EXCHANGE-UNAVAILABLE');
+  const consumed=await consumeSourceOwnedContinuityVerificationExecutorExchange();
+  if(!consumed?.verificationContextHandle) refuse('OSV-EXCHANGE-UNAVAILABLE');
+  const verificationContextHandle=consumed.verificationContextHandle;
+  // The authentic inspector reopens the complete bound closure and live parent.
+  // Nested origin/owner/member bindings remain that inspector's responsibility.
+  const before=await inspectSourceOwnedContinuityVerificationExecutorContext({verificationContextHandle});
+  const inputs=requireContext(before);
+  const {runVerifyJournal}=await import('./verify-journal.mjs');
+  if(before.signal.aborted) refuse('OSV-EXPIRED');
+  // Do not forward an open options object or replace any production default.
+  const journal=await runVerifyJournal({
+    gitCommonDir:inputs.gitCommonDir,
+    repoRoot:inputs.repoRoot,
+    candidate:inputs.candidate,
+    suites:inputs.suites,
+    policyInputs:inputs.policyInputs,
+    signal:before.signal,
+  });
+  const after=await inspectSourceOwnedContinuityVerificationExecutorContext({verificationContextHandle});
+  requireContext(after,before.bindingSha256);
+  if(after.signal!==before.signal) refuse('OSV-EXCHANGE-UNAVAILABLE');
+  // The parent reopens genuine journal evidence and rechecks the original owner.
+  // This acknowledgement precedes, and does not assert, this executor's close.
+  const ack=await finalizeSourceOwnedContinuityVerificationExecutorExchange({
+    verificationContextHandle,
+    terminal:journal,
+  });
+  if(!ack || JSON.stringify(Object.keys(ack))!==JSON.stringify(['status'])
+    || ack.status!=='acknowledged') refuse('OSV-TERMINAL-UNAVAILABLE');
+  if(before.signal.aborted) refuse('OSV-EXPIRED');
+  return journal?.terminal?.status==='passed' ? 0 : 1;
+}
+
+try {
+  process.exitCode=await execute();
+} catch(error) {
+  // The parent captures the actual outer close and retains any journal effects.
+  // Raw child errors, paths, handles and exchange data never become diagnostics.
+  const code=REFUSAL_CODES.has(error?.code) ? error.code : 'OSV-VERIFY-FAILED';
+  process.stderr.write(code+'\n');
+  process.exitCode=1;
+}

+
+function registrations(id, kinds, selectedVariant) {

['OSVF001','OSVF002'] : ['OSVF001'], maxBytes: 65536}}));

+async function sourceImport(f, relative, expected) {

+  if (expected !== undefined) assert.equal(sha(fs.readFileSync(file)), expected, 'Bind actual selected Source before product evaluation');
+  const modules = {[NEW_LIBRARY]:LibrarySource,[I03]:OnboardingSource,'plugins/pipeline-core/lib/session-authority-registry.mjs':RegistrySource};
+  assert.ok(Object.hasOwn(modules,relative),'Only the fixed already authenticated Source modules are inspected');

+}
+function refusal(actual, codes) {
+  assert.equal(actual?.status, 'unavailable', 'Require the real Source refusal union');
+  assert.ok(OSV_CODES.has(actual.code), 'Refusal must retain a declared typed Source code');
+  assert.ok(codes.includes(actual.code), 'Require the independently specified failure branch');
+}
+function actualSuccess(actual) {
+  assert.equal(actual?.status, 'succeeded', 'Actual default Verify and fresh terminal ownership must succeed');
+  assert.equal(actual.code, null);
+  assert.equal(actual.terminal.outerClose.closeObserved, true);
+  assert.equal(actual.terminal.outerClose.code, 0);
+  assert.equal(actual.terminal.outerClose.signal, null);
+  assert.equal(actual.terminal.outerClose.errorCode, null);
+  assert.equal(actual.terminal.journal.terminal.status, 'passed');
+  assert.equal(actual.terminal.journal.dispatchedSuiteCount, 1);
+  assert.equal(actual.terminal.journal.steps.length, 1);
+  assert.equal(actual.terminal.journal.steps[0].exitCode, 0);
+  assert.equal(actual.terminal.journal.steps[0].reused, false);
+}
+function plainPhysicalAuthority(f) {
+  assert.ok(Array.isArray(f.authorityFiles) && f.authorityFiles.length > 0, 'Fixture must expose actual State/course/member authority paths for readback');

+}
+async function author(c, f, row, kind, support = false) {

+  const files = [{path: row.file, source: data.source}];
+  let supportFile = null;
+  if (support) {
+    supportFile = path.join(path.dirname(suite), 'actual-support.mjs');
+    files[0].source += "import {value} from './actual-support.mjs';\nassert.equal(value,42);\n";

+}
+
+// Invoked ONLY by the actual fixed Source Controller after genuine ctor/run/bind.
+// Plain context is not authority: all Source APIs recheck the original private handles.
+// No runtime factory, preload, caller-selected module, transferred brand or METHOD.
+export async function runOwnedControllerCase({caseId,variant,context}) {
+  const variants={OSV001:['standard'],OSV002:['standard'],OSV003:['standard'],OSV004:['complete','missing','malformed','duplicate-declaration','incomplete','real-failure'],OSV005:['replay','deadline','disconnect'],OSV006:['standard'],OSV007:['standard'],OSV008:['standard']};
+  assert.ok(Object.hasOwn(variants,caseId)&&variants[caseId].includes(variant),'Require an exact fixed original case/variant');

+  async function course(id, kinds, callback) {

+    assert.equal(current.course.lifecycle,'approved','Original positive verifies while actually approved');
+    assert.equal(current.repository.primaryRoot,f.repository);
+    assert.deepEqual(current.repository,context.repository,'Source context must retain the same actual full repository');
+    const observed=onboarding.observeSessionCleanupState(f.repository);
+    assert.equal(typeof observed.path,'string');
+    const state=observed.state;
+    const memberFile=path.join(current.repository.commonDir,current.issuer.expectedMemberRef.path.slice(5));
+    f.authorityFiles=[observed.path,path.resolve(f.repository,current.course.planPath),path.resolve(f.repository,state.planSubmission.specPath),memberFile];
+    if(state.planApproval?.acceptedContract)f.authorityFiles.push(path.resolve(f.repository,state.planApproval.acceptedContract.path));
+    f.authorityFiles=[...new Set(f.authorityFiles)];
+    const controller=library.createSourceOwnedContinuityVerificationController({runtimePort:f.runtime.runtimePort});
+    assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(controller).sort(),['acquireVerificationPort','authorOwnedTaskVerificationSuite','completeOwnedTaskVerificationRegistration']);
+    await callback({f,rows,library,onboarding,current,controller});
+    // Original entry owns final requester disposal. No fixture/runtime is minted here.
+  }
+  const cases = Object.freeze([
+    {id:'OSV001',name:'Actual approved owning course executes its Source-associated real suite',run:()=>course('OSV001',['complete'],async({f,rows,controller})=>{
+      const prepared = await author(controller,f,rows[0],'complete');

+    {id:'OSV002',name:'Real task custody rejects forged preparation, foreign selection and support drift',run:()=>course('OSV002',['complete','missing'],async({f,rows,controller})=>{

+      assertOwnedPhysicalConservation({root:f.ownedRoot,before});
+      const prepared = await author(controller,f,rows[0],'complete',true);
+      refusal(await controller.acquireVerificationPort().execute({suiteId:rows[1].name}),['OSV-ASSOCIATION-UNAVAILABLE']);

+      assertOwnedPhysicalConservation({root:f.ownedRoot,before});
+    })},

+      const prepared=await author(controller,f,rows[0],'complete');

+      try { refusal(await prepared.port.execute({suiteId:rows[0].name}),['OSV-INPUT-DRIFT','OSV-OWNER-UNAVAILABLE','OSV-VERIFY-FAILED']); }

+      if(variant==='replay') { await course('OSV005',['complete'],async({f,rows,controller})=>{

+      const prepared=await author(controller,f,rows[0],'complete');
+      const before=plainPhysicalAuthority(f);
+      actualSuccess(await prepared.port.execute({suiteId:rows[0].name}));

+      const prepared=await author(controller,f,rows[0],'complete');
+      const before=plainPhysicalAuthority(f);

+      refusal(await prepared.port.execute({suiteId:rows[0].name}),['OSV-REPLAY']);
+      await assertActualGuardRefusal({graphRoot:f.graphRoot,repository:f.repository,kind:'public-frame'});
+      await assertActualGuardRefusal({graphRoot:f.graphRoot,repository:f.repository,kind:'ordinary-command'});
+      assertOwnedPhysicalConservation({root:f.ownedRoot,before});

+  ]);
+  const selected=cases.find(row=>row.id===caseId);
+  assert.ok(selected);
+  const recorder=createTestCaseCompletionRecorder({caseIds:[caseId],fd:3,maxBytes:65536});
+  try {
+    await selected.run();

+    try { recorder.dispose(caseId,'fail'); } catch {}
+    throw error; // Preserve the exact original Error; FD3 failure never changes the verdict.
+  }
+}
