+  OSV007:Object.freeze(['standard']),OSV008:Object.freeze(['standard'])
+});
+const exact=(value,keys)=>value!==null&&typeof value==='object'&&!Array.isArray(value)
+  &&Object.keys(value).sort().join(',')===[...keys].sort().join(',');
+function refuse(code){const error=new Error(code);error.name='OwningVerificationControllerError';error.code=code;throw error;}
+function selectors(argv){
+  if(argv.length!==6||argv[0]!=='--root'||argv[2]!=='--suite'||argv[4]!=='--task-source')refuse('OVC-INPUT');
+  const root=argv[1],suiteId=argv[3],taskSource=argv[5];
+  if(!isAbsolute(root)||resolve(root)!==root||realpathSync(root)!==root||process.cwd()!==root
+    ||!isAbsolute(taskSource)||resolve(taskSource)!==taskSource||realpathSync(taskSource)!==taskSource
+    ||typeof suiteId!=='string'||! /^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,119}$/u.test(suiteId))refuse('OVC-INPUT');
+  const tail=relative(root,taskSource);
+  if(!tail||tail==='..'||tail.startsWith('..'+sep)||isAbsolute(tail))refuse('OVC-INPUT');
+  return {root,suiteId,taskSource};
+}
+function taskInput(selected){
+  const input=readOwnedVerificationPhysicalFile(selected.taskSource,{root:selected.root,maxBytes:MAX_INPUT});
+  const value=parseStrictJson(input.bytes);
+  if(value?.schema==='pipeline.owning-verification-controller-check.v1'){
+    if(!exact(value,['schema','suiteId','caseId','variant'])||value.suiteId!==selected.suiteId
+      ||!Object.hasOwn(CHECK_CASES,value.caseId)||!CHECK_CASES[value.caseId].includes(value.variant)
+      ||value.suiteId!==value.caseId.toLowerCase()+'-'+value.variant)refuse('OVC-CHECK-INPUT');
+    return {value,ref:input.ref,check:true};
+  }
+  if(!exact(value,['schema','suiteId','files'])||value.schema!=='pipeline.owning-verification-task-source.v1'
+    ||value.suiteId!==selected.suiteId||!Array.isArray(value.files)||value.files.length<1||value.files.length>128
+    ||value.files.some(file=>!exact(file,['path','source'])||typeof file.path!=='string'||typeof file.source!=='string'))refuse('OVC-TASK-SOURCE');
+  return {value,ref:input.ref};
+}
+// Nonarming observations only. The constructor independently authenticates the
+// actual fixed kernel invocation and approval; this reader creates no brands.
+export function inspectOwningVerificationControllerTaskSource(input){
+  if(!exact(input,['rootDir','suiteId','taskSource']))refuse('OVC-INPUT');
+  const selected=selectors(['--root',input.rootDir,'--suite',input.suiteId,'--task-source',input.taskSource]);
+  const image=taskInput(selected),repository=inspectSignedDescriptorCustodyRepository(selected.root);
+  if(repository.primaryRoot!==selected.root)refuse('OVC-INPUT');
+  const registration=readOwnedVerificationRegistration(repository,selected.suiteId);
+  try{lstatSync(registration.selectedSuite.file);refuse('OVC-CHECK-TARGET-EXISTS');}
+  catch(error){if(error.code!=='ENOENT')throw error;}
+  if(image.check&&image.value.caseId==='OSV002')readOwnedVerificationRegistration(repository,'osv002-missing');
+  // Infrastructure root derives only from this installed Source location,
+  // separately from the actual owning repository/course/registration.
+  const sourceRoot=resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)),'..','..','..');
+  const sourceClosure=collectOwnedVerificationSourceModules({primaryRoot:sourceRoot},[fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)]);
+  recheckOwnedVerificationPhysicalRefs([...sourceClosure,image.ref]);
+  return Object.freeze({kind:image.check?'check':'task',taskSourceRef:image.ref,sourceClosure,registration});
+}
+async function runClosedControllerCheck(selected,input,runtime){
+  const repository=inspectSignedDescriptorCustodyRepository(selected.root);
+  const observed=inspectOwningVerificationControllerTaskSource({rootDir:selected.root,suiteId:selected.suiteId,taskSource:selected.taskSource});
+  if(observed.kind!=='check'||JSON.stringify(observed.taskSourceRef)!==JSON.stringify(input.ref))refuse('OVC-CHECK-INPUT');
+  const registration=observed.registration,closure=observed.sourceClosure;
+  recheckOwnedVerificationPhysicalRefs([...closure,input.ref]);
+  const controls=await import('./owning-verification-controller-controls.mjs');
+  recheckOwnedVerificationPhysicalRefs([...closure,input.ref]);
+  const fresh=readOwnedVerificationRegistration(repository,selected.suiteId);
+  if(JSON.stringify(fresh)!==JSON.stringify(registration))refuse('OVC-CHECK-REGISTRATION-DRIFT');
+  if(typeof controls.runOwnedControllerCase!=='function')refuse('OVC-CHECK-MODULE');
+  const result=await controls.runOwnedControllerCase(Object.freeze({caseId:input.value.caseId,variant:input.value.variant,
+    context:Object.freeze({repository,runtimePort:runtime.runtimePort,disposeRequester:runtime.dispose})}));
+  // No requester/Controller handle or callback result is serialized as authority.
+  recheckOwnedVerificationPhysicalRefs([...closure,input.ref]);
+  if(!exact(result,['schema','caseId','variant','status'])
+    ||result.schema!=='pipeline.owning-verification-controller-check-result.v1'
+    ||result.caseId!==input.value.caseId||result.variant!==input.value.variant||result.status!=='passed')refuse('OVC-CHECK-RESULT');
+  return Object.freeze({schema:'pipeline.owning-verification-controller-result.v1',status:'succeeded',code:null,
+    suiteId:selected.suiteId,caseId:input.value.caseId,variant:input.value.variant,taskSourceSha256:input.ref.sha256,
+    candidate:registration.candidate});
+}
+function finishOwningControllerLifetime(selected,runtime,result,check){
+  // Executed verification and owning terminal release are separate observations.
+  // Only the real same-process Source writer may release the original binding.
+  let cleanupRelease;
+  if(result.status!=='succeeded'){
+    cleanupRelease=Object.freeze({status:'held',code:'OVC-VERIFICATION-NOT-TERMINAL',committed:null});
+  }else{
+    try{
+      const before=observeSessionCleanupState(selected.root);
+      const released=releaseOnboardingSessionCleanup({rootDir:selected.root,sessionCleanup:runtime.sessionCleanup,
+        expectedStateSha256:before.stateSha256,expectedRevision:before.revision});
+      const after=observeSessionCleanupState(selected.root);
+      if(released?.status!=='released'||released.sessionCleanup!==null||after.sessionCleanup!==null||after.orphanBinding
+        ||JSON.stringify(after.state.activeFeature)!==JSON.stringify(before.state.activeFeature)
+        ||JSON.stringify(after.state.planApproval)!==JSON.stringify(before.state.planApproval)
+        ||after.state.planApproved!==before.state.planApproved)refuse('OVC-RELEASE-READBACK');
+      cleanupRelease=Object.freeze({status:'released',code:null,stateSha256:after.stateSha256,
+        revision:after.revision,mutated:released.mutated});
+    }catch(error){
+      const code=/^(?:SDC|SESSION-CLEANUP|OVC)-[A-Z0-9-]{1,80}$/u.test(error?.code??'')?error.code:'OVC-RELEASE-HELD';
+      cleanupRelease=Object.freeze({status:'held',code,committed:typeof error?.committed==='boolean'?error.committed:null});
+    }
+  }
+  if(!check&&result.status==='succeeded'&&cleanupRelease.status!=='released'){
+    return Object.freeze({...result,status:'held',code:cleanupRelease.code,verificationStatus:result.status,
+      cleanupRelease,owningLifetimeReleased:false});
+  }
+  return Object.freeze({...result,cleanupRelease,owningLifetimeReleased:cleanupRelease.status==='released'});
+}
+async function runOwningVerificationController(){
+  const selected=selectors(process.argv.slice(2)),input=taskInput(selected);
+  // The bridge independently authenticates the actual fixed entry/kernel argv,
+  // real approved State and genuine process/source facts. This argument grants nothing.
+  const runtime=createSourceOwnedApprovedControllerRequesterRuntime({rootDir:selected.root});
+  try{return await runtime.run(async()=>{
+    recheckOwnedVerificationPhysicalRefs([input.ref]);
+    bindOnboardingSessionCleanup({rootDir:selected.root,sessionCleanup:runtime.sessionCleanup,
+      expectedStateSha256:runtime.expectedStateSha256,expectedRevision:runtime.expectedRevision});
+    if(input.check){
+      const checked=await runClosedControllerCheck(selected,input,runtime);
+      return finishOwningControllerLifetime(selected,runtime,checked,true);
+    }
+    const controller=createSourceOwnedContinuityVerificationController({runtimePort:runtime.runtimePort});
+    const before=readOwnedVerificationCandidate({primaryRoot:selected.root});
+    const authored=controller.authorOwnedTaskVerificationSuite({suiteId:selected.suiteId,files:input.value.files});
+    if(authored.status!=='authored'||!authored.taskPreparationHandle)refuse('OVC-AUTHOR-UNAVAILABLE');
+    // The selected registered suite is independently rediscovered by the genuine API.
+    const registered=readOwnedVerificationRegistration({primaryRoot:selected.root},selected.suiteId);
+    const suiteRef=readOwnedVerificationPhysicalFile(registered.selectedSuite.file,{root:selected.root,maxBytes:MAX_INPUT}).ref;
+    // Existing protocol permits genuine untracked task files with complete physical
+    // custody. Registration was independently committed BEFORE the owning lifetime.
+    recheckOwnedVerificationPhysicalRefs([suiteRef,input.ref]);
+    const candidate=readOwnedVerificationCandidate({primaryRoot:selected.root});
+    if(candidate.commit!==before.commit||candidate.tree!==before.tree)refuse('OVC-CANDIDATE-DRIFT');
+    const completed=controller.completeOwnedTaskVerificationRegistration({taskPreparationHandle:authored.taskPreparationHandle});
+    if(completed.status!=='registered'||completed.suiteId!==selected.suiteId)refuse('OVC-REGISTRATION-UNAVAILABLE');
+    const result=await controller.acquireVerificationPort().execute({suiteId:selected.suiteId});
+    const executed=Object.freeze({schema:'pipeline.owning-verification-controller-result.v1',status:result.status,
+      code:result.code??null,suiteId:selected.suiteId,associationSha256:completed.associationSha256,
+      taskSourceSha256:input.ref.sha256,candidate});
+    return finishOwningControllerLifetime(selected,runtime,executed,false);
+  });}finally{await runtime.dispose();}
+}
+const entry=process.argv[1]&&resolve(process.argv[1]);
+if(entry===fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)){
+  runOwningVerificationController().then(result=>{
+    process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(result)+'\n');process.exitCode=result.status==='succeeded'?0:1;
+  }).catch(error=>{
+    const code=/^(?:OVC|OSV|SDC)-[A-Z0-9-]{1,80}$/u.test(error?.code??'')?error.code:'OVC-UNAVAILABLE';
+    process.stderr.write(JSON.stringify({schema:'pipeline.owning-verification-controller-result.v1',status:'unavailable',code})+'\n');
+    process.exitCode=1;
+  });
+}

+#!/usr/bin/env node
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: SUL-1.0
+/** Import-only regression: an installed Phoenix entry must link without checkout harness files. */
+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
+import { spawnSync } from "node:child_process";
+import { cpSync, existsSync, lstatSync, mkdirSync, mkdtempSync, readFileSync, readdirSync, rmSync } from "node:fs";
+import { join, resolve } from "node:path";
+import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
+import { registerTestCaseCompletion } from "../lib/test-case-completion.mjs";
+
+function snapshot(root, prefix = "") {
+  const entries = [];
+  for (const name of readdirSync(join(root, prefix)).sort()) {
+    const relative = join(prefix, name);
+    const path = join(root, relative);
+    const stat = lstatSync(path);
+    assert.equal(stat.isSymbolicLink(), false, `standalone fixture must not escape through a symlink: ${relative}`);
+    if (stat.isDirectory()) {
+      entries.push([relative, "directory"]);
+      entries.push(...snapshot(root, relative));
+    } else {
+      assert.equal(stat.isFile(), true, `unsupported package entry: ${relative}`);
+      entries.push([relative, createHash("sha256").update(readFileSync(path)).digest("hex")]);
+    }
+  }
+  return entries;
+}
+
+const cases = [{ id: "PHARI001", name: "Phoenix authority revision imports from a standalone real plugin package without writer execution", run: (t) => {
+  const source = resolve(process.env.PIPELINE_PHOENIX_PACKAGE_ROOT ?? "plugins/pipeline-core");
+  const scratch = resolve("scratch/alfred-phoenix-package-regression-fixtures-20261011");
+  mkdirSync(scratch, { recursive: true });
+  const fixture = mkdtempSync(join(scratch, "package-"));
+  t.after(() => rmSync(fixture, { recursive: true, force: true }));
+  const installed = join(fixture, "installed", "pipeline-core");
+  cpSync(source, installed, { recursive: true, dereference: false });
+  const home = join(fixture, "empty-home");
+  mkdirSync(home);
+  const entry = join(installed, "scripts", "phoenix-authority-revision.mjs");
+  const writer = join(installed, "scripts", "pipeline-state.mjs");
+  assert.equal(existsSync(entry), true, "real Phoenix entry must be packaged");
+  assert.equal(existsSync(writer), true, "real canonical state writer must be packaged");
+  assert.equal(existsSync(join(fixture, "harness")), false, "no external checkout harness may mask the defect");
+  const before = snapshot(fixture);
+  // No argv are passed to either imported entry, and neither exported run is called.
+  // Node permissions deny filesystem writes, reads outside the fixture and child execution.
+  const program = `
+    const revision = await import(${JSON.stringify(pathToFileURL(entry).href)});
+    const writer = await import(${JSON.stringify(pathToFileURL(writer).href)});
+    if (typeof revision.run !== "function" || typeof writer.run !== "function") {
+      throw new Error("Phoenix and its genuine canonical writer must export run");
+    }
+    process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ revisionRun: typeof revision.run, writerRun: typeof writer.run }) + "\\n");
+  `;
+  const child = spawnSync(process.execPath, ["--permission", `--allow-fs-read=${fixture}`, "--input-type=module", "--eval", program], {
+    cwd: fixture,
+    env: { ...process.env, NODE_OPTIONS: "", HOME: home, USERPROFILE: home },
+    encoding: "utf8",
+    timeout: 30000,
+    maxBuffer: 1024 * 1024,
+    shell: false,
+  });
+  assert.deepEqual(snapshot(fixture), before, "import must leave all fixture bytes and paths unchanged");
+  assert.ifError(child.error);
+  assert.equal(child.signal, null, `import child terminated: ${child.stderr}`);
+  assert.equal(child.status, 0, `standalone Phoenix entry failed to import:\n${child.stderr}`);
+  assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(child.stdout), { revisionRun: "function", writerRun: "function" });
+} }];
+
+registerTestCaseCompletion({
+  cases,
+  fd: Number(process.env.PIPELINE_VERIFY_CASE_COMPLETION_FD ?? 3),
+  maxBytes: Number(process.env.PIPELINE_VERIFY_CASE_COMPLETION_MAX_BYTES ?? 4096),
+});

@@ -0,0 +1,100 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env node
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: SUL-1.0
+/**
+ * Usage: node report-resource-headroom.mjs --input scratch/resource-observations.json
+ * Or pass a bounded observation JSON document on stdin. Read-only diagnostic;
+ * exit 0 means the report was emitted, never that a project check passed.
+ * Source and artifact references are declared data and are never opened here.
+ */
+import { closeSync, constants, fstatSync, lstatSync, openSync, readSync, realpathSync } from 'node:fs';
+import { join, resolve } from 'node:path';
+import { TextDecoder } from 'node:util';
+import { isDirectInvocation } from '../lib/entrypoint.mjs';
+import { ResourceHeadroomError, reportProjectResourceHeadroom } from '../lib/project-resource-headroom.mjs';
+
+const MAX_INPUT_BYTES = 65536;
+const PRIVATE_ROOTS = new Set(['.git', '.ssh', '.aws', '.codex', '.agents', '.claude', '.pipeline']);
+const fail = (message) => { throw new ResourceHeadroomError(message); };
+
+export function parseResourceHeadroomArgs(argv) {
+  if (!Array.isArray(argv)) fail('Arguments must be an array.');
+  if (argv.length === 0) return { input: null };
+  if (argv.length !== 2 || argv[0] !== '--input' || typeof argv[1] !== 'string') fail('Expected only --input <repository-relative JSON path>.');
+  const input = argv[1];
+  const parts = input.split('/');
+  if (input.length === 0 || input.length > 500 || !input.endsWith('.json')
+    || /[\\:\x00-\x1f\x7f]/u.test(input) || parts.some(part => part === '' || part === '.' || part === '..')
+    || PRIVATE_ROOTS.has(parts[0])) fail('Input must be a public repository-relative JSON path.');
+  return { input };
+}
+
+function sameFile(left, right) {
+  return ['dev', 'ino', 'mode', 'nlink', 'size', 'mtimeNs', 'ctimeNs'].every(key => left[key] === right[key]);
+}
+
+function readInputFile(cwd, input) {
+  const requestedRoot = resolve(cwd);
+  const rootStat = lstatSync(requestedRoot);
+  if (!rootStat.isDirectory() || rootStat.isSymbolicLink() || realpathSync(requestedRoot) !== requestedRoot) fail('Input root must be a physical directory.');
+  let current = requestedRoot;
+  const parts = input.split('/');
+  let initial;
+  for (let index = 0; index < parts.length; index += 1) {
+    current = join(current, parts[index]);
+    const stat = lstatSync(current, { bigint: true });
+    if (stat.isSymbolicLink() || realpathSync(current) !== current) fail('Input path must not use physical aliases.');
+    if (index < parts.length - 1) {
+      if (!stat.isDirectory()) fail('Input parent is not a directory.');
+    } else {
+      if (!stat.isFile() || stat.nlink !== 1n || stat.size > BigInt(MAX_INPUT_BYTES)) fail('Input must be one bounded regular file.');
+      initial = stat;
+    }
+  }
+  const fd = openSync(current, constants.O_RDONLY | (constants.O_NOFOLLOW ?? 0));
+  try {
+    const opened = fstatSync(fd, { bigint: true });
+    if (!sameFile(initial, opened)) fail('Input physical identity changed.');
+    const buffer = Buffer.alloc(MAX_INPUT_BYTES + 1);
+    let size = 0;
+    while (size < buffer.length) {
+      const count = readSync(fd, buffer, size, buffer.length - size, null);
+      if (count === 0) break;
+      size += count;
+    }
+    if (size > MAX_INPUT_BYTES || !sameFile(opened, fstatSync(fd, { bigint: true }))
+      || !sameFile(opened, lstatSync(current, { bigint: true }))) fail('Input changed while being read.');
+    return buffer.subarray(0, size);
+  } finally { closeSync(fd); }
+}
+
+async function readStdin(stdin) {
+  const chunks = [];
+  let size = 0;
+  for await (const chunk of stdin) {
+    if (typeof chunk !== 'string' && !Buffer.isBuffer(chunk) && !(chunk instanceof Uint8Array)) fail('Input stream must contain UTF-8 bytes.');
+    const bytes = Buffer.from(chunk);
+    size += bytes.length;
+    if (size > MAX_INPUT_BYTES) fail('Input exceeds the JSON transport bound.');
+    chunks.push(bytes);
+  }
+  return Buffer.concat(chunks);
+}
+
+export async function main({ argv = process.argv.slice(2), stdin = process.stdin,
+  stdout = process.stdout, stderr = process.stderr, cwd = process.cwd() } = {}) {
+  try {
+    const args = parseResourceHeadroomArgs(argv);
+    const bytes = args.input === null ? await readStdin(stdin) : readInputFile(cwd, args.input);
+    const text = new TextDecoder('utf-8', { fatal: true }).decode(bytes);
+    const report = reportProjectResourceHeadroom(JSON.parse(text));
+    stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify(report, null, 2)}\n`);
+    return 0;
+  } catch (error) {
+    // Do not echo caller input, native paths or private filesystem error text.
+    const message = error instanceof ResourceHeadroomError ? error.message : 'Unable to read valid bounded observation JSON.';
+    stderr.write(`RESOURCE-HEADROOM-INPUT: ${message}\n`);
+    return 2;
+  }
+}
+
+if (isDirectInvocation(import.meta.url)) process.exitCode = await main();

+#!/usr/bin/env node
+// SPDX-License-Identifier: SUL-1.0
+// Bounded, report-only command used after a handover update and by guard-push.
+import { lstatSync, realpathSync } from "node:fs";
+import { resolve } from "node:path";
+import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
+import { reportScratchCustody } from "../lib/scratch-custody-report.mjs";
+
+const OID = /^(?:[0-9a-f]{40}|[0-9a-f]{64})$/u;
+function usage() {
+  process.stderr.write("Usage: scratch-custody-check.mjs --root <repo> [--push-commit <full-oid>]\n");
+  process.exitCode = 2;
+}
+function main(argv) {
+  let root = null;
+  let pushCommit = null;
+  for (let i = 0; i < argv.length; i += 1) {
+    if (argv[i] === "--root" && root === null && argv[i + 1] && !argv[i + 1].startsWith("--")) root = argv[++i];
+    else if (argv[i] === "--push-commit" && pushCommit === null && argv[i + 1] && !argv[i + 1].startsWith("--")) pushCommit = argv[++i];
+    else return usage();
+  }
+  if (!root || (pushCommit !== null && !OID.test(pushCommit))) return usage();
+  try {
+    const absolute = resolve(root);
+    const stat = lstatSync(absolute);
+    if (!stat.isDirectory() || stat.isSymbolicLink() || realpathSync(absolute) !== absolute) throw new Error("unsafe root");
+    const report = reportScratchCustody({ root: absolute, pushCommit });
+    process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify(report)}\n`);
+    // Findings are WARN/report-only. They never refuse a close or push.
+    if (report.warnings.length) process.stderr.write(`[scratch-custody] WARN: ${report.warnings.length} custody finding(s); review the typed report.\n`);
+  } catch {
+    process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify({ schema: "pipeline.scratch-custody-report.v1", mode: "report-only", warnings: [{ code: "observer-unavailable" }], views: [] })}\n`);
+    process.stderr.write("[scratch-custody] WARN: custody report unavailable; no close or push gate was changed.\n");
+  }
+}
+
+if (process.argv[1] && resolve(process.argv[1]) === fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)) main(process.argv.slice(2));

+import {mkdtempSync,chmodSync,lstatSync,realpathSync} from 'node:fs';
+import {userInfo} from 'node:os';
+import {join,resolve,dirname,isAbsolute} from 'node:path';
+import {fileURLToPath} from 'node:url';

+const sourceRoot=fileURLToPath(new URL('../../../',import.meta.url));
+const fixtureRoot=fileURLToPath(new URL('./signing-disclosure-sweep/',import.meta.url));
+assert.equal(resolve(sourceRoot),resolve(fixtureRoot,'../../../..'));
+const originalCwd=process.cwd();
+const osUser=userInfo(),home=osUser.homedir;
+assert(isAbsolute(home)&&resolve(home)===home&&home!=='/');
+assert(Number.isSafeInteger(osUser.uid)&&osUser.uid===process.getuid());
+const fields=['dev','ino','uid','gid','mode','nlink','size','mtimeNs','ctimeNs'];
+function directoryFact(path){
+  const s=lstatSync(path,{bigint:true});
+  assert(s.isDirectory()&&!s.isSymbolicLink()&&(s.mode&0o022n)===0n);
+  assert.equal(realpathSync(path),path);
+  try{lstatSync(join(path,'.git'));assert.fail('METHOD cwd must be outside every Git worktree');}catch(error){assert.equal(error.code,'ENOENT');}

+    assert.equal(records.length,1,'exact actual request-bound review material');return records[0];
+  }
+  function capture(action,onDisclosure=()=>{}) {
+    const original=process.stdout.write;let output='';
+    process.stdout.write=function(chunk,...args){output+=String(chunk);onDisclosure(String(chunk));return true;};
+    try{return {result:action(),output};}finally{process.stdout.write=original;}
+  }
+  return [
+    {id:'SDR001',scope:'controlled-encrypted-METHOD-signing-material',async run(){
+      const fixture=await createSigningMethodFixture(configuration),request=fixture.readRequest();

+      assert.equal(fixture.signingSpawns(),1,'real disposable encrypted signing once');
+      assert.equal(result.intentSha256,fixture.transport.intentSha256);
+      const proof=JSON.parse(readFileSync(result.paths.proof));
+      assert.equal(proof.intentSha256,fixture.transport.intentSha256);
+      assert(verify(null,Buffer.from(proof.intentSha256),fixture.publicKey,Buffer.from(proof.signatureBase64,'base64')),'actual signature verifies exact original intent');
+      const full=material(fixture),info=lstatSync(full.path);
+      assert.equal(info.nlink,1);assert.equal(info.mode&0o777,0o600);
+      assert.equal(full.record.request.sha256,sha(request));assert.deepEqual(full.record.request.record,fixture.transport);
+      assert(Array.isArray(full.record.fullDisclosureLines));assert(full.record.fullDisclosureLines.length>0);
+      assert(output.includes(sha(full.bytes)),'prompt names actual full-material byte digest');
+      assert(output.trimEnd().split('\n').length<=25,'actual protected-key disclosure frame stays bounded');
+      assert.deepEqual(fixture.readRequest(),request,'signing cannot rewrite request');
+    }},
+    {id:'SDR002',scope:'controlled-readiness-first-no-owner-request-read',async run(){
+      const fixture=await createSigningMethodFixture(configuration);
+      writeFileSync(join(fixture.keys,'po-public.pem'),'METHOD public key mismatch\n',{mode:0o600});
+      let requestReads=0,privateReads=0;
+      fixture.dependencies.readFile=(path,...args)=>{
+        if(path===join(fixture.f.dir,fixture.request))requestReads++;
+        if(path===join(fixture.keys,'po-private.pem'))privateReads++;
+        return readFileSync(path,...args);
+      };
+      assert.throws(()=>fixture.run(),error=>Array.isArray(error.findings)&&error.findings.some(finding=>finding.findingId==='trust-anchor-match'&&finding.status!=='ok'));
+      assert.equal(requestReads,0,'actual anchor failure precedes scratch request/describer');
+      assert.equal(privateReads,0,'unmatched public anchor cannot open private key');assert.equal(fixture.signingSpawns(),0);
+      assert.equal(readdirSync(join(fixture.f.dir,'scratch')).filter(name=>name.startsWith('review-')).length,0,'no material publication before readiness');
+    }},
+    {id:'SDR003',scope:'controlled-late-material-CAS-before-signing',async run(){
+      const fixture=await createSigningMethodFixture(configuration);let changed=false;
+      assert.throws(()=>capture(()=>fixture.run(),()=>{

+      assert(changed,'actual disclosure reached before exact owned material tamper');
+      assert.equal(fixture.signingSpawns(),0,'late material drift refuses before private signing child');
+      assert(!existsSync(join(fixture.keys,`proof-${fixture.transport.intentSha256}.json`)),'no proof published on drift');
+    }}
+  ];
+}

+  owner.staged.git(f,'add','--','project/critical-human-proof.json');

+  const pluginRoot=join(sourceRoot,'plugins/pipeline-core'),scriptPath=join(pluginRoot,'scripts/guard-human-override.mjs');
+  const denied=hgo.recordHumanGuardDenial({rootDir:f.dir,pluginRoot,scriptPath,toolName:'Write',toolInput:{file_path:'method-signing-target.md',content:'METHOD input\n'},denials:[{guard:'guard-lifecycle-ready.mjs',reason:'GUARD-DEVPLAN-SHELL'}]});
+  assert.equal(denied.status,'planned');
+  const plan=hgo.planHumanGuardOverride({rootDir:f.dir,pluginRoot,scriptPath,requestSha256:denied.requestSha256});
+  let emitted='',errors='';
+  assert.equal(cli.main(['emit-signature-digest','--repo',f.dir,'--request-sha256',denied.requestSha256,'--plan-sha256',plan.planSha256],{write:value=>{emitted+=value;},writeError:value=>{errors+=value;}}),0);

+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import {generateKeyPairSync,createHash,sign} from 'node:crypto';
+import {join,resolve} from 'node:path';
+import {pathToFileURL} from 'node:url';
+
+// Synthetic METHOD signatures verified by the genuine authorization producer.
+// Historical clock inputs are original writer API inputs, not stored JSON edits.
+export async function createSweepAuthorityFixture({fixtureRoot,sourceRoot,course}) {
+  assert(['armed-current','consumed-current','consumed-before-bind'].includes(course));
+  assert.equal(resolve(sourceRoot),resolve(fixtureRoot,'../../../..'));
+  const owner=await import(pathToFileURL(join(fixtureRoot,'state-owner.fixture.mjs')));
+  const hgo=await import(pathToFileURL(join(sourceRoot,'plugins/pipeline-core/lib/human-guard-override.mjs')));
+  const f=owner.staged.makeFixture('signature',{stage:'initialized'});
+  const pair=generateKeyPairSync('ed25519'),publicKey=pair.publicKey.export({type:'spki',format:'pem'});
+  const keyReference='disposable-sweep-METHOD-key';
+  owner.staged.writeJson(f,'project/critical-human-proof.json',{schema:'pipeline.critical-human-proof-policy.v3',requiredKinds:['push'],waivedKinds:[],trustAnchors:[{keyReference,publicKeySha256:createHash('sha256').update(publicKey).digest('hex')}]});
+  owner.staged.git(f,'add','--','project/critical-human-proof.json');
+  owner.staged.git(f,'commit','-q','-m','test: bind disposable sweep METHOD public anchor');
+  const pluginRoot=join(sourceRoot,'plugins/pipeline-core'),scriptPath=join(pluginRoot,'scripts/guard-human-override.mjs');
+  const toolName='Write',toolInput={file_path:'method-authority-sweep-target.md',content:'Disposable METHOD operation\n'};
+  const denials=[{guard:'guard-lifecycle-ready.mjs',reason:'GUARD-DEVPLAN-SHELL'}];
+  // An unexpired consumed-before-bind case proves consumption eligibility rather
+  // than merely expiry. The two current-owner cases are expired at sweep time.
+  const nowMs=course==='consumed-before-bind'?Date.now():1000;
+  const shared={rootDir:f.dir,pluginRoot,scriptPath};
+  const denied=hgo.recordHumanGuardDenial({...shared,toolName,toolInput,denials,nowMs,ttlMs:86400000});
+  assert.equal(denied.status,'planned');
+  const planned=hgo.planHumanGuardOverride({...shared,requestSha256:denied.requestSha256,nowMs:nowMs+1});
+  const prepared=hgo.prepareHumanGuardOverrideAuthorization({...shared,requestSha256:denied.requestSha256,planSha256:planned.planSha256,reason:hgo.HGO_SIGNATURE_REASON,nowMs:nowMs+2});
+  const intent=hgo.buildHumanGuardOverrideSignatureIntent({prepared,planned});
+  const proof={schema:'pipeline.po-approval-proof.v1',intentSha256:intent.sha256,keyReference,publicKey,signatureBase64:sign(null,Buffer.from(intent.sha256),pair.privateKey).toString('base64')};
+  const authorize=()=>hgo.authorizeHumanGuardOverrideBySignature({...shared,requestSha256:denied.requestSha256,planSha256:planned.planSha256,proof,nowMs:nowMs+3});
+  const consume=()=>hgo.consumeHumanGuardOverride({...shared,toolName,toolInput,denials,nowMs:nowMs+4});
+  let authorization,consumption=null;
+  if(course==='consumed-before-bind') {
+    authorization=authorize();assert.equal(authorization.status,'armed');
+    consumption=consume();assert.equal(consumption.status,'consumed');
+    await owner.bindActualStateOwner(f);
+  } else {
+    await owner.bindActualStateOwner(f);
+    authorization=f.runtime.run(authorize);assert.equal(authorization.status,'armed');
+    if(course==='consumed-current') {consumption=f.runtime.run(consume);assert.equal(consumption.status,'consumed');}
+  }
+  return {f,hgo,shared,course,denied,planned,authorization,consumption,
+    sweep:()=>f.runtime.run(()=>hgo.sweepHumanGuardOverrideRequests({rootDir:f.dir}))};
+}

+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import {readFileSync,existsSync,readdirSync,lstatSync} from 'node:fs';
+import {join,resolve} from 'node:path';
+import {pathToFileURL} from 'node:url';
+import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
+
+// Root-executed METHOD constructors. The real denial writer creates expiry;
+// the real initialized project is bound only after those inputs exist.
+// No fixture writes a request, capability, hold, consumed event, or READY state.
+export async function sweepCases({fixtureRoot,sourceRoot}) {
+  assert.equal(resolve(sourceRoot),resolve(fixtureRoot,'../../../..'),'all constructors and readers must load one graph instance');
+  const owner=await import(pathToFileURL(join(fixtureRoot,'state-owner.fixture.mjs')));
+  const hgo=await import(pathToFileURL(join(sourceRoot,'plugins/pipeline-core/lib/human-guard-override.mjs')));
+  const pluginRoot=join(sourceRoot,'plugins/pipeline-core');
+  const scriptPath=join(pluginRoot,'scripts/guard-human-override.mjs');
+  const digest=b=>createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex');
+  const canonical=value=>Array.isArray(value)?`[${value.map(canonical).join(',')}]`:value!==null&&typeof value==='object'?`{${Object.keys(value).sort().map(key=>`${JSON.stringify(key)}:${canonical(value[key])}`).join(',')}}`:JSON.stringify(value);
+  async function setup(rows) {
+    const f=owner.staged.makeFixture('signature',{stage:'initialized'});
+    const records=rows.map((expired,index)=>{
+      const record=hgo.recordHumanGuardDenial({rootDir:f.dir,pluginRoot,scriptPath,
+        toolName:'Write',toolInput:{file_path:`method-sweep-${index}.md`,content:`METHOD ${index}\n`},
+        denials:[{guard:'guard-lifecycle-ready.mjs',reason:'GUARD-DEVPLAN-SHELL'}],
+        nowMs:expired?1000:Date.now(),ttlMs:86400000});
+      assert.equal(record.status,'planned','genuine denial producer must succeed before any sweep');
+      assert.match(record.requestSha256,/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/);
+      return record;
+    });
+    await owner.bindActualStateOwner(f);
+    return {f,records};
+  }
+  function locate(f,sha) {
+    // Discover by authenticated request content, never basename-as-authority.
+    const root=join(f.repository.commonDir,'agent-pipeline');
+    const matches=[];let entries=0;
+    function visit(path,depth=0) {
+      assert(depth<=8,'bounded owned request discovery');
+      for(const name of readdirSync(path)) {
+        assert(++entries<=4096,'bounded owned namespace membership');
+        const child=join(path,name),info=lstatSync(child);
+        assert(!info.isSymbolicLink(),'no symlink traversal');
+        if(info.isDirectory())visit(child,depth+1);
+        else if(info.isFile()&&name.endsWith('.json')&&info.size<=1048576) {
+          const bytes=readFileSync(child);let record;try{record=JSON.parse(bytes);}catch{continue;}
+          if(digest(canonical(record))===sha&&/^pipeline\.human-guard-override-request\./.test(record.schema??''))matches.push({path:child,sha256:digest(bytes)});
+        }
+      }
+    }
+    visit(root);assert.equal(matches.length,1,'exact Source-produced request record');return matches[0];
+  }
+  return [
+    {id:'SDS001',scope:'controlled-expiry-with-current-all12',async run(){
+      const {f,records}=await setup([true,false]);
+      const expired=locate(f,records[0].requestSha256),active=locate(f,records[1].requestSha256);
+      const result=f.runtime.run(()=>hgo.sweepHumanGuardOverrideRequests({rootDir:f.dir}));
+      assert.equal(result.status,'swept');assert.equal(result.removed,1);
+      assert.equal(existsSync(expired.path),false,'actual expired request removed');
+      assert.equal(digest(readFileSync(active.path)),active.sha256,'actual unexpired unconsumed request conserved');
+      assert.equal(lstatSync(active.path).nlink,1);
+    }},
+    {id:'SDS002',scope:'controlled-unconsumed-retention',async run(){
+      const {f,records}=await setup([false]);const request=locate(f,records[0].requestSha256);
+      const result=f.runtime.run(()=>hgo.sweepHumanGuardOverrideRequests({rootDir:f.dir}));
+      assert.equal(result.status,'absent');assert.equal(result.removed,0);assert.equal(result.remainingEligible,0);
+      assert.equal(digest(readFileSync(request.path)),request.sha256,'zero matching capabilities must not count as authentic consumption');
+    }},
+    {id:'SDS003',scope:'controlled-one-use-effect-followup',async run(){
+      const {f,records}=await setup([true]);const request=locate(f,records[0].requestSha256);
+      const first=f.runtime.run(()=>hgo.sweepHumanGuardOverrideRequests({rootDir:f.dir}));
+      assert.equal(first.status,'swept');assert.equal(first.removed,1);assert(!existsSync(request.path));
+      const second=f.runtime.run(()=>hgo.sweepHumanGuardOverrideRequests({rootDir:f.dir}));
+      assert.equal(second.status,'absent');assert.equal(second.removed,0);assert.equal(second.remainingEligible,0);
+    }}
+  ];
+}

+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
+import fs from 'node:fs';
+import {syncBuiltinESMExports} from 'node:module';
+import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
+import {join,resolve} from 'node:path';
+import {pathToFileURL} from 'node:url';
+
+const hash=bytes=>createHash('sha256').update(bytes).digest('hex');
+function image(path) {
+  const stat=fs.lstatSync(path);assert(stat.isFile()&&!stat.isSymbolicLink()&&stat.nlink===1);
+  return {path,sha256:hash(fs.readFileSync(path)),dev:stat.dev,ino:stat.ino,mode:stat.mode,uid:stat.uid,gid:stat.gid,nlink:stat.nlink,size:stat.size};
+}
+function inventory(root,exclude=()=>false) {
+  const files=[];let count=0;
+  function walk(path,depth=0) {
+    assert(depth<=12);const stat=fs.lstatSync(path);assert(!stat.isSymbolicLink());
+    if(stat.isDirectory())for(const name of fs.readdirSync(path)){assert(++count<=8192);walk(join(path,name),depth+1);}
+    else if(!exclude(path)){assert(stat.size<=1048576);files.push(image(path));}
+  }
+  walk(root);return files;
+}
+function conserve(rows) {for(const row of rows)assert.deepEqual(image(row.path),row,'original protected physical record conserved');}
+
+export async function sweepPhysicalMethodCases({fixtureRoot,sourceRoot}) {
+  assert.equal(resolve(sourceRoot),resolve(fixtureRoot,'../../../..'));
+  const owner=await import(pathToFileURL(join(fixtureRoot,'state-owner.fixture.mjs')));
+  const hgo=await import(pathToFileURL(join(sourceRoot,'plugins/pipeline-core/lib/human-guard-override.mjs')));
+  const registry=await import(pathToFileURL(join(sourceRoot,'plugins/pipeline-core/lib/session-authority-registry.mjs')));
+  async function setup(count) {
+    const f=owner.staged.makeFixture('signature',{stage:'initialized'});
+    const pluginRoot=join(sourceRoot,'plugins/pipeline-core'),scriptPath=join(pluginRoot,'scripts/guard-human-override.mjs');
+    const records=[];
+    for(let index=0;index<count;index++) {
+      const record=hgo.recordHumanGuardDenial({rootDir:f.dir,pluginRoot,scriptPath,toolName:'Write',
+        toolInput:{file_path:`physical-method-${count}-${index}.md`,content:`Disposable METHOD ${index}\n`},
+        denials:[{guard:'guard-lifecycle-ready.mjs',reason:'GUARD-DEVPLAN-SHELL'}],nowMs:1000,ttlMs:86400000});
+      assert.equal(record.status,'planned');assert.match(record.requestSha256,/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/);records.push(record);
+    }
+    await owner.bindActualStateOwner(f);
+    const root=join(f.repository.commonDir,'agent-pipeline','human-guard-overrides');
+    const requests=records.map(record=>image(join(root,'requests',record.requestSha256+'.json')));
+    assert.equal(new Set(requests.map(row=>row.path)).size,count);
+    for(const row of requests)assert(Date.parse(JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(row.path)).expiresAt)<Date.now());
+    return {f,root,requests,sweep:()=>f.runtime.run(()=>hgo.sweepHumanGuardOverrideRequests({rootDir:f.dir}))};
+  }
+  return [
+    {id:'SDF001',scope:'isolated-METHOD-real-partial-unlink-EBADF',async run(){
+      const x=await setup(2),authority=join(x.f.repository.commonDir,'agent-pipeline','session-authority');
+      const protectedRows=[...inventory(x.root,path=>x.requests.some(row=>row.path===path)),...inventory(authority)];
+      const auditBefore=fs.readFileSync(join(x.root,'audit.jsonl'));
+      const originals=Object.fromEntries(['openSync','readSync','closeSync','unlinkSync'].map(name=>[name,fs[name]]));
+      const descriptors=new Map();let removed=null,reached=0,observedError=null,openedFlags=null,faultRequest=null;
+      fs.unlinkSync=function(path,...args) {
+        if(typeof path!=='string'||!path.startsWith(join(x.root,'requests','.sweep-'))||!path.endsWith('/request.json'))return originals.unlinkSync(path,...args);
+        const stat=fs.lstatSync(path),request=x.requests.find(row=>row.dev===stat.dev&&row.ino===stat.ino);
+        const result=originals.unlinkSync(path,...args);
+        if(request){assert.equal(removed,null,'only the first request may physically disappear');assert(!fs.existsSync(path));removed=request;}
+        return result;
+      };
+      fs.openSync=function(path,flags,...args) {
+        const fd=originals.openSync(path,flags,...args);
+        if(removed&&reached===0&&typeof flags==='number'&&(flags&(fs.constants.O_WRONLY|fs.constants.O_RDWR))===0) {
+          const request=x.requests.find(row=>row.path===path&&row!==removed);
+          if(request){const stat=fs.fstatSync(fd);assert.equal(stat.dev,request.dev);assert.equal(stat.ino,request.ino);descriptors.set(fd,request);openedFlags=flags;}
+        }
+        return fd;
+      };
+      fs.readSync=function(fd,...args) {
+        if(descriptors.has(fd)&&reached===0) {
+          faultRequest=descriptors.get(fd);assert(removed);assert(!fs.existsSync(removed.path));reached++;
+          originals.closeSync(fd);
+          try{return originals.readSync(fd,...args);}catch(error){observedError=error.code;throw error;}
+        }
+        return originals.readSync(fd,...args);
+      };
+      fs.closeSync=function(fd){try{return originals.closeSync(fd);}finally{descriptors.delete(fd);}};
+      syncBuiltinESMExports();let thrown=null,result;
+      try{result=x.sweep();}catch(error){thrown=error;}
+      finally{for(const [name,value]of Object.entries(originals))fs[name]=value;syncBuiltinESMExports();}
+      assert.equal(reached,1);assert.equal(observedError,'EBADF');assert.equal(typeof openedFlags,'number');
+      assert.equal(result,undefined);assert.equal(thrown?.name,'HumanGuardOverrideError');assert.equal(thrown?.code,'HGO-SWEEP-CAS');
+      assert(!fs.existsSync(removed.path));assert.deepEqual(image(faultRequest.path),faultRequest);
+      conserve(protectedRows);assert.deepEqual(fs.readFileSync(join(x.root,'audit.jsonl')),auditBefore);
+      assert.equal(hgo.verifyHumanGuardOverrideAudit({rootDir:x.f.dir}).status,'valid');
+      let admissionError=null;
+      try{x.f.runtime.run(()=>registry.withSessionAuthorityBoundary({repository:x.f.repository},boundary=>
+        registry.inspectSourceOwnedSessionAuthorityProducerRecord({boundary,producerPort:x.f.ports.find(row=>row.producerId==='human-guard-override').port})));}
+      catch(error){admissionError=error;}
+      assert.equal(admissionError?.name,'SessionAuthorityError');
+      assert(['SDC-AUTHORITY-CAS','SDC-AUTHORITY-UNAVAILABLE'].includes(admissionError?.code),'genuine subsequent admission must fail closed');
+      conserve(protectedRows);assert(!fs.existsSync(removed.path));assert.deepEqual(image(faultRequest.path),faultRequest);
+    }},
+    {id:'SDF002',scope:'actual-61-per-operation-budget',async run(){
+      const x=await setup(62),auditBefore=fs.readFileSync(join(x.root,'audit.jsonl'));
+      const preserved=inventory(x.root,path=>x.requests.some(row=>row.path===path)||['audit.jsonl','audit.head.json'].some(name=>path===join(x.root,name)));
+      const result=x.sweep();assert.equal(result.status,'swept');assert.equal(result.removed,61);
+      assert.equal(result.retained,1);assert.equal(result.remainingEligible,1);
+      const retained=x.requests.filter(row=>fs.existsSync(row.path));assert.equal(retained.length,1);assert.deepEqual(image(retained[0].path),retained[0]);
+      conserve(preserved);const audit=fs.readFileSync(join(x.root,'audit.jsonl'));
+      assert.deepEqual(audit.subarray(0,auditBefore.length),auditBefore);
+      assert.equal(hgo.verifyHumanGuardOverrideAudit({rootDir:x.f.dir}).status,'valid');
+    }}
+  ];
+}

+import assert from 'node:assert/strict';

+import {createHash} from 'node:crypto';
+
+// Actual CLI emitter and indexed owner reader; no approval/signature is minted.
+export async function typedHgoCases({fixtureRoot,sourceRoot}) {
+  assert.equal(resolve(sourceRoot),resolve(fixtureRoot,'../../../..'),'all constructors and readers must load one graph instance');
+  const owner=await import(pathToFileURL(join(fixtureRoot,'state-owner.fixture.mjs')));
+  const hgo=await import(pathToFileURL(join(sourceRoot,'plugins/pipeline-core/lib/human-guard-override.mjs')));
+  const cli=await import(pathToFileURL(join(sourceRoot,'plugins/pipeline-core/scripts/guard-human-override.mjs')));
+  const pluginRoot=join(sourceRoot,'plugins/pipeline-core'),scriptPath=join(pluginRoot,'scripts/guard-human-override.mjs');
+  async function setup() {
+    const f=owner.staged.makeFixture('signature',{stage:'initialized'});
+    const recorded=hgo.recordHumanGuardDenial({rootDir:f.dir,pluginRoot,scriptPath,toolName:'Write',
+      toolInput:{file_path:'method-typed-disclosure.md',content:'Disposable METHOD input\n'},
+      denials:[{guard:'guard-lifecycle-ready.mjs',reason:'GUARD-DEVPLAN-SHELL'}]});
+    assert.equal(recorded.status,'planned');
+    const plan=hgo.planHumanGuardOverride({rootDir:f.dir,pluginRoot,scriptPath,requestSha256:recorded.requestSha256});
+    let output='',error='';
+    const status=cli.main(['emit-signature-digest','--repo',f.dir,'--request-sha256',recorded.requestSha256,'--plan-sha256',plan.planSha256],
+      {write:text=>{output+=text;},writeError:text=>{error+=text;}});
+    assert.equal(status,0,'actual emitter must succeed; no fabricated transport fallback');assert.equal(error,'');
+    const transport=JSON.parse(output);
+    assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(transport).sort(),['intentSha256','planSha256','requestSha256','schema','selectionSha256']);
+    assert.equal(transport.schema,'pipeline.human-guard-override-signature-digest.v1');
+    await owner.bindActualStateOwner(f);
+    return {f,transport,options:{rootDir:f.dir,pluginRoot,scriptPath}};
+  }
+  return [
+    {id:'SDT001',scope:'actual-emitter-indexed-reader',async run(){
+      const {f,transport,options}=await setup();
+      const record=f.runtime.run(()=>hgo.describeHumanGuardOverrideSignatureRequest(transport,options));
+      assert(record!==null,'genuine emitted request must resolve its actual indexed owner');
+      assert.equal(record.resolved,true);
+      assert.deepEqual(record.requestBinding,{requestSha256:transport.requestSha256,planSha256:transport.planSha256,selectionSha256:transport.selectionSha256});
+      const material=readFileSync(record.materialArtifact.path);
+      assert.equal(createHash('sha256').update(material).digest('hex'),record.materialArtifact.sha256,'actual physical full plan bytes bind the material digest');
+      assert.equal(material.length,record.materialArtifact.bytes);
+      assert(record.fullReviewMaterial!==null&&typeof record.fullReviewMaterial==='object','full material comes from genuine indexed plan');
+      assert.deepEqual(JSON.parse(material),record.fullReviewMaterial,'full review is the actual same-FD owner plan, not invented disclosure');
+    }},
+    {id:'SDT002',scope:'exact-five-key-binding-refusal',async run(){
+      const {f,transport,options}=await setup();
+      for(const key of ['requestSha256','planSha256','selectionSha256','intentSha256']) {
+        const wrong={...transport,[key]:(transport[key]==='00'.repeat(32)?'11':'00').repeat(32)};
+        assert.equal(f.runtime.run(()=>hgo.describeHumanGuardOverrideSignatureRequest(wrong,options)),null,`altered ${key} must refuse`);
+        const missing={...transport};delete missing[key];
+        assert.equal(f.runtime.run(()=>hgo.describeHumanGuardOverrideSignatureRequest(missing,options)),null,`missing ${key} must refuse`);
+      }
+      for(const wrong of [{...transport,extra:true},{...transport,schema:'pipeline.foreign.v1'}])
+        assert.equal(f.runtime.run(()=>hgo.describeHumanGuardOverrideSignatureRequest(wrong,options)),null,'foreign or extended shape must refuse');
+      const after=f.runtime.run(()=>hgo.describeHumanGuardOverrideSignatureRequest(transport,options));
+      assert(after!==null,'negative reads cannot consume or alter the genuine indexed preparation');
+    }}
+  ];
+}
